(1)
  Peshe Haq Muzda Shafa'at Ka Sunate Jayengey
  Aap Rote Jayengey Hum Ko Hansaate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Peshe Haq = Allah Ke Saamne
2) Muzda = Khushkhabri
3) Shafa'at = Sifaarish

    Mafhoom :-
     Baroz E Qiyamat Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Khuda Ki
Bargah Me Humien Shafa'at Ka Muzda E Jaan Fiza
(Khushkhabri) Sunayengey. Dare Huwe Dilo'n Ko
Sukoon Aajega Phir Jab Ummat Sooye Jannat Rawaan
Hogi To Manzar Ye Hoga Ke Huzoor Khud To Rote
Hongey ( Ummat Ke Liye Allah Ki Bargah Me Rona)
Aur Ummat Ki Bakshish Ki Khushi Me Hansi Huyi
Ummat Jannat Ki Taraf Rawaan Dawaan Hogi.

  Dil Nikal Jaane Ki Ja Hai Aah Kin Aankho'n Se
               Woh
 Hum Se Pyaaso'n Ke Liye Darya Bahate Jayengey

                     1

Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Ja = Jagah
2) Hum Se = Humare Jaise
3) Bahana = Chalana

    Mafhoom :-
    Hamara Kaleja Phat Kyun Nahi Jaata ( Jab Ye
Manzoor Tasawwur Me Aaye) Ke Hamare Aaqa ﷺ
Hum Jaise Nikammo'n Ke Liye Apni Pyaari Aur
Sarmageen Aankhon Se Aansuon Ka Darya Baha Rahe
Hongey.

   Kusthgaane Garmi E Mehshar Ko Wo Jaan E
                 Maseeh
  Aaj Daaman Ki Hawaa De Kar Jilaate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Kushtgaane = Maqtool
2) Garmi E Mehshar = Qiyamat Ki Dhoop Aur Garmi
3)Jaan E Maseeh = Hazrath E Isa Alaihissalam Ki Jaan

    Mafhoom :-
     Allah! Allah! Mehshar Ki Qiyamat Ki Garmi Me
Jab Jism Jhalas Kar Murda Ho Chuke Hongey Wo Jaan

                     2

E Maseeh, Rehmat E Aalam ﷺ Apne Daaman E
Rehmat Ki Hawa De Kar Un Murdo'n Ko Zinda Farma
Rahe Hongey, Yaani Shafa'at Farma Kar Us Museebat
Se Chuda Rahe Hongey.

   Gul Khile Ga Aaj Ye Un Ki Naseem E Faiz Se
 Khoon Rote Aayengey Hum Muskurate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Naseem E Faiz = Bakhshish Ki Khushbudaar Hawa
2) Khoon Rona = Khoob Gid Gida Kar Rona

    Mafhoom :-
     Jab Aaqa Kareem ﷺ Ke Faiz O Karam Se
Thandi O Khushbudaar Hawa Chalegi To Murjaye
Huwe Chehre Phool Ki Tarah Khil Jayengey To Hum
Gunahgar Maidan E Mehshar Me Aaye To Khauf Ke
Maare  Rote  Rote Ab  Jannat  Ki  Taraf  Khoob
Khushiyaan Manate Ja Rahe Hain.

Haan Chalo Hasrat Zado'n Sunte Hain Wo Din Aaj
                    Hai
 Thi Khabar Jiski Ke Wo Jalwa Dikhate Jayengey


                     3

Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Hasrat Zada = Mehroom, Gham Ka Maara
2) Jalwa Dikhana = Deedar Karwana

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Gham Ke Maaro! Aye Be Saharo! Jis Din
Ke Baare Me Hum Ne Padha Aur Tum Ne Suna Tha
Ke Huzoor ﷺ Ka Deedar Hoga, Chalo! Wo Din Aa
Gaya Hai Aur Wo Dekho Mehboob E Khuda Apne
Chehre Anwar Se Parda Hatane Aa Rahe Hain.

 Aaj Eid E Aashiqaan Hain Gar Khuda Chahe Ke
               Woh
  Abru E Paywasta Ka Aalam Dikhate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     1) Eid = Khushi Ka Din
     2) Abru E Paywasta = Mile Huwe Bhavien

    Mafhoom :-
    Haan Haan Aaj Hi Aashiqan E Rasool Ki Asal
Eid Hai Ke Duniya Me To Bina Dekhe Un Ki Baatien
Karte The Aur Sunte The Aaj Zara Apni Aankhon Se
Mehboob E Khuda Ke Mile Huwe Bhanwein Mubarak

                     4

Dekho Aur Unki Bargah Me Mohabbat Ke Saath
Durood O Salam Ke Nazrane Pesh Karo.

 Khaak Uftaado'n Bas Unke Aane Hi Ke Dair Hai
  Khud Woh Gir Ka Sajda Me Tum Ko Utha Te
                   Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Khaak Uftaado'n = Zameen Par Gire Huwe Logon,
Majboor

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Khaak Nasheeno! Ab Tumhien Khaak Se
Utha Kar Jannat Ke Baghaat Pahunchane Ka Waqt
Aagaya, Bas Unke Aane Hi Ki Dair Hai Ek Sajde
Karengey, Khud Sajde Me Tashreef Le Jayengey Aur
Tumhien Khaak Se Utha Kar Hamdosh Sara Karengey.

 Kuch Khabar Bhi Hai Faqeero'n Aaj Wo Din Hai
                 Ke Woh
 Ne'mat E Khuld Apne Sadqe Me Lutate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     1) Ne'mat E Khuld = Jannat Ki Ne'mat

                     5

Mafhoom :- Duniya Me To Aaqa ﷺ Jannat Ki
Basharatien Sunate Rahe Lekin Aaj Baroz E Mehshar
Apni Ummat Ko Jannat Ki Nemat Taqseem Farmate
Huwe Dikhayi Dengey.

Wusa'tien Dee Hain Khuda Ne Daaman E Mehboob
                  Ko
Jurm Khulte Jayengey Aur Woh Chupate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Wusa'tien = Kushaadgi, Gunjaishien

    Mafhoom :-
     Sarkar E Madina ﷺ Ke Daaman E Karam Ko
Allah Ne Itna Wasee' Farma Diya Hain Ke Hamare
Jitne Bhi Jurm Maidan E Mehshar Me Pesh Hongey
Sab Us Daaman E Rehmat Me Chup Jayengey.

 Lo Woh Aaye Muskurate Hum Aseero'n Ki Taraf
 Khirman E I'siyaan Pe Ab Bijli Giraate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Lo Woh Aaye = Kisi Ki Achanak Aamad Par Bola
Jaata Hai
                     6

2) Aseero'n = Qaidiyon
3) Khirman E I'siyaan = Gunaho'n Ka Dher
4) Bijli Girana = Barbaad Karna

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Ahle Mehshar! Sab Khade Hojao! Wo
Dekho Aaqa ﷺKi Sawari Aagayi Aur Huzoor ﷺ
Apne Gunahgar Ummatiyo'n Ki Taraf Dekh Kar
Muskura  Rahe  Hain  Aur  Haan  Tumhien Apne
Gunaho'n Ke Ambaar Nazar Aa Rahe Hain, Us Liye
Pareshan Ho? To Phir Khush Hojao Dekho Mere Aaqa
Kis Tarah Tumhare Gunaho'n Pe Apne Jamal Ki
Bijliyo'n Gira Kar Unko Jala Kar Raakh Kar Rahe
Hain.

  Aankh Kholo Ghamzado'n Dekho Wo Giryaa'n
                 Aaye Hai
 Loh Dil Se Naqsh E Gham Ke Ab Mitate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz:-
1) Aankh Kholo = Hosh Me Aajao!
2) Giryaa'n = Rona
3) Loh Dil = Dil Ki Takhti
4) Naqsh = Nishaan

                     7

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mujrimo! Hosh Me Aao! Wo Dekho
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ! Allah Ki Bargah Me Ro Ro Kar
Tumhare Gunaho'n Ki Nishaan Tak Tumahre Dil Ki
Takhti Se Mitaa Rahe Hain.

  Sokhta Jaano'n Pe Wo Pur Josh E Rehmat Aaye
                   Hain
   Aab E Kausar Se Lagi Dil Ki Mitate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     1) Sokhta = Jala Huwa
     2) Aab E Kausar = Houz E Kausar Ka Paani

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye  Aasiyo'n!  Tumhare  Dilon  Ko  Agar
Gunaho'n Ki Aag Ne Jala Rakha Hai To Dekhte Nahi
Ho Ke Tumhare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ka Darya Bhi
Josh Me Aaya Huwa Hai, Wo Houz E Kausar Ke
Cheenton Se Tumhare Dilon Ko Lagi Huyi Aag
Bhujalengey.

Aaftab Unka Hi Chamkega Jab Auron Ke Chiraagh
  Sar Sar E Josh E Balaa Se Jhilmilate Jayengey
                     8

Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Aaftab = Suraj
2) Sar Sar = Aandhi
3) Jhilmilana = Chiragh Ka Thodi Thodi Roshni Dena

    Mafhoom :-
     Doosre Ambiya Kiram Ki Bhi Roshni Hogi
Magar Mehshar Ke Toofan Aalam O Masaib Ke
Aandhi Ki Wajah Se Bujhte,  Jalte Hongey Lekin
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ka Suraj Us Waqt Joban Par Hoga.

 Paaye Kubaan Pul Se Guzrengey Teri Awaaz Par
  Rabbi Sallim Ki Sada Par Wajd Laate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Paaye Kubaan = Zor Se Paun Zameer Par Maarte
Huwe Pul Sirat Per Guzarna
2) Rabbi Sallim = Aye Allah! Salamati Ke Saath Meri
Ummat Ko Guzaar
3) Wajd = Jhoomna

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyaare Aaqa ﷺ Jab Aap Hum
Gunahgaron Ke Liye Pul Sirat Se Aasani Ke Saath

                     9

Guzarne Ke Kiye Apne Rab Se Dua Karnegey To Aap
Ki Aawaaz Sun Kar Hum Pul Se Zor Zor Se Qadam
Maarte Huwe Pul Se Guzar Jayengey.

 Sarwar E Deen Lijiye Apne Naatwaano Ki Khabar
    Nafs O Shaitaan Sayyada Kab Tak Dabaate
                   Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     1) Sarwar E Deen = Deen Ke Sardar
     2) Naatwaan = Kamzor
     3) Sayyada = Aye Sardar

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mehboob ﷺ Meherbani Farmaye Aur
Humien Nafs O Shaitaan Ke Shar Se Bachaye. Aap Ke
Kamzor Ummati Ko Ye Zaalim Kab Tak Apna
Taabe'dar Bana Kar Hukm Chalate Rahengey.

 Hashr Tak Daalenegey Hum Paidaish E Moula Ki
               Dhoom
   Misl E Faaras Najd Ke Qile' Giraate Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
                     10

1) Paidaish = Huzoor ﷺ Ka Paida Hona
2) Dhoom = Charcha
3) Faaras = Iran

    Mafhoom :-
   Hum Apne Mehboob E Pak ﷺ Ke Milad Ke
Charche Karte Rahengey Aur Ye Silsila Qiyamat Tak
Jaari Rahega. Agar Najdi Ko Pasand Nahi Karta To
Jahannum Me Jaaye. Jaise Huzoor ﷺ Ke Paidaish
Huye Wo Iran Ke Mohallat Me Zalzala Aagaya Usi
Tarah Zikr E Milad Karte Rahengey Aur Najdi Qal'on
Ko Girate Jayengey.

  Khaak Ho jayein A'duu Jal Kar Magar Hum To
                   Raza
  Dam Me Jab Tak Dam Hai Zikr Unka Sunate
                   Jayengey

    Mushkil Alfaz:-
     1) Khaka Hojayien A'duu = Dushman Hasad Ki
Aag Me Jal Kar Rakh Hojaye
     2) Dam Me Jab Tak Dam Hai = Jab Tak Jism Me
Jaan Hai
    Mafhoom :-

                     11

Aye Dushmanan E Zikr E Mustafaﷺ Tum Jal
Kar Rakh Hojao Lekin Hamare Jism Me Jab Tak Jaan
Hai Hum Apne Aaqa ﷺ Ka Zikr Karte Hi Rahengey.


                          (2)
  Chamak Tujhse Paate Hain Sab Paane Waale
   Mera Dil Bhi Chamka De Chamkaane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Chamak = Roshni, Nooraniyat

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ Jo Bhi Zamane Me Chamka
Hai Aap Hi Ke Noor Se Chamka Hai Kyun Ki Asl E
Kaayenat Aur Wajh E Takhleeq E Kaayenath Aap Hi
Hain, To Mere Aaqa ﷺ Mera Dil Bhi Gunaho'n Se
Siyah Ho Chuka Hain Is Par Bhi Noor Ki Ek Kiran
Daalde Taa Ke Ye Bhi Chamak Jaaye.

       Barasta Nahi Dekh Kar Abre Rehmat
    Bado'n Par Bhi Barsaade Barsaane Waale


                     12

Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Barasta = Utarna, Naazil Hona
2) Abre Rehmat = Rehmat Ka Badal
3) Bado'n = Buro'n

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Agarche Hamare Aamaal
Bohat Bure Sahin Shayad Unhe Dekh Kar Hi Rehmat
Ka Badal Hum Par Nahi Barasta To Aye Pyaare Nabi
ﷺ Aap Meherbaani Farmaye Aur Rehmat Ka Badal
Ko Hukm Dein Ke Hum Par Bhi Barse.

     Madine Ki Khitte Khuda Tujhko Rakkhe
     Ghareebo Faqeero'n Ke Tehraane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Khitte = Tukde

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ke Madine! Khuda Ta'ala
Tujhe Salamat Ta Qiyamat Rakhe Ke Hum Jaise
Ghareebo Faqeero'n Ko Tu Apna Thikana Ata Karne
Wala Hain.


                     13

Tu Zinda Hai Wallah Tu Zinda Hai Wallah
  Mere Chashme Aalam Se Chhup Jaane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Wallah = Allah Ki Qasam
2) Chashme Aalam = Zaahiri Nazar

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ ! Allah Ki Qasam Aap Zinda
Hain Aur Hamari Zaahiri Nazar Se Poshida Hain.

   Main Mujrim Hoon Aaqa Mujhe Saath Lelo
    Ki Raaste Me Hain Ja Ba Ja Thaane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Mujrim = Gunhagar
2) Raaste = Raasta
3) Ja Ba Ja = Har Jagah
4) Thaane Waale = Thanvi Ke Maanne Waale, Chowk
Police Waale Yaani Allah Ke Firishtey

    Mafhoom :-
    Main  Mujrim O  Qusoorwaar  Hoon  Aur
Mujrimo'n Ke Peeche Har Waqt Police Waale Lage

                     14

Rehte Hain Usi Tarah Mere Peeche Allah Ke Firishtey
Lage Huwe Hain Mujhe Apni Panah Dijiye.

 Haram Ki Zameen Aur Qadam Rakh Ke Chalna
      Are Sar Ka Mauqa Hai O Jaane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Haram = Makka O Madina
2) Are = Nida Ke Liye Pukarna
3) Mauqa = Jaga

    Mafhoom :-
     Harmain  Shareefain  Ki  Sarzameen To  Itni
Muqaddas Hain Ke Bas Chale To Is Par Qadam Rakh
Kar Chalne Ki Bajaye Sar Ke Bal Chala Jaaye.

   Chal Uth Jabah Farsa Ho Saaqi Ke Dar Per
     Dar E Jood Aye Mere Mastaane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz:-
1) Jabah Farsa = Peshani Ragadne Waala
2) Saaqi = Pilane Waale
3) Jood = Sakhawat


                     15

4) Mastaane Waale = Ishq E Rasool ﷺ Me Mast
Rahne Waale

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ka Ishq Dil Me Rakhne
Waale! Chal Ja Sarkar Ki Bargah Me Dar E Rehmat
Khul Gaya Hai Aur Saaqi E Kausar Ka Faiz Jaari O
Saari Hai, Wahan Ja Kar Maatha Ragad Yaani Saare
Adab Bajaa La. Ya Matlab Ye Hain Ke Allah Ki
Bargah Me Sajda Shukrane Ke Nawafil Ada Kar Kyun
Ke Us Ne Tujhe Dar E Mustafa ﷺ Ki Haazri Se
Nawaza Aur Phir Sarkar Ki Bargha Me Aakar Qadmon
Me Gir Kar Faiz Maanga.

      Tera Khaaye Tere Ghulamo'n Se Uljhe
   Hain Munkir Ajab Khaane Ghurraane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Uljhein = Jhagdna
2) Munkir Ajab = Ajeeb Inkari
3) Ghurrana = Bila Waja Gusse Me Shor Karna

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ! Ye Aap Ki
Azmat Ke Munkireen Bhi Ajeeb Nasl Ke Log Hain Ke

                     16

Aap Ka Sadqa Khaate Hain Aur Aap Ke Hi Ghulamo'n
Se Ulajhte Hain.

      Rahega Yunhi Unka Charcha Rahega
      Pade Khaak Hojaaye Jal Jaane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Charcha = Shor, Dhoom, Zikr
2) Khaak Hojaaye = Mar Jaayien

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Munkiron Tum Sarkar Ka Zikr Sun Kar Jalo
Ya Jal Jal Kar Maro Kyun Ke Huzoor ﷺ Ki Azmat
Ke Danke Bajte Hi Rahengey.

      Ab Aayi Shafa'at Ki Saa'at Ab Aayi
     Zara Chain Le Mere Ghabraane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Saa'at = Ghadi, Waqt
2) Chain = Aaram
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Dil! Kyun Ghabraate Ho
Abhi Tumhari Shafa'at Ki Baari Ab Aane Hi Waali
Hai.
                     17

Raza Nafs Dushman Hai Dam Me Na Aana
  Kahan Tumne Dekhe Hain Chandraane Waale

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
1) Dam Me = Dhoke Me
2) Chandraane Waale = Jhutlana

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Ahmed Raza! Nafs Ke Dhoke Aur Fareb Me
Na Aana Tu Ne Abhi Behkane Waale Aur Phislaane

Adyan Ko Mansookh Kardiya Ab Naja'at Isi Deen Me
Hai.

   Jin Ke Talwo'n Ka Dhowan Hai Aab E Hayaat
      Hai Wo Jaan E Maseeha Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dhowan = Istemal Kiya Huwa Paani
Aab E Hayaat = Hayat Baksh Paani
Jaan E Maseeha = Isa Alaihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan

    Mafhoom :-
     Sarkar ﷺ Ke Qadam Mubarak Se Ba Waqt E
Wuzoo Girne Waala Paani Aisa Hai Ke Jis Se Ahle
Emaan Ko Hayaat E Jaavedaani Naseeb Hoti Hai. Is
Liye Huzoor ﷺ Isa Alihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan Hai.

      Arsh O Kursi Ko Thi Aaina Bandiyaan
       Suye Haq Jab Sudhara Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aaina Bandiyaan = Rang Range Sheesho'n Se Makaan
Ko Aarasta Karna
Sudhara = Rawana Huwa
                     73

Mafhoom  :- Jab Nabi E Akram ﷺ Shab E
Meraj Ke Dulha Bane To Aap Ki Izzat Afzaai Ke Liye
Allah Ta'ala Ne Arsh O Kursi Ko Bhi Khoob Sajaya
Hain.

        Khalq Se Auliya Auliya Se Rusul
       Aur Rasoolo'n Se Aala Hamara Nabi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khalq = Makhlooq
Auliya = Allah Ke Pyaare
Rusul = Ambiya E Kiram

    Mafhoom  :- Tamam Makhlooq Me Se Insan
Afzal O Aala Aur Insaano Se Auliya E Kiram Afzal
Hai Aur Auliya Se Rasool O Mursaleen Afzal Aur Sab
Rasoolo'n Se Aala Hamare Nabi ﷺ Hai.

      Husn Khata Jis Ke Namak Ki Qasam
      Wo Maleeh E Dil Aara Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Maleeh = Namkeen ( Jisko Dekhne Se Sairabi Na Ho)

                     74

Mafhoom  :- Husn E Mustafa ﷺ Se  Aisi
Namkeen O Malahat Hai Ke Khud Husn Bhi Us
Malahat Ki Qasmien Khata Hai Aur Wo Malahat
Waala Pyaara, Aankho Ka Taara, Hamara Nabi Hai.

     Zikr Sab Pheeke Jab Tak Na Mazkoor Ho
      Namkeen Husn Waala Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Pheeke = Be Mazaa
Mazkoor = Jiska Zikr Kiya Jaaye

    Mafhoom :- Jis Tarah Khaana Baghiar Namak
Ke Pheeka Aur Be Maza Isi Tarah Agar Khuda Ka Zikr
Kar Liya Jaaye Aur Mehboob e Khuda Ka Zikr Na
Kiya Jaaye To Saare Zikr Pheeke Rehte Hain.

      Jis Ke Do Boond Hai Kausar O Salsabeel
     Hai Wo Rehmat Ka Darya Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Boond = Qatre
Kausar = Jannat Ki Nehr Houz E Kausar
Salsabeel = Jannat Ka Ek Chashma
                     75

Mafhoom :-
    Hous e Kausar Jisse Saari Kaainat Paani Piyegi
Magar Uske Paani Me Kami Na Aayegi. Isi Tarah
Salsabeel Bhi Jannat Ka Bohat Bada Chashma Hai
Lekin Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ka Dhaate Maarta
Huwa Samundar Itna Wasee' Hai Ke Ye Kausar O
Salsabeel Uske Do Qatre Hain.

       Jaise Sab Ka Khuda Ek Hai Waise Hi
         Inka Unka Tumhara Hamara Nabi

    Mafhoom :-
      Jis Tarah Allah Ta'ala Khuda Hone Me Tanha
Hai, Allah Ka Mehboob Rasool Hone Me   Saari
Khudaayi Me, Wo Khuda Hone Me Be Misaal Ye
Mustafa Hone Me Be Misaal, Wo Sab Ka Khuda Hai
Aur Ye Sabke Nabi Hai.

      Qarno Badli Rasoolo'n Ki Hoti Rahi
       Chaand Badli Ka Nikla Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Qarno = Zamane
Badli = Badalna
                     76

Mafhoom :- Hazrath E Adam Alaihissalam Se
Lekar Hazrth E Isa Tak Nabi Aate Rahe Jaate Rahe Koi
Kisi Zamane Ka Nabi, Koi Kisi Alaqe Aur Khitte Ka
Nabi Lekin Jab Hamare Nabi Ka Aaftab Buland Huwa
To Ta Qiyamat Kisi Nabi Ki Zaroorat Hi Baaqi Na
Rahi.

    Kon Deta Hain Dene Ko Munh Chahiye
      Dene Waala Hai Saccha Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dene Ko = Ata Karne Ko

    Mafhoom :- Huzoor ﷺ Ke Siwa Kon Hai Jo
Har Suwali Ki Chahat Se Zyada Ata Kare Kisi Ko
Emaan De Kisi Ko Hidayat De Aur Bhi Mazeed To Ye
Sab Kuch Dene Waala Allah Ka Mehboob Hi Hai Jo
Sab Ki Hajaatien Poori Farma Raha Hain.

    Kya Khabar Kitne Taare Khile Chup Gaye
      Par Na Doobe Na Dooba Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khile = Chamke
Chup Gaye = Ghuroob Huwe

                     77

Mafhoom  :- Kisi Ko Kya Maloom Ke Kitne
Ambiya E Kiram Aasman E Nabuwwat Pe Sitaaron Ki
Tarah Apne Apne Daur Me Chamke Aur Jab Unki
Muddat Khatam Huyi To Chup Gaye Lekin Jab
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Baari Aayi To Aap Aise Chamke
Ke Kabi Doobne Ka Sawal Hi Paida Nahi Ho Sakta.

      Mulk E Kounain Me Ambiya Taajdar
        Taajdaaro'n Ka Aaqa Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kounain = Dono Jahaan
Tajdaar = Baadshah
    Mafhoom :- Ambiya E Kiram Dono Jahaano'n
Ke Baadshah Hai Aur Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ka Martaba
Ye Hai Ke Aap Un Baadshaho'n Ke Bhi Baadshah Hai.

    La Makaan Tak Ujala Hai Jiska Wo Hai
      Har Makaan Ka Ujala Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
La Makaan = Jis Par Jagha Ya Makaan Ka Itlaq Na Ho
Sake
Ujala = Roshni

                     78

Mafhoom :- Chaand Suraj Ki Roshni To Phir
Bhi Mehdood Hai Lekin Mah E Taiba Ki Nooraniyat
Ka Aalam Ye Hai Ke Unke Wajood E Bawajood Se
Farishtey Bhi Chamke Arsh Bhi Chamka, Zameen Bhi
Chamki, Aasmaan Bhi Chamka, Makaan Bhi Chamke
La Makana Bhi Chamke.

      Saare Accho'n Me Accha Samjhiye Jise
      Hai Us Acche Se Accha Hamara Nabi

    Mafhoom :-
     Duniya Me Jitne Behtreen Aur Acche Log Hain
Aap Un Sab Se Behtreen Aur Acche Hain.

    Saare Ooncho'n Me Ooncha Samjhiye Jise
     Hai Us Oonche Se Ooncha Hamara Nabi

    Mafhoom :- Dono Jahaan Me Jis Ko Bhi Tum
Ooncha Aur Buland Shan Waala Kahogey Mere Aaqa
ﷺ To Us Se Bhi Buland Hai.

       Ambiya Se Karun Arz Kyun Maaliko
       Kya Nabi Hai Tumhara Hamara Nabi

                     79

Mafhoom :-
     Qiyamat Ke Din Jab Tamam Ambiya E Kiram
Jalwa Farma Hongey Aur Hum Bhi Hongey Aur Har
Kisi Ka Ummati Keh Raha Hoga Ke Hum Inke
Ummati Unke Ummati Hain Lekin Hum Keh Rahe
Hongey Hum Nabi Ul Ambiya Ke Ummati Hai Aur
Agar Mujhe Ijazat Mile Gi To Mai Tamam Ambiya Ke
Paas Ja Kar Arz Karunga Ke Kya Hamara Nabi Jo Hai
Wo Tumhara Bhi Nabi Hai?

        Jisne Tukde Kiye Qamar Ke Wo Hai
     Noor E Wahdat Ka Tukda Hamara Nabi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Qamar = Chaand
Noor E Wahdat Ka Tukda = Allah Ke Noor Ka Jalwa
    Mafhoom :-
      Sirf Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Hi To Hai Jin Hone
Chaand Ke Do Tukde Kiye Hain Aur Haan Hamara
Nabi Allah Ke Noor Ka Jalwa Aur Aks Bhi Hain.

   Sab Chamak Waale Ujlo'n Me Chamka Kiye
    Andhe Sheesho'n Me Chamka Hamara Nabi

                     80

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ujlo'n = Roshan
Andhe Sheeshe = Kaale

    Mafhoom :-
    Ambiya E Kiram Padhe Likhe Mazhab, Nek
Logo'n Me Tahsreef Laate Rahe Lekin Hamare Nabi
Alaihissalam Jin Logon Me Mab'oos Huye Wo Kufr O
Shirk, Jihalat Waale Logon Me Hamare Nabi Andhe
Sheesho'n Me Aisa Chamke Ke Un Ko Bhi Chamka
Ke Rakh Diya.

      Jisne Murda Dilo'n Ko Di Umr E Abad
      Hai Wo Jaan E Maseeha Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Umr E Abad = Hamesha Ki Zindagi

    Mafhoom :-
    Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ne To Aisa Tauheed Ka
Naghma Alaapa Ke Jo Murda Dil The Unko Hamesha
Ki Zindagi Mil Gayi.  Isliye Aap Hazrath E  Isa
Alaihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan Hai.


                     81

Ghamzado'n Ko Raza Muzdah Dijiye Ke Hain
        Bekaso'n Ka Sahara Hamara Nabi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
    Muzdah = Khushkhabri

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Raza! Ghamgheen Dil Waale, Jo Apne Bure
Aamal Par Ghamgheen Hai Aur Bekas O Majboor Hai
Unko Khushkhabri  Dijiye Ke Hamare Aaqa ﷺ
Bekason Ke Sahara Hai Duniya o Aakhirtah Me To Na
Ghabraaye.





                     82

(10)
 Sunte Hain Ki Mehshar Me Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain
  Gar Unki Rasaai Hai Lo Jab To Ban Aayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Rasaai = Pahunch, Guzar
Lo = Baraye Ummed, Haan
Ban Aayi = Kaam Hogaya

    Mafhoom :- Aye Gunahgar Ye Pata Chala Hai
Ke Mehshar Me Sirf  Huzoor ﷺ Hi Ki Allah Ki
Bargah Tak Pahunch Hai. Accha Agar Huzoor Hi Ki
Rasaai Hai To Kaam Bilkul Aasan Ho Gaga Hai Ke
Huzoor To Phir Apne Hi Hain.


  Machla Hai Ke Rehmat Ne Ummed Bandhaayi
                   Hain
  Kya Baat Teri Mujrim Kya Baat Ban Aayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Machla Hai = Zid Kar Baitha
Ummed Bandhana = Kaam Hojane Ki Tasalli Dena
    Mafhoom :-Aye Mujrim Tu Is Liye Zid Kar
Baitha Hai Na Ke Unki Rehmat Kisi Ko Mayoos Nahi

                     83

Karti Tere Muqaddar Pe Qurbaan Aye Gunahgar Tu
Ne Bhi Khoob Taweelain Karke Uzr Aur Bahaane
Banaaye Hai Ke Aisi Baat Ban Aayi Hai Ke Tere
Gunah Nekiyon Me Tabdeel Hogye Aur Tu Haari
Baazi Jeet Gaya.

  Sab Ne Saf E Mehshar Me Lalkaar Diya Humko
   Aye Bekaso'n Ke Aaqa Ab Teri Duhaayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Lalkaar = Jhidak Diya
Be Kas = Majboor

    Mafhoom :-
    Tamam Ambiya E Kiram Ne To Maidan E
Mehshar Ki Saf Se Humien Jhidak Kar Nikal Diya Ke
Jao! Hum Tumhari Shafa'at Nahi Kar Sakte! ( Tum
Itne Bade Mujrim Ho Ke Hamari Shafa'at Se Tumhara
Kaam Na Banega) Aye Majbooro'n Ke Aaqa Ab Aap
Hi Ki Bargah Me Faryaad Hai.

 Yoon To Sab Unhi Ka Hai Par Dil Ki Agar Poocho
 Ye Toote Huwe Dil Hi Khaas Unki Kamaayi Hain


                     84

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kamaayi = Aamdani

    Mafhoom :-
     Waise To Har Shay'i Sarkar ﷺ Ke Liye Hai
Kyun Ke Unhi Ke Sadqe Se Har Ne'mat Mili Hai
Magar Hamara Toota Huwa Dil Khaas Unhi Ki
Mohabbat Ke Liye Hai, Is Me Koi Aur Sama Nahi
Sakta Ya Matlab Uski Unki Bargah Me Bohat Zyada
Ahmiyat Hain.


Zaair Bhi Gaye Kab Ke Din Dhalne Pe Hain Pyaare
   Uth Mere Akele Chal Kya Der Lagaayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zaair = Ziyarath Karne Wala
Din Dhalne Pe = Suraj Ghuroob Hone Ke Qareeb

    Mafhoom :- Madina Shareef Ki Ziyarth Karne
Waale To Kab Ke Ja Chuke Hain Aur Aye Ahmed
Raza Tu Abhi Aaram Se Baitha Huwa Hai Zindagi Ka
Suraj Ghuroob Hone Ke Qareeb Hai, Uth Der Na Laga
Aur Agar Koi Saath Nahi Bhi To Akela Hi Sooye
Madina Rawana Ho Ja.

                     85

Bazaar E Amal Me To Sauda Na Bana Apna
   Sarkar Karam Tujh Me A'ibi Ki Samaayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sauda = Qeemat, Hisaab Kitaab
A'ibi = Gunahgar
Samaayi = Wus'at, Gunjaish

    Mafhoom :-Aye Hamare Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Amal
Ke Lihaaz Se To Hum Bilkul Nikamme Hai, Koi Neki
Hai Na Koi Tayyari, Aye Aaqa Karam Farmaye Agar
Aap Hum Jaise Aib Daaro'n Ko na Sambhaalengey To
Kaun Sambhalega Aap Ke Daaman E Karam Me To
Mujh Jaise Karodo'n Sama Sakte Hain.

  Girte Huwo'n Ko Muzdah Sajda Me Gire Maula
  Ro Ro Ke Shafa'at Ki Tamheed Uthaayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Muzdah = Khushkhabri
Tamheed = God
    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Gunahgaaro'n Mubarak Ho Aaqa Ne Sajde
Me Sar E Anwar Rakh Kar Baab E Shafa'at Khol Diya
                     86

Hai Aur Dekho Ro Ro Kar Zulfien Bhikar Kar Allah
Ki Hamd Aise Pyare Andaaz Me Shuru Ki Hai.

  Aye Dil Ye Sulagna Kya Jalna Hai Jal Bhi Uth
  Dam Ghutne Laga Zaalim Kya Dhooni Ramaayi
                   Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sulagna = Andar Hi Andar Jalte Rehna
Dhooni Ramaayi Hai = Dhooni Li Huyi Hai

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Dil Teri Ye Aadat Mujhe Hargiz Pasand
Nahi Hai Jo Tu Andar Hi Andar Sulagta Hai Agar
Tujhe Jalna Hai To Jal Kar Raakh Ho Jata, Ye Kya
Aahista Aahista Dhuwaan Nikalta Rehta Hai Jis Se
Dam Ghootne Lagta Hai.

 Mujrim Ko Na Sharmao Ahbaab Kafan Dhak Do
Munh Dekh Ke Kya Hoga Parde Me Bhalaayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
    Ahbaab = Dost
    Dhak Do = Band Karo

                     87

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Dosto'n Baar Baar Marne Ke Baad Mere
Chehre Ko Khol Kar Kya Dekhte Ho? Main Mujrim
Hoon Mujhe Kyun Sharminda Karte Ho, Kafan Se
Mera Chehra Daanp Do Ye Mujrim Is Qaabil

sections.title: Nahi

blocks.text:
Nahi Ke
Baar Baar Us Ka Munh Dekha Jaaye, Iski Bhalaayi Isi
Me Hai Ke Parde Me Rehne Do.

 Ab Aap Hi Sambhaale To Kaam Apne Sambhaal
                    Jaaye
  Hum Ne To Kamaayi Sab Khelo'n Me Gawaayi
                   Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kamaayi = Aamdani, Mehnat
Ganwaayi = Zaaya Kiya

    Mafhoom :- Aye Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Ab Aap Hi
Karam Farmaye To Hamari Baat Banjayegi Warna
Hum To Apna Masla Kharaab Kar Baithe Aur Jo Bhi
Waqt Tha Wo Khel Tamasho'n Me Ganwa Baithe.

    Aye Ishq Tere Sadqe Jalne Se Chute Saste
    Jo Aag Bujha Degi Wo Aag Lagaayi Hain

                     88

Mushkil Alfaz :-
     Chute = Aazaad Ho

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Ishq E Mustafa ﷺ Main Tujh Pe Qurbaan
Jaaun Tu Ne Hamare Dil Me Jo Firaq O Gham E
Mustafa ﷺ Ki Aag Lagaayi Hain Is Ka Fayeda Ye
Huwa Ke Jahannum Ki Aag Se Chutkara Mil Gaya
Hai.

   Hirs O Hawas Bad Se Dil Tu Bhi Sitam Karle
   Tu Hi Nahi Begana Duniya Hi Paraayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Hirs O Hawas = Lalach
Bad = Bura

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Dil Bure Lalach Ke Saath Jitna Zulm Kar
Sakta Hai Karle Kyun Ke Begana Aur Janbi To Saara
Zamana Hai Sirf Tu Hi To Nahi Ya Matlab Bhi Ho
Sakta Hai Ke Jab Mai Saari Duniya Ka Zulm Sah Raha
Hoon To Ek Tera Bhi Sah Lunga.


                     89

Hum Dil Jale Hain Kis Ke Hat Fitnoo Ke Parkale
  Kyun Phoonk Doon Ik Uff Se Kya Aag Lagaayi
                   Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Hat = Door Ho
Parkale = Chingaare
Phoonk Doon = Bujha Dun

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mukhalif Hum Dil Jale Aashiq Hai To Hai
Lekin Tu Jaanta Bhi Hai Ke Kis Ke Apne Mehboob Ke
Tu Peeche Hat Ja Fitno Ki Chingaari Mai Tujhe Ik
Phoonk Se Jala Kar Raakh Kardunga.

   Taiba Na Sahi Afzal Makkah Hi Bada Zaahid
Hum Ishq Ke Bande Hain Kyun Baat Badaayi Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Taiba = Madina
Zaahid = Aye Ibaadat Guzar

    Mafhoom :- Aye Ibaadya Guzar! Hum Se Na
Jhagad Ke Makka Afzal Hai Ya Madina Afzal? Chal

                     90

Teri Hi Maan Leta Hoon Makka Hi Afzal Sahi!
Madina Na Sahi Lekin Hum Ishq Waale Hain Hum Se
Na Jhagad Ke Makka Ko Banane Waale Hazrath
Ibrahim Alaihissalam Aur Madina Banane Waale
Unke Bhi Aaqa Hai.

   Matla' Me Ye Shak Tha Wallah Raza Wallah
    Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain Sirf Unki Rasaai Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Matla' = Pehla Shair
Wallah = Allah Ki Qasam

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Raza Jo Tu Ne Pehle Shair Me Kaha Hai
Isme Koi Shak Hi Nahi Hai Kyun Ke Allah Ki Qasam
Baroz E Qiyamat Sirf Unki Hi Rasaayi Hai.





                     91

(11)
 Rukh Din Hai Ya Mehr E Sama Ye Bhi Nahi Wo
                  Bhi Nahi
 Shab Zulf Ya Mushk E Khuta Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Rukh = Chehra
Mehr E Sama = Aasmaan Ka Suraj
Shab = Raat
Mushk E Khuta = Khaalis Kastoori

    Mafhoom :-
    Main Apne Pyare Nabi Ke Chehre Ko Din Kahun
Ya Aasman Ka Suraj Lekin Suraj Ko Bhi Roshni To
Mehboob e Khuda Ke Rukh E Waddhuha Se Mili Hai
Aur Din Ka Ujala Bhi Aaqa ﷺ Ke Husn Ka Jalwa Hai
Lihaza Ye Din Huzoor ﷺ Ke Chehre Jaisa Ho Sakta
Hai Na Suraj Aur Sarkar ﷺ Ke Zulf Mubarak Ko Raat
Kaha Jaaye Ya Kastoori Jo Nihayat Khushbudar Hoti
Hai Lekin Ye Bhi Mera Khayal Ghalat Hai Kyun Ke
Raat Ki Tareeki Aur Kastoori Ki Khushbu Huzoor ﷺ
Ke Zulfon Ka Faiz Hai Aur Faiz Lene Waale Dene
Waale Ek Jaise Nahi Ho Sakte.

                     92

Mumkin Me Ye Qudrat Kaha Wajib Me A'bdiyyat
                  Kaha
 Hairaan Hoon Ye Bhi Hai Khata Ye Bhi Nahi Wo
                  Bhi Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaaz :-
Mumkin = Jis Ka Hona Na Hona Barabar Ho
Qudrat = Taqat
Wajib = Jiska Hona Zaroori Ho Aur Na Hona Mahaal
A'bdiyyat = Bandagi
Khata = Bhool
    Mafhoom  :- Hamare Aaqa O Moula ﷺ Itni
Qudrato'n Ke Malik Hai ( Maslan Chand Ko Tukde
Karna, Doobe Suraj Ko Pherna Waghaira) Ke Mumkin
Ul Wujood ( Makhlooq) Me Ya Taqatien Kahan? Aur
Aap Ko Wajib Ul Wajood Yaani Khud Khuda Manna
Ye Bhi Jaiz Nahi Kyun Ke Aap To Khuda Ke Rasool
O Nabi Hai Aur Allah Taala Kisi Ki Ibaadat Bandagi
Se Pak Hai To Phir Mai Hairaan Hoon Ke Aap Ko Kya
Kaha Jaaye.

 Haq Ye Ke Hai A'bde Ila Aur Aalam E Imkaan Ke
                  Shah
 Barzakh Hai Wo Sirre Khuda Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi
                     93

Mushkil Alfaz :-
A'bde Ila = Allah Ke Bande
Aalam E Imkaan = Makhlooq
Shah = Shah
Barzakh = Parda
Sirr = Raaz

    Mafhoom :- Sacchi Baat To Ye Hain Ke Aap ﷺ
Khuda Ke Banda E Khaas Hai Aur Khudaayi Ke
Badshah Hai Aur Allah Aur Uske Makhlooq Ke
Darmiyaan Parda O Rabta Hone Ke Saath Saath Alllah
Ta'ala Ka Khusoosi Raaz Hain.

 Bulbul Ne Gul Unko Kahan Qumree Ne Se Sarwe
                 Jaan Fiza
 Hairat Ne Jhunjhlakar Kaha Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     Gul = Phool
    Qumree = Safed Parinda
    Sarw = Khubsoorat Darakht
     Jaan Fiza = Rooh Ko Taazgi Dene Wala
     Hairat = Ta'jjub
     Jhunjhala Kar = Ghusse Me Aa Kar

                     94

Mafhoom :-
    Madine  Ke   Tajdaar  Aur  Ummat  Ke
Ghamkhwaar Ko Bulbul Ne Dekha To Phool Kah
Diya, Qumree Ne Dekha To Apna Mehboob ( Sarwe
Jaan Fiza) Kah Diya. Hairat Ne Dono Ko Daant Kar
Kaha Khabardaar Jo Mehboob E Khuda Ko Phool
Kaha To, Tum Sab Mehboob Ke Qadmon Pe Qurban
Ho Jao Ke Wo To Wajah E Takhliq E Kainaat Hain.

 Khursheed Tha Kis Zor Par Kya Bad Ke Chamka
               Tha Qamar
Be Parda Jab Wo Rukh Huwa Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khursheed = Suraj
Qamar = Chaand

    Mafhoom :-
     Suraj Apni Poori Aab O Taab Ke Saath Tulu'
Huwa Aur Saare Jahan Ko Roshan Kar Diya, Chaand
Apni Tamam Tar Jalwo Saamaniyo Ke Saath Chamka
Aur Saari Duniya Ko Baqiya Noor Bana Diya Magar
Jab Rukh E Waddhuha Se Niqaab Utha To Chaand Ki
Chamak  Rahi Na  Suraj Ke Dhamak, Dono Ne
                     95

Sharminda Ho Kar Munh Chupa Liya Aur Mehboob
Ke Husn O Jamal Ke Aage Apna Sar E Tasleem Kham
Kar Liya.

  Dar Tha Ke I'siyaan Ki Saza Ab Hogi Ya Roz E
                     Jaza
  Dee Unki Rehmat Ne Sada Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
I'siyaan = Gunah
Roz E Jaza = Qiyamat
Sada = Awaaz

    Mafhoom :- Bohat Dar Tha Ke Is Qadar Gunah
Jama' Hogaye Hain Un Gunaho'n Ki Saza Khuda Jaane
Is Duniya Me Milegi Ya Qiyamat Ke Din, Allah Ta'ala
Ki Rehmat ( Hamare Aaqa ﷺ)Ko Hamari Pareshaani
Ganwara Na Huwi Aur Aap Ne Alal E'laan Farmaya,
Ghabrao Nahi Na Yahan Saza Hogi Na Wahan Hogi.

 Koi Hai Nazaan Zohd Par Ya Husn E Tauba Hai
                      Sipar
Yaan Hai Faqat Teri Ata Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi Nahi

                     96

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Naazan = Naaz Karna
Zohd = Parehzgaari
Husn = Umdagi
Sipar = Dhaal
Yaan = Yahan
Ata = Bakhshish

    Mafhoom :-
     Koi Apni Parehzgaari Par Naaz Kar Raha Hai To
Kisi Ke Liye Us Ki Tauba Dhaal Ban Gayi Hai, Aye
Mere Aaqa! Mere Palle Me Na To Ibaadat Hai Na Hi
Mujhe Apni Tauba Par Bharosa Hai. Bas Mai To Aap
Ki Rehmat O Sahara Par Baitha Huwa Hoon.

  Din Lahv Me Khona Tujhe Shab Zulf Tak Sona
                    Tujhe
Sharm E Nabi Khauf E Khuda Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Lahv = Khel Koodh
Khona = Zaaye Karna
Sharm = Haya

                     97

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Ghafil Musalman Tere Din Khel Koodh Me
Guzar Jaate Hain, To Raatien Yaad E Ilahi Se Ghaflat
Me Guzar Deta Hai, Na Tujhe Khuaf E Khuda Hai Na
Sharm E Nabi Hain.

 Rizq E Khuda Khaaya Kiye Farman E Haq Taala
                      Kiye
  Shukr E Khuda Tarse Saza Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
    Farman = Hukm
     Tala = Taalna
     Tars = Dar

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Banda E Khuda! Tu Khuda Ta'ala Ka Diya
Huwa Rizq Bhi Khata Hai Us Ke Ba Wajood Us Ke
Ahkamat Pe Amal Kar Ke Us Ke Ne'maton Ka Shukr
Ada Karne Ke Bajaye Heele Bahane Karke Uske
Ahkamat Se Jaan Chudaraha Hai. Na Tere Andar Us
Ki Ne'maton Ka Shukr Karne Ka Jazba Paida Ho Raha
Hai Na Hi Tujhe Uske Azaab Ka Dar Hai.

                     98

Hai Bulbul E Rangeen Raza Ya Tuti'e Naghma
                    Sara
  Haq Ye Ke Wasif Hai Tera Ye Bhi Nahi Wo Bhi
                   Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     Rangeen = Rangdaar
    Naghma Sara = Gaane Waali
     Wasif = Tareef Karne Wala

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ke Dar Ka Gada
Ahmed Raza Apne Aap Ko Bulbul Rangeen Mizaaj
Kahe Jo Har Waqt Aap Ki Naat Me Mast Rehta Hai
Ya Jo Aap Ki Shaan Me Har Waqt Bolta Rehta Hai
Magar Ye Dono Me Se Kuch Bhi Nahi Hoon, Mai To
Bas Aap Ka Adna Sana Khwaan Hoo Aur Ye
SanKhaaani Agar Qubool Ho To Ye Sharaf Hai.





                     99

(12)
 Wo Kamaal E Husn E Huzoor Hai Ke Gumaan E
             Naqs Jahaan Nahi
  Yahi Phool Khaar Se Door Hai Yahi Shama’ Hai
             Ke

sections.title: Dhuwaan Nahi

blocks.text:
Dhuwaan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Naqs = A’ib, Kami
Khaar = Kaanta

    Mafhoom  :-
    Aaqa E Do Jahaan ﷺ Ko Allah Ta’ala Ne
Kamaal Ka Husn Ata Farmaya Hai Ke Aap ﷺ Ke
Husn Me Aib To Kya Aib Ka Gumaan Bhi Nahi
Hosakta  , Duniya Ka Konsa Phool Hai Jiske Saath
Kaanta Nahi Magar Madine Ka Phool Har Kaante Se
Mehfooz Hai Aur Har Tarah Ka Kaanta Aapﷺ Se
Door Hai Aur Har Shama’ Ke Saath Dhuwaan Ka
Hona Laazim Hai Lekin Aap ﷺ  Aise Shama’e
Risalat Hai Ke Jahaan Dhuwein Ka Naam O Nishaan
Tak Nahi….


                    100

Do Jahaan Ki Behtariyaan Nahi Ke Amaniye Dil o
                 Jaan Nahi
    Kaho Kya Hai Wo Jo Yahaan Nahi Magar Ik
           Nahin Ki Wo Haan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Amani = Aaram,Sukoon

    Mafhoom  :- Dono Jahaano’n Ki Bhalaaiyaan
,Duniya O Aakhirath Ka Aaram O Sukoon,Dil O Jaan
Ki Poori Tamannao’n Ka Poora Hona,Bhala Batao To
Sahi Koi Ne’mat Hai Jo Sarkarﷺ Ke Qadmo’n Me
Nahi Milti Haan Magar Ek Shayi’ Hai Ke Jo Yahaan
Nahi Aur Wo Ye Ke Kisi Ko Aapﷺ Ne Kabhi Bhi
‘Nahi’ Na Farmaya Ke Kisi Ne Kuch Maanga Ho Aur
Aap ﷺNe Farmaya Ke Mere Paas Nahi Hain….

  Main Nisaar Tere Kalam Par Mili Yun To Kisko
               Zubaan Nahi
  Wo Sukhan Hain Jis Mein Sukhan Na Ho Wo
        Bayaan Hai Jiska Bayaan Nahi
    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Nisaar = Qurban

                    101

Sukhan 1 = Baat,Kalam
Sukhan 2 = A’eteraz

    Mafhoom  :- Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Duniya
Me Zabaan Daani Aur Qaadir Ul Kalami To Bohat
Saare Logon Ko Mila Hai Lekin Mai Aap ﷺ Ke
Kalam Par Kyu Na Qurbaan Hojaun Kyun Ki Aap ﷺ
Ki Har Baat Hi Be Misaal La Jawaab Hai Aur Ba
Kamal Bhi,Jahaan Aap ﷺ Bol Gaye Wahaan Bade
Bado’n Ne Sar E Tasleem Kham Karliya Aur Kisi Ko
A’eteraz Karne Ki Gunjaish Na Rahi Aur Aap ﷺ Ka
Bayan Aisa Bayaan Hai Ke Koi Us Ko Bayan Hi Na
Kar Saka….

 Bakhuda Khuda Ka Yahi Hai Dar Nahin Aur Koi
               Mafar Maqar
    Jo Wahaan Se Ho Yahin Aake Ho Jo Yahaan
            Nahi To Wahaan Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bakhuda = Khuda Ki Qasam
Mafar = Bhaagne Ki Jagah
Maqar = Panah Ki Jagah
    Mafhoom :- Qasam Allah Ki Baat Bohat Pakki
Hain Ke Khuda Ka Darwaza Wohi Hain Jo Mustafa Ka

                    102

Darwaza Hai Huzoor ﷺ Ki Bargah Ke Ilawa Na
Kahin Aman O Qaraar Naseeb Ho Sakta Hai.Aur Na
Hi Aapﷺ Ke Bargah Ke Ilawa Kahi Jaaye Panah Hai
Allah Ta’ala Ka Har Hukm ,Ne’mat Pehle Huzoorﷺ
Ke Paas Aati Hai Phir Huzoor ﷺUs Ko Makhlooq Me
Taqseem Karte Hain.Agar Kisi Ko Huzoor ﷺ Ki
Bargah Se Kuch Nahi Mila To Samajh Le Uske Liye
Khuda Ki Bargah Me Bhi Kuch Bhi Nahi….

 Kare Mustafa Ki Ihaanatien Khule Band Us Pe Ye
                     Jurra’tien
    Ke Main Kya Nahi Hoon Muhammadi ? Are
        Haan Nahin Arey Haan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ihaanatien = Gustakhiyaan
Khule Band = Alal E’laan, Khule Aam
Jurra’tien = Bahaadurian

    Mafhoom  :- Ye Ajeeb Musalmani Hain Ke
Huzoor Nabi E Kareem ﷺ Jin Ki Mohabbat A’in
Emaan Hai Balke Imaan Ki Jaan Hai Unki Shaan Me
Gustakhiyaan Bhi Bakte Hain Aur Phir Kehte Hain Ki

                    103

Kya Ham Muhammadi Nahi ? To Sun Lo ! Haan Tu
Na Muhammadi Hai Na Musalman Hai.

  Tere Aage Yoon Hai Dabe Lachey Fusahaa Arab
              Ke Bade Bade
   Koi Jaane Munh Me Zubaan Nahi , Nahi Balke
              Jism Me Jaan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dabe Lache = Sharmaaye,Dare Huwe
Fusahaa = Acchi Aur Umda Baat Karne Waala

    Mafhoom :-
    Bade Bade Zabaan Daraaz Khutaba,Faseeh O
Baleegh Jin Per Khutbaat O Shayari Bhi Naaz Karti
Hai.Mere Aaqa ﷺKi Bargah Me Haazir Hote Hain To
Zabaanien Band Hojaati Goya Aisa Lagta Hai Munh
Me Zabaan Hi Nahi ,Balke Yun Lagta Hai Jism Me
Jaan Bhi Nahi Hai.

 Wo Sharaf Ke Qat’a Hai Nisbatien Wo Karam Ke
             Sab Se Qareeb Hain
  Koi Keh Do Yaas O Ummed Se Wo Kaheen Nahin
          Wo Kahaan Nahi
                    104

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sharaf = Buzurgi
Qat’a = Kaatna
Nisbatien = Ta’lluqat
Yaas = Na Umeed

    Mafhoom :-
     Apni Azmat O Shaan Ke Aetebar Se Huzoor ﷺ
Se Kya Nisbat Ho Sakti Hai Ye To Aapﷺ Ka Karam
Hai Ke Wo Imaan Waalon Ki Jaano’n Se Bhi Zyada
Qareeb Hai Lihaza Mayooso’n Se Kaho Ke Aaqa
ﷺKa Daaman E Rehmat Me Tumhare Liye Koi Jaga
Nahi Kyun Ke Wo Sarapa Rehmat Hai . Aur Jo Aap
ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ke Ummedwaar Hai Un Se Kaho!Ke
Unka Karam Kisi Ko Mehroom Nahi Karega.Apni
Ummed Unse Waabsta Rakho Ke Aap ﷺAllah Ki
Rehmat Hai Aur Allah Ne Rehmat Se Na Ummed Na
Hone Ka Hukm Diya Hai.

  Yeh Nahin Ke Khuld Na Ho Neko Wo Nekoi Ki
              Bhee Hay Abroo
  Magar Aye Madina Ki Aarzoo Jise Chahe To Wo
              Samaan Nahi


                    105

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khuld = Jannat
Neko,Nekoi = Bhalayi,Behtari
Aabroo = Izzat
Samaan = Barabar

    Mafhoom :-
    Mai Is Baat Se Inkaar Nahi Karta Ke Jannat
Khubsoorat Nahi.Balke Mai To Ye Keh Raha Hoon Ke
Jannat Ka Husn Bhi Us Dar Ki Khairat Hai Lekin Aye
Aarzo E Madina Jis Seene Me Tu Basi Jaaye Uska
Maqam Kya Hoga Ye Khud Jannat Se Hi Poochlo
Bhala Jannat Us Seene Ki Barabari Kaise Kar Sakti
Hai Jis Seene Ko Madine Ki Aarzoo Ne Madina Bana
Diya.

  Hay Unhi Ke Noor Se Sab A’yaan Hai Unhi Ke
             Jalwa Me Sab Nihaan
   Bane Subhe Taabisg Mehr Se Rahe Pesh Mehr
               Ye Jaan Hain
    Mushkil Alfaz :-
A’yaan = Zaahir
Jalwa = Chamak
Nihaan = Posheeda
Taabish = Suraj Ki Roshni
                    106

Pesh = Saamne
Jaan = Taqat,Taab

    Mafhoom :-
    Hamare Aaqaﷺ Ke Noor Se Hi Har Shay'i Ka
Zahoor Huwa Aur Aapﷺ Hi ke Noor Ke Saamne Har
Shayi Parde Me Chali Jaati Hai Jaise Subh Sadiq Ki
Roshni Ke Suraj Ke Noor Ke Saamne Chup Jaati Hai
Kyun Ke Is Me Kitni Taqat Nahi Hoti Ke Suraj Ke
Noor Ka Saamna Kar Sake.Isi Tarah Huzoor ﷺKe
Noor Ke Saamne Koi Roshni Bhi Apni Infradiyat
Qaayim Nahi Kar Sakti.

 Wahi Noor E Haq Wahi Zill E Rab Hain Unhi Ke
            Sab Hay Unhi Se Sab
  Nahin Un Ki Milk Me Aasmaan Ke Zameen Nahi
             Ke Zamaan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zil = Saaya
Zamaan = Zamaana

    Mafhoom :- Hamare Aaqa O Maula ﷺ Hi Noor
E Zaati Baari Hai Yaani Allah Ne Apne Noor Ke Parto
                    107

Se Aap Ka Noor Paida Farmaya,Saare Jahaan Ko Phir
Aapﷺ Ke Noor Ke Faiz Se Paida Kiya Aur Saara
Jahaan Aap Hi Ke Liye Banaya,Aap Hi Ki Milkiyat
Me Sab Kuch Hai Chahe Wo Aasmaan Kyun Na Ho
Zameen Ya Koi Bhi Zamaana Jab Aap Mehboob E
Khuda Tehre To Malik E Konain Bhi Tehre.

  Wahi La Makaan Ke Makeen Huwe Sare Arsh
             Takht Nasheen Huwe
 Woh Nabi Hai Jiske Hain Ye Makaan Wo Khuda
           Hai Jiska Makaan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
La Makaan = Jis Par Jagah Aur Makan Ka Itlaq Na Ho
Makeen = Makaan Me Rehne Waala
Sare Arsh = Arsh Ke Upar
Takht Nasheen = Takht Par Baithne Waala
    Mafhoom  :- La Makaan Bhi Huzoorﷺ Ki
Qiyam Gaah Hai Aur Arsh Ke Upar Jalwagari Bhi
Huzoorﷺ Ne  Farmayi  Hai Ye  Saare  Makaan
Huzoorﷺ    Hi    Ke    Hai    Kyun    Ke
Makaan,Jism,Jismaaniyat Ke Liye Hota Hai Aur Allah
Ta’ala Chunke In Cheezo’n Se Paak Hai Lihaza Us Ki
Zaat E Ba Barkat Makaan Se Paak Hai.
                    108

Sare Arsh Par Hai Teri Guzar Dil E Farsh Par Hai
                    Teri Nazar
 Malakoot O Mulk Me Koi Shayi Nahi Wo Jo Tujh
              Pe A’yaan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Guzar = Aana Jaana
Malakoot = Farishto’n Ki Rehne Ki Jagah
A’yaan = Zaahir,Khula Huwa

    Mafhoom :- Madine Shareef Ki Galiyo’n Me
Chalne Waale ,Mehboob Ki Arsh Par Bhi Aana Jaan
Hai Aur Allah Ki Mehrbani Se Dilo’n Ki Raazo’n Ki
Na Sirf Khabar Rakhtte Hain Balke Unko Dekhte Bhi
Hain Algaraz Zameen O Aasmnaan Ya Makaan O La
Maakan Koi Zarra Aisa Nahi Jo Aap Ki Nigaho'n Ke
Saamne Na Ho .
 Karoon Tere Naam Pe Jaan Fida Na Bas Ek Jaan
            Do Jahaan Fida
  Do Jahaan Se Bhi Nahi Jee Bhara Karoon Kya
             Karoro Jahaan Nahi
    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Fida = Qurbaan
Bas = Sirf

                    109

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Nabi ﷺ Mera Dil To Yahi
Chahta Hai Ke Main Aapﷺ Ke Naam E Aqdas Pe
Jaan Qurban Kardun Aur Mere Pyare Aaqaﷺ Ek Sirf
Jaan Aap ﷺKe Naam E Naami Par Qurbaan Karna To
Aap Ke Shayaan E Shaan Nahi Samjhta Main To
Chahta Hoon Ke Dono Jahaan Agar Mere Ikhtiyaar Me
Ho To Aap Ke Naam E Aqdas Par Nisaar Kardun Aur
Mere Pyare Aaq Aap Ka Naam E Mubarak To Is
Qaabil Hai Ke Karoron Jahaan Bhi Us Par Nichawar
Kardun Lekin Kya Karun Karoron Jahaan To Hai Hi
Nahi.

Tere Qaf Ko Naadire Daher Hai Koi Misl To Misaal
                  De
  Nahi Gul Ke Paudo Me Daaliya Ke Chaman Me
              Saro Chamaan Nahi


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Nadir = Ajeeb O Ghareeb
Misl = Bara Bar
Misaal = Nazeer
Daaliyan = Shaakhien
Chaman = Baagh
Chamaan = Naaz Se Chalna
                    110

Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ka Qad E Anwar
Subhanallah ! Allah Ta’ala Ne Aisa Bana Diya Hai Ke
Uske  Saath  Kisi  Shayi Ki  Misaal Nahi Di  Jaa
Sakti.Chahe Wo Baagh Me Gulaab Ke Paudo’n Ki
Seedhi Daaliyan Ho Ya Saro Ka Seedha Tana Darakht
Ho Ye Cheezien Aap Ke Qad E Anwar Ke Saath
Misaal Di Jaane Ke Qaabil Hi Nahi.


   Nahi Jis Ke Rang Ka Doosra Na To Ho Koi Na
                Kabhi Huwa
   Kahu Us Ko Gul Kahe Koi Ke Gulo’n Ka Dher
               Kahaan Nahi
    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Gulo’n = Phool
Dher = Bohat

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺAap Jaisa Koi Paida
Huwa  Hai Na  Hoga.Kya Main Aap Ko  Phool
Kahun?Magar Kyun Kahun?Isliye Ke Phoolo’n Ke To
Dher Hi Dher Nazar Aa Rahe Hai Aur Aap Jaisa To Ek
Bhi Nahi Hai.


                    111

Karun Madh E Ahle E Duwal Raza Pade Is Balaa
            Me Meri Balaa
  Main Gadaa Hun Apne Kareem Ka Mera Deen
             Paara E Naan Nahi

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Madh = Tareef
Duwal = Daulat Waale
Balaa = Museebat
Gada = Mangta
Paara = Tukda
Naan = Roti

    Mafhoom :- Ahmed Raza Ka Qalam Sirf Naat E
Rasool Ke Liye Waqf Hai .Baqi Raha Baadshaho’n Ki
Tareef Karna Is Museebat Me Mai To Kya Mera Joota
Bhi Nahi Jayega.Is Liye Ke Main Apne Aaqa Ke Dar
Ka Bhikaari Hoon ,Kya Unki Bheek Khatam Thodi
Hogyi Ke Main Roti Ke Tukde Ki Khaatir Kisi Nawab
Ki Tareef Karun.





                    112

(13)
  Wasf E Rukh Unka Kiya Karte Hain Sharah E
      Wash Shams O Dhuha Karte Hain
     Unki Hum Madh O Sana Karte Hain Jinko
         Mehmood

sections.title: Kaha Karte Hain

blocks.text:
Kaha Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Wasf E Rukh = Chehre Ki Tareef
Sharah Wash Shams O Dhuha = Surah E Shams O
Surah E Dhuha Ki Tahsreeh,Tafseel
Madh O Sana = Tareef
Mehmood = Tareef Kiya Huwa

    Mafhoom  :- Hum Jo Apne Aaqa Ki Rukh E
Anwar Ki Tareef Karte Hain To Koi Na Jaiz Ya
Ma’mooli Kaam Nahi Karte Balke Surah E Shams Aur
Surah Dhuha Ki Tashreeh Karte Hain Aur Us Ki
Tareef Karte Hain Jiski Khuda Ne Tareef Ki Hai Ke
Us Ko Mehmood (Tareef Kiya Huwa) Bana Diya Hai.

 Mah E Shaq Gashta Ki Soorat Dekho Kaanp Kar
           Mehr Ki Raja’t Dekho
Mustafa Pyare Ki Qudrat Dekho Kaise Ae'jaz Huwa
                   Karte Hain

                    113

Mushkil Alfaz :-
    Mah E Shaq Ghashta = Tukda Tukda Chaand
    Mehr = Suraj
     Aejaz = Aajiz Karna

    Mafhoom :- Aye Azmat E Mustafa Ke Munkiro!
Zara Dekho Mere Aaqa Ne Kaise Chaand Ke Do
Tukde Kardiya,Aur Kis Tarah Suraj Kaanpta Huwa
Doobne Ke Baad Wapis Aaya.Mere Pyare Aaqa Ki
Qudrat O Taqat Ka Zara Andaaza To Lagao Aur Ghaur
Karo Ke Kaise Mo’jizaat Huwa Karte Hain.

 Tu Hai Khursheed E Risaalat Pyaare Chup Gaye
                Teri Ziya Me Taare
 Ambiya Aur Hai Sab Mah Pare Tujh Se Hi Noor
                Liya Karte Hain


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khursheed E Risalat = Risalat Ka Suraj
Ziya = Roshni
Mah Pare = Chaand Ke Tukde

    Mafhoom   :- Aye  Mere  Pyare  Aaqa Aap
Aasmaan E Nabuwwat Ke Suraj Hai Jiski Roshni Me

                    114

Sitaare Chup  Jaate  Hain.Baaqi Tamaam Ambiya
Chaand Ke Tukde Hain Jinko Noor Aap Hi Ke Faiz Se
Mila Hai.

Aye Balaa Be Khirdi E Kuffar Rakhte Hain Aise Ke
             Haq Me Inkaar
 Ke Gawaahi Ho Gar Usko Darkaar Be Zubaan Bol
              Utha Karte Hain


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Be Khirdi = Kam Aqal
Darkaar = Zaroorat

    Mafhoom :- Haaye Afsos Kam Aql Aur Jahalat
Kitni Bari Museebat Hai Ke Kaafiro’n Ne Us Ki
Nabuwwat O Kamalaat Ka Inkar Karte Hain Jis Ki
Azmath O  Risaalat  Ki  Gawahi  Hi Be  Zabaan
(Chaand,Suraj,Patthar,Darakht)Dete Hain.

 Apne Moula Ki Hai Bas Shaan E Azeem ,Jaanwar
            Bhi Kare Jinki Tazeem
   Sang Karte Hain Adab Se Tasleem Ped Sajde Me
                Gira Karte Hain


                    115

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Shaan E Azeem = Buland Maqam O Martaba
Tazeem = Izzat Karna
Sang = Patthar
Tasleem = Salam Karna
Ped = Darakht

    Mafhoom :- Imam Ul Ambiya Ki Zara Shaan
Bhi To Dekho Ke  Jaanwar  Bhi Tazeem  Karte
Hain.Patthar Aap Ka Ehteram Karte Hain Aur Darakht
Aap Ki Bargah Me Haazir Hokar Sajda Rez Hote Hain.

Rifa’te Zikr Hai Tera Hissa, Dono’n Aalam Me Hai
                Tera Charcha
 Margh E Firdous Pas Az Hamd E Khuda, Teri Hi
         Madh O Sana Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Rifa’t = Buland
Charcha = Shohrat
Margh E Firdous = Jannati Parinde(Farishte)
Pas Az Hamd = Allah Ki Taraf Karne Ke Baad

    Mafhoom :- Mere Aaqa Aap Ki Bulandiyo’n Ka
Andaaza Kon Laga Sakta Hai Ke Arsh O Farsh Aur

                    116

Zameen O Aasmaan Pe Aap Ki Azmat Ke Danke Baj
Rahe Hain Hai.Zameen Me  Namaz Me  , Aasman
Me,Jabke Allah Ke Farishtey Allah Ki Hamd O Sana
Ke Baad Aap Ki Zaat Par Durood O Salaam Hi Padte
Hain.

 Ungliyaan Paayi Wo Pyaari Pyaari Jinse Darya E
             Karam Hai Jaari
    Josh Par Aati Hai Jab GhamKhwaari Tishne
            Sairaab Huwa Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Josh = Ghalba
Ghamkhwaari = Hamdardi
Tishne = Pyase
Sairaab = Bharpoor

    Mafhoom :-
    Hamare Aaqa Ke Narm O Nazook Aur Pyaari
Pyaari Ungliyo’n Kis Qadar Shaan Rakhti Thi Ke Un
Se Karam Ke Darya Paani Jaari Hojate Aur Jab Aaqa
Apne  Ghulamo’n  Pe  Mehrban  Hojaaye To Un
Pyaaso’n Ko Us Punjab E Rehmat Se Sairaab Farmaa
Dete Hain.

                    117

Haan Yahin Karti Hain Chidiyaan Faryad, Yahin
           Se Chahti Hai Harni Daad
Isi Dar Pe Shutraan E Nashaad Gil E Ranj O ‘Anaa
                   Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Yahin = Aap Hi Ke Bargah Me
Daad = Insaaf
Dar = Darwaza
Shutraan E Nashaad = Ghamgeen Oont
Gil = Shikayat
Ranj O ‘Anaa = Dukh Museebat

    Mafhoom :- Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ki Bargah To Wo
Hai Ke Jahaan Chidiyaan Bhi Aakar Faryad Karti Hai
Aur Unki Faryad Rasi Suni  Jaati Hai.Har  Insafi
Maangi Jaati Hai Aur Usko Insaaf Milta Hai,Oont
Apni Takleef Ki Shikayat Karta Hai To Uski Shikayat
Door Kardi Jaati Hai.

  Aasteen Rehmat E Aalam Ulteh Kamar E Pak Pe
            Daaman Baandhe
   Girne Walo’n Ko Koocha E Dozakh Se Saaf Alag
           Kheench Liya Karte Hain

                    118

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aasteen = Qamees,Ya Shirt Ka Daaman
Rehmat E Aalam ﷺ = Jahaano’n Ki Rehmat
Koocha = Gali,Raasta

    Mafhoom :- Mere Aaqa O Moula ﷺ Ne Apna
Daaman Chada Kar Tayyar Hokar Pul Sirat Par Khade
Hain Ta Ke Aasani Ke Saath Ummatiyon Ko Dozakh
Ke Gado’n Se Nikal Kar Jannat Ke Baghaat Me
Pahuncha Sake.

 Jab Saba Aati Hai Taiba Se Idhar, Khilkhilaa Padti
             Hai Kaliyaan Yaksar
    Phool Jaamah Se Nikal Kar Baahar Rukh E
         Rangeen Ki Sana Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Saba = Hawa
Yaksar = Mukammal
Jaamah = Libaas
Rukh E Rangeen = Khoobsurat

    Mafhoom :- Jab Madine Se Khushbudaar Thandi
Thandi Hawa Nikal Kar Baagh Ki Taraf Aati Hai To

                    119

Ghuncha Wajd Me Jhoom Jaate Hain Aur Yakdam
Khilkhila Kar Khushi Se Jhoom Ut the Hai Aur Phir
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Shaan Me Naghma Saraa Hojaate
Hain.

 Tu Hai Wo Baadhsha E Kouno Makaan Ki Malake
             Haft Falak Ke Har Aan
 Tere Moula Se Shah E Arsh ‘Aywan Teri Daulat Ki
             Dua Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kon O Makaan = Saara Jahaan
Malak = Farishtey
Haft Falak = Saath Aasmaan
Har Aan = Har Waqt
Shah E Arsh ‘Aywaan = Allah Ke Mehal Ke Baadshah

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye  Saare  Jahano’n Ke Aaqa ﷺ  Saatho
Aasamaano’n Ke Tamaam Noorani Farishte Har Waqt
Aap ﷺ Ki Iqbal Bulandi Ke Liye Aap ﷺ Ke Rab Ki
Bargah Me Dua Goh Hain.Yaanidurood O Salam Pad
Rahe Hain.Hain


                    120

Jiske Jalwe Se Uhad Haibataan, Ma’dan E Noor
              Hai Uska Daaman
 Hum Bhi Us Chaand Pe Ho Kar Qurbaan,Dil E
          Sangeen Ki Jila Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ma’dan E E Noor = Noor Ki Kaan,Markaz E Noor
Daaman = Daaman
Dil E Sangeen- = Patthar Dil
Jila = Safayi,Zinda

    Mafhoom :- Jis Aaqa ﷺ Ke Jalwo  Se Uhad
Pahad Aaj Tak Aur Ta Qiyamat Chamkta Rahe Ga Us
Markaz E Noor Aur Mahtab E Nabuwwat Pe Qurban
Hokar Hum Bhi Kyu Na Apne Siyah Aur Patthar Dil
Ki Safayi Kar Ke Uska Ilaj Karlien.

 Kyu Na Zeba Ho Tujhse Taajwari Tere Hi Dam Ki
             Hai Sab Jalwa Gari
 Malak O Jinno Bashar Hoor O Pari Sab Jaan Tujh
            Pe Fida Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Taajwari = Baadshahat

                    121

Jalwagari = Roshni
Malak = Farishte
Bashar = Insaan
Hoor O Pari = Jannat Ki Pakeeza Auratien

    Mafhoom  :- Aye Tajdaar E Shafa’t ﷺ Asal
Hukoomat To Aap Hi Ki  Hai Kyun Ke  Saari
Kaayenath Ki Saari Baharien Aap ﷺ Hi Ke Dam
Qadmo’n Se Hai Aur Aakhirath Ki Saari Ronaqien
Aapﷺ Hi Ki Shafa’t E Kubra Ke Tufail Hai,.Yahi
Wajah Hai Ke Farishte,Jinn,Insaan.Hoor O Pari Sab
Aapﷺ Per Jaan Nichaawar Karte Huwe Nazar Aate
Hain.

  Toot Parrti Hain Balaayien Jin Par,Jinko Milta
             Nahin Koi Yaawar
   Har Taraf Se Wo Pur Armaan Phir Kar Unke
       Daaman Me Chupa Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Yaawar = Madadgar
Pur Armaan = Ummedwaar
    Mafhoom :- Jo Aapﷺ Ka Daaman E Karam
Chor Dete Hain Un Par Museebatien.Takleefain Toot
Padte Hain Aur Har Taraf Se Dhakke Khaa Khaa Kar

                    122

Aakhirkaar Jab Koi Bhi Unka Sahara Nahi Banta To
Phir Aaja Ke Aapﷺ Hi Ke Daaman Me Unko Bhi
Panah Milti Hai Aur Jo Aapﷺ Hi Ke Dar Ke Hokar
Baith Jaate Hain Unke Liye Masaib O Aalaam Bhi
Jannat Ke Phool Ban Jaate Hain.

 Lab Pe Aajata Hai Jab Naam E Janab, Munh Me
       Ghul Jaata Hai Shahad E Naayaab
  Wajd Me Hoke Hum Hai Aye Jaan Betaab Apne
         Lab Choom Liya Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Lab = Hont
Shahad Nayaab = Khalis Shahad
Ghul Jaana = Mil Jaana
Wajd = Bekhudi
Betaab = Be Qaraar

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ki Zaat Me Kya
Kya Kamalat Honge Jabke Aap Ka Naam E Naami
Hamare Labo’n Pe Aata Hai To Aisa Lagta Hai Jaise
Kisi Ne Khaalis Shahad Hamare Munh Me Daal Diya
Hai Jo Fauran Hi Munh Me Ghul Jaata Hai Aur Poore

                    123

Jisme Ko Raahat O Sukoon Mayassar Hota Aajata Hai
Isi Khushi Me Hont Aapas Me Mil Jaate Hai Aur Ek
Doosre Ko Bosa Lete Hain.

  Lab Pe Kis Munh Se Gham E Ulfat Layien Kya
       Balaa Dil Hay Alam Jiska Sunaien
Hum To Unke Kafe Paa Par Mit Jaye Unke Dar Par
              Jo Mita Karte Hain

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Gham E Ulfat = Mohabbat Ka Gham
Alam = Takleef
Kafe Pa = Paon Ka Talwa
    Mafhoom :- Hum Kyun Apna Dukhda Aap ﷺ
Ko Sunaye Aur Aap Ko Pareshaan Karien Hamare Dil
Ki Haisiyyat Hi Kya Ke Jis Ka Gham Suna Suna Kar
Aap Ke  Dil Ko Ghamgheen Karien Hum To Ye
Chahte Hain Ke Us Dil Ki Bala Samet Un Aashiqan E
Mustafa ﷺ Ke Qadmo’n Pe Qurbaan Ho Jaate Hain
Jo Khush Naseeb Aap Ke Khaak Pe Fidaa Hogaye.

 Apne Dil Ka Unhi Se Hai Aaram Sonpe Hai Apne
             Unhi Ko Sab Kaam
     Lau’ Lagi Hain Ke Ab Us Dar Ke Ghulam
        Charaye Dard E Raza Karte Hain

                    124

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sonpe = Supurd Kiye
Lau’ = Dhyaan
Charaye Dard = Beemari Ka Ilaj

    Mafhoom :-
    Chunke Hamare Dil Ka Aaram O Sukoon Bhi
Huzoor ﷺ Hi Ke Damqadam Se Hai Us Liye Hum Ne
Apne Tamam Kaam Huzoor ﷺ Hi Ke Supurd
Kardiya Hain Ke Jab Duniya Ka Sukoon Huzoor ﷺ
Se Hai To Aakhirath Bhi Huzoor Hi Ke Dam Qadam
Se Hai.Jab Hum Ne Itna Kaam Karliya Ab Ummed Hai
Ke Huzoor ﷺ Ke Darbar Ke Khusoosi Auliya Allah
Jo Dil Ke Tabeeb Hote Ahmed Raza Ke Gham Ka Ilaj
Karne Ke Liye Mutaharrik Hogaye Hai Kyun Ke Un
Ko Pata Chal Gaya Hai Ke Ye To Apni Hi Party Ka
Banda Hai.





                    125

(14)
 Arsh E Haq Hai Masnad E Rifa’t Rasool Allah Ki

sections.title: Dekhni Hai Hashr Me Izzat Rasool Allah Ki

blocks.text:
Dekhni Hai Hashr Me Izzat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Masnad = Baithne Ki Jaga
Rifa’t = Bulandi
Izzat = Maqam O Martaba

    Mafhoom :- Hum Sab Ne Jo Allah Ke Mehboob
ﷺ Ki Shaan Duniya Me Padi Aur Hum Maanne
Waale Hogaye Aur Munkir Padh Kar Bhi Inkaar Kar
Gaye Apni Aankho’n Se Dekhni Hai Ke Khuda Ke
Arsh E Mo’alla Par Huzoor Tashreef Farma Hai.

Qabr Me Lehraayenge Ta Hashr Chashme Noor Ke
   Jalwa Farma Hogi Jab Tala’t Rasool Allah Ki


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Lehrana = Jhoolne,Jaari Hona
Tal’at = Chehra Noorani,Surat
    Mafhoom :- Qabr Me Aashiqane Mustafa ﷺ
Ke Liye Huzoor ﷺ Ki Aamad Par Aap Ke Chehre

                    126

Aqdas Se Noor Ke Aise Jalwe Uthengey Jhando’n Ki
Tarah  Momin  Ki  Qabr  Ta  Qiyamat  Lehraate
Rahengey.

  Kaafiro’n Par Tegh Waala Se Giri Barq E Gazab
   Abr Aa saa Cha Gayi Haibat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Taigh Waala = Buland Talwar
Barq E Ghazab = Qahar Ki Bijli
Abr Aasaa = Baadal Ki Tarah

    Mafhoom :- Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ne Jab Apne Dast E
Aqdas Me Talwar Ko Lekar Us Ko Bulandi Ata
Farmayi To Ab Uski Haibat Itni Baat Se Hi Kaafiro’n
Ke Dilo’n Pe Aisi Baithi Ke Aisa Lagta Hai Un Par
Qahr Ki Bijli Giri.

   La Wa Rabbil ‘Arsh Jisko Jo Mila Unse Mila
  Bat Ti Hai Kaunain Me Ne’mat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
La Wa Rabbil Arsh = Qasam Hai Arsh Ke Rab Ki

                    127

Mafhoom :-
    Mujhe Arsh Ke Rab Ki Qasam Jis Ko Jo Nemat
Bhi Milti Hai Dar E Rasool Se Hi Milti Hai Dono
Jahan Me Rasoolallah ﷺ Ke Qadmo’n Ka Sadqe Hi
Nematien Banti Ja Rahi Hai.

Wo Jahannum Me Gaya Jo Un Se Mustaghni Huwa
   Hai Khaleelullah Ko Haajat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Mustaghni = Be Niyaz, La Parwa
Khaleelullah = Hazrat E Ibrahim Alaihissalam
Hajat = Zaroorat

    Mafhoom :-
     Jo Mere Aaqa ﷺ Se Be Niyaz Aur La Parwa
Hogaya Aur Ye Kaha Ke Humien Ab Unki Zaroorat
Nahi Wo Seedha Jahannum Me Jayega Kyun Ke Baroz
E Mehshar Hazrath E Ibrahim Alihissalam Ko ,Balke
Sab Ko Hi Zaroorat Hai To Tumhari Kya Auqat Hai.

  Suraj Ulteh Paun Palteh Chaand Ishaare Se Ho
                 Chaak
  Andhe Najdi Dekh Le Qudrat Rasool Allah Ki
                    128

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ulte Paun Palatna = Unhi Qadmo Pe Wapis Hona
Chaak = Do Tukde

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Gustakh E Rasool , Andhe Najdi Dekh Isse
Badh Kar Huzoor ﷺ Ki Qudrat O Taqath Ki Kya
Daleel Ho Sakti Hai Ke Aap ﷺ Ishaara Farma Dein
To Dooba Huwa Suraj Wapis Laut Aata Hai Aur
Chaand Do Tukde Hojata.

 Tujh Se Aur Jannat Se Kya Matlab Wahabi Door
                Ho
  Hum Rasool Allah Ke Jannat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Matlab = Kaam

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Azmat E Mustafa ﷺ Ke Munkir,Aye
Gustakh Tujh Se Aur Jannat Se Kya Matlab.Tera Us
Ki Taraf Lau Lagana Bekaar Hai Kyun Ke Jannat To
Unke Deewano’n Ki Hai Aur Isliye Hum Rasool Allah
Ke Jannat Rasool Allah Ki.

                    129

Zikr Roke Fazl Kaate Naqs Ka Jooyan Rahe
 Phir Kahe Mardak Ke Hoon Ummat Rasool Allah
                      Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Fazl = Fazeelat
Kaate = Kaant Chaat Kare,Fazeelat Ka Inkar Kare
Naqs = A’ib
Jooyan = Talash Karne Waala
Mardak = Zaleel Kameena
    Mafhoom :- Aye Najdi Tuhe Sharm Nahi Aati
Ke Jinka Kalma Padta Hai Unhi Ke Zikr Se Chidta
Hai,Rokne Ki Koshish  Karta  Hai,Fazeelato’n Ko
Chupata,A’ib Talash Karne Ki Koshish Karta Hai,Aur
Phir Kehta Hai Ke Ummati Hoon Rasool Allah Ka Aye
Zaleel Tujhe Sharm Karni Chahiye.


Najdi Usne Tujh Ko Mohlat Di Ke Is Aalam Me Hai
  Kaafir O Murtad Pe Bhi Rehmat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Mohlat = Dheel
Aalam = Jahaan
Kaafir O Murtad = Deen Se Phirne Waala
                    130

Mafhoom :- Sun Najdi! Agar Tu Kahta Hai Ke
Agar Hum Aise Hain To Allah Apne Mehboob Ke
Gustakhi Ki Wajah Se Apne Azaab Me Mubtila Kyun
Nahi Kar Raha To Sun Allah Ne Apne Mehboob Ke
Sadqe Me Mohlat De Rakhi Hai .Kyunke Duniya Me
Kaafir O Murtad Pe Bhi Huzoor ﷺ Ki Rehmat Baras
Rahi Hai Ke Bade Azaab Se Bache Huwe Hain Aur
Apne Nek Kaamo’n Ki Wajah Se Jo Sirf Duniya Me
Ajar Milne Wala Hai Use Nematien Pa Rahe Hain.

  Hum Bhikaari Wo Kareem Unka Khuda Unse
                  Fuzoo
    Aur Na Kehna Nahi Aadat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Fuzoo = Zyada
Na = Nahi
    Mafhoom :-
     Alhamdulillah! Hum Apne Aaqa ﷺ Ke Dar Ke
Bhikaari Hai Aur Humien Apne Aaqa Sab Kuch Dete
Hain Kyun Ke Wo Kareem Hai Aur Unka Khuda Unko
Ata Fermata Hai. Aur Hamare Nabi Ki Shaan Ye Hai
Ke Wo ‘Na’ Nahi Farmate Aur ‘Na Kehna’ Unki Aadat
Hi Nahi Hai.

                    131

Ahle Sunnat Ka Hai Bedaa Paar Ashaabe Huzoor
  Najm Hai Aur Naaw Hai ‘Itrat Rasool Allah Ki

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ashaab E Huzoor = Huzoor ﷺ Ke Sahaba
Najm = Sitaare
Naaw = Kashti
Itrat = Aal

    Mafhoom :- Inshallah Allah Ta’ala Hum Ahle
Sunnath Wa Jama’at Jo Sahaba E Kiram Aur Ahle
Baith Dono Ko Maanne Waale’unka Ehteram Karne
Waale Unki Mohabbat Ko Apne Imaan Ki Jaan
Samajhne Waale, Duniya Aur Aakhirath Me Hamara
Beda Paar,Hamari Kashti Kinaare Par Pahunch Jayegi
Kyunki Hamare Liye Sahaba E Kiram Sitaare Aur
Ahle Baith E Kiram Kashti Hai.

   Khaak Hokar Ishq Me Aaram Se Sona Mila
     Jaan Ki Ikseer Hai Ulfat Rasool Allah Ki


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ikseer = Kimiya Jis Se Sona Banta Hai
Ulfat = Mohabbat
                    132

Mafhoom :-
   Hum Huzoor ﷺ Ke Qadmo’n Ki Khaak Banien
To Allah Ta’ala Ne Humien Chain Ki Neend Ata
Farmayi Is Se Saabit Huwa Ke Aaqa ﷺ Ki Mohabbat
Mitti Ko Sona Banana Waale Kimiya Hai.

  Toot Jayiengey Gunahgaaro’n Ke Fauran Qaid O
                  Band
   Hashr Ko Khul Jaayegi Taqat Rasool Allah Ki

     Mushkil Alfaz :-
Qaid O Band = Bediyaan

    Mafhoom:- Qiyamat Ke Din Hamare Aaqa ﷺ
Ki Taqat Ka Andaza Hoga Jab Carodo’n Mujrim Qaid
O Band Me Daal Kar Jahannum Ki Taraf Le Jaaye Ja
Rahe Hongey To Huzoor ﷺ  Ka Ek Sajda Saari
Bediyaan Tod Kar Murimo’n Ko Riha Kara Dega Aur
Jahannum Se Logo’n Ko Nikal Kar Bahar Kare Ga .

  Ya Rab Ek Sa’at Me Dhool Jayien Siyaahkaro’n
                Ke Jurm
    Josh Me Aajaye Ab Rehmat Rasool Allah Ki

                    133

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sa’at = Lamha,Ghadi
Dhool Jayien = Saaf Hojayien

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye  Allah,Wo  Ghadi  Jald Aaye Ke  Tere
Mehboob Ki Rehmat Ka Darya Ho Aru Ek Hi Lamhe
Me Siyaakaro’n K Jurm Aise Dhool Jayien Ke Naam
O Nishaan Tak Baaqi Na Rahe.

   Hai Gul E Baagh E Qudus Rukhsaar Zebaaye
                  Huzoor
   Sarwe Gulzaare Qidam Qaamat Rasool Allah

    Mushkil Alfz :-
Gul E Baagh E Qudus = Taqaddus (Ilahi) Ke Baagh Ke
Phool
Rukhsaar Zebaaye = Khoobsuat Gaal
Sarwe Gulzaare Qidam = Qadeem (Sifa’at Eilahi Ka
Jalwa)
Qamat = Qad Anwar

    Mafhoom :- Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ka Chehra Anwar
Pakeezgi Ki Azemusshan  Gulistaan Ka Chamkta

                    134

Huwa Tar O Taaza Phool Hai Aur Aap Ka Qad E
Anwar Qadeem Ke Haseen Baagh Ka Sarw Hai.

  Aye Raza Khud Sahib E Quraan Hai Maddah E
                  Huzoor
 Tujh Se Kab Mumkin Hai Midhat Rasool Allah Ki

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sahib E Quraan = Khuda Ta’ala
Maddah = Tareef Karne Waala
Midhat = Tareef

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Raza Tu Jitni Bhi Apne Aaqa Ki Tareef
Karega Kama Haqquhu Nahi Kar Sakega Kyun Ke
Jabunka Parwardigar Khud Unki Tareef Karne Waala
Hai.





                    135

(15)
  Sarwar Kahun Ke Malik O Maula Kahun Tujhe

sections.title: Baagh E Khaleel Ka Gul E Zaiba Kahun Tujhe

blocks.text:
Baagh E Khaleel Ka Gul E Zaiba Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sarwar = Sardar
Khaleel = Ibrahim Alaihissalam
Gul E Zaiba = Khubsoorat Phool

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Pyare Nabi! ﷺ Mai
Aap Ko  Sardaar  Kahun,Apna  Aaqa O  Maula
Kahun,Hazrath E Ibrahim Alaihissalam Ke Gulistaan
Ka Gul ( Khubsoorat Phool) Kahun Ya Kya Kahun?
Kyun Ke Aap Me Ye Tamaam Sifa’at Bhi Hai Aur
Iske Ilawa Bhi Beshumaar Sifa’at Allah Ta’ala Ne Aap
Ko Ata Farmayi Hai.

 Hirmaan Naseeb Hun Tujhe Ummed Gah Kahun
 Jaan E Muraad O Kaan E Tamanna Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Hirmaan Naseeb = Mehroom O Badnaseeb
Ummed Gah = Umeed Poori Hone Ki Jagah
Jaan E Murad = Maqsad Ke Husool Hone Ki Jaan
Kaan E Tamanna = Ummedo’n Ka Zakheera

                    136

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ  ! Agarche Main
Badnaseeb Mehroom Ul Qismat Sahi Lekin,Jab Aap
Meri Ummedo’n Ka Markaz Murado’n Ki Jaan O
Tamannaao’n Ka Zakheera Hai To Phir Mehroomi
Kaisi ? Aap ﷺ Ki Nigahe Inayat Se Badqismati Nek
Bakhti Me Badal Hi Jayegi.

  Gulzaar E Quds Ka Gul E Rangeen Ada Kahun
Darmaan E Dard E Bulbul E Shayda Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Gulzaar E Quds = Pakeezgi Ka Baagh
Gul E Rangeen Ada = Rangdaar Phool
Darmaan = Ilaaj
Dard = Beemari
Bulbul E Shayda = Aashiq E Zaar Murad

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Azmat O Kamal Waale
Nabi ﷺ ! Aap Ko Jannat Ke Muqaddas O Pakeeza
Baagh Ka Khubsoorat Tareen,Naazmeen Phool Kaha
Jaaye,Ya Dard E Ishq Me Tadapne Waali Bulbul Ka
Ilaaj Kahun .


                    137

Subh E Watan Pe Shaam E Gharibaan Ko Doon
                    Sharaf
    Bekas Nawaz Gesuo’n Waala Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Subh E Watan = Apne Desh Ki Subah
Shaam E Gharibaan = Musaafiro’n Ki Shaam Jo
Mashaqqat Waali Hoti Hai
Sharaf = Fazeelat
Bekasnawaz = Majbooro’n Ko Nawazne Waala
Gesuo’n Waala = Zulfo’n Waala

    Mafhoom :-
    Main Apne Desh Ki Subah Ko Aye Mere Pyare
Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ke Madina Shareef Ki Musafirat Aur
Ghareeb Ul Watan Waali Shaam Par Fazilat Deta
Hoon,Aap To Ghareeb Nawaz Hai Aur Aisi Pyaari
Zulfo’n Waale Hai Ke Saare Jahaan Aap Ke Zulf Ke
Qaidi Hai Aur Aap Ke Zulf Ke Har Baal Ke Saath
Hazaar Gunahgaaro’n Ka Muqaddar Bana Huwa Hai.

  Allah Re Tere Jism E Munawwar Ki Taabishien
  Aye Jaan E Jaan Main Jaan E Tajallaa Kahun
                    Tujhe

                    138

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Allah Re = Wah Wah
Munawar = Noorani
Taabishien = Chamak
Jaan E Jaan = Jaan Ki Bhi Jaan
Jaan E Tajalla = Roshni O Noor Ki Jaan

    Mafhoom :-
     Subhan Allah! Aap ﷺ Ke Noorani Jism Me
Tajalliyan Aisi Bhar Di Gayi Hai Ke Aye Meri Jaan Ki
Bhi Jaan Mera Dil To Chah Raha Hai Ke Mai Aap Ko
Noor Ki Bhi Jaan Kahun.

 Be Daagh Laalah Ya Qamar E Bey Kalaf Kahoon
 Be Khaar Gulban E Chaman Aaraa Kahun Tujhe


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Be Daagh Laalah = Ek Khaas Phool Magar Usme
Daagh Na Ho
Be Kalaf = Be Daagh
Be Khaar = Beghair Kaanto’n Ke
Gulban = Surkh Gulab
Chaman Aaraa = Baagh Ko Zeenat Bakhsne Waala


                    139

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ ! Agar Aap Ko Gul E
Laalah Kahun To Khoobsurat To Hota Hai Magar
Usme Bhi Siyaah Daagh Hota Hai ,To Phir Mai Aap
Ko Wo Gul E Laalah Kehta Hoon Jisme Daagh Na Ho,
Phir Mai Aap Ko Aisa Phool Bhi Kahunga Jiske Sath
Kaanta Na Ho,Aur Wo Phool Poore Baagh Ka Husn O
Jamaal O Zeb O Zeenat Ho.

   Mujrim Hoon Apne ‘Afw Ka Saamaan Karun
                  Shaha
   Yaani Shafi’ E Roz E Jazaa Ka Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Afw = Muafi
Saamaan = Tayyari
Shafi’ E Roz E Jaza = Qiyamat Ke Din Shfa’at
Farmane Waale

    Mafhoom  :- To Haan Mujhe Yaad Aaya Ke
Main To Khud Mujrim O Khatakaar Hoon Aur Aap
Shafi’ E Roz E Shumaar Hai To Kyun Ka Koi Aisa
Wasf Aap Ke Liye Kahun Ke Aap Ki Tareef Hojaye
Aur Mera Bhi Kaam Banjaaye.

                    140

Is Murda Dil Ko Muzdah Hayaat E Abd Ka Kahun
  Taab O Tawaan E Jaan E Masiha Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Muzdah = Khushkhabri
Hayaat E Abd = Hamesha Ki Zindagi
Taab O Tawaan = Taqat O Quwwat
Jaan E Masiha = Murdo’n Ko Zinda Karne Waale Isa
Alaihissalam Ki Bhi Jaan

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ ! Mai Apne Is Murda Dl Ko
Hamesha Ki Zindagi Ki Khushkhabri Sunata Huwa
Aap Ko Isa Alaihisssalam Ki Jaan Me Murda Zinda
Karne Ki Jo Taqat Hai Wo Qarar Deta Hoon.

   Tere To Wasf E A’ib E Tanaahi Se Hai Baree
  Hairan Hoon Mere Shah Mai Kya Kahun Tujhe

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Wasf = Khoobi
A’ib = Khaami
Tanaahi = Inteha Hona,Khatam Hona
Bari = Paak

                    141

Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ ! Aap Ke Ausaf O Kamalat
Ki Koi Had Hi Nahi Kyun Ke Aap Ke Ausaaf Itne Hain
Ke  Khatam   Hone  Waale  Ai’b  Se  Bhi  Paak
Hain.Yahan Par Kisi Ke Khoobiyan Khatam Hojana
Ye Bhi Ai’b Hai Aur Aap ﷺ To Is Se Bhi Pak Hai
Aur Aap Ke Kamalao O Ausaaf Khatam Hi Nahi Hota.

    Keh Legi Sab Kuch Unke Sanakhwaan Ki
                 Khamoshi
  Chup Ho Raha Ye Keh Ke Main Kya Kya Kahun
                    Tujhe

    Muushkil Alfaz :-
Sanakhwaan = Tareef Karne Waala

    Mafhoom :-
    Aap Ka Sanakhwaan Aap Ki Azmat O Shaan Ke
Saamne Hairan Ho Kar Khamosh Hojata Hai Ke Itni
Tareef Ki Lekin Tareef Khatam Nahi Ho Rahi Aur Kya
Kya Kaha Jaaye.

   Lekin Raza Ne Khatm E Sukhan Is Pe Kardiya
   Khaliq Ka Banda Khalq Ka Aaqa Kahun Tujhe
                    142

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sukhan = Baat,Kalam
Khaliq = Paida Karne Waala ,Allah Azzawajjal
Khalq = Makhlooq

    Mafhoom :-
    Aur Aye Mere Pyaare Aaqa ﷺ ! Raza Ne Baat
Yahan Khatam Kardi Ke Aap Ko Allah Ka Banda E
Khaas Kahunga Aur Allah Ki Saari Makhlooq Ka
Aaqa O Maula Kahunga.





                    143

(16)
        Zarre Jhar Kar Teri Paizaaro’n Ke

sections.title: Taj E Sar Bante Hain Saiyyaro’n Ke

blocks.text:
Taj E Sar Bante Hain Saiyyaro’n Ke


    Muhskil Alfaz :-
Zarre = Gird(Sab Se Choti Cheez)
Paizaaro’n = Nal’ain E Muqaddas,Joota Mubarak
Saiyyaro’n = Gardish Karne Waale Sitaare

    Mafhoom :- Suraj,Chaand,Mushtari,Sitaare Ke
Saro’n Pe Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ki Nala’in Mubarak Se Jhad
Kar Girne Waale  Mitthi Ke Zarre Taj Ban Kar
Chamakte Hain.

   Hum Se Choro’n Pe Jo Farmaayien Karam
       Khil’at E Zar Banien Pushtaaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khil’at = Inaam Ka Joda
Zar = Sona
Pushtaaro’n = Dhero’n Ke Dher
    Mafhoom :- Neko’n Ko To Aap ﷺ Kya Kya
Inaam Ata Farmate Honge Hum Jaise Paapiyo’n Aur

                    144

Nekiyo’n Ko  Bhi  Itna Nawaaz  Dete  Hain Ke
Khil’ato’n (Sunehre Aur Sacche Kaam Ke Jode Jo
Kapdo’n Per Sone Ki Taaro’n Se Chadhaayi Kar Ke
Log Shaadi Ke Mauqe’ Pe Tayyari Karte Hain Yaani
Khal’at) Ka Dher Lagaa Dete Hain Jo Uthana Mushkil
Hojata Hai.Kyun Ke Wo Apni Shaan Ke Mutabiq Ata
Farmate Hain.

      Mere Aaqa Ka Wo Dar Hai Jiss Per
     Maathe Ghiss Jaate Hain Sardaaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Maathe = Peshaani
    Mafhoom :- Mere Nabi ﷺ Ka Dar E Aqdas To
Wo  Hai  Jahaan  Bade  Bade  Baadshah  Apni
Peshaaniya’n Ragadte Nahi Thakte Aur Usko Apne
Liye Sa’adat Samajhte Hain.

         Mere Eesa Tere Sadqe Jaaon
        Toor Be Toor Hai Beemaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Toor =  Chaal,Chalan,Tarz,Ravish
Be Toor = Buri Halat
                    145

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Hamare Eesa (Yaani Mohammed Mustafa
ﷺ  ) Aap Ke Beemaro’n (Hum Gunahgaaro’n Ke
Bade Be Dhange Lachan Hai Ke Har Waqt Aap Ki Na
Farmaani Me Lage Rahte Hai Na Marna Yaad Na
Marker Uthna Yaad,Na Farmaaniyo’n Me Bohat Aage
Nikal Chuke Hain.Magar Aap Per Qurban Jaayien Ke
Aap Hum Jaiso’n Ko Phir Bhi Nibha Rahe Hain.

    Mujrimo’n! Chashm E Tabassum Rakkho
       Phool Ban Jaate Hain Angaaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Chashm = Aankh,Ummed
Tabassum = Muskurahat
Angaaro’n = Aag Ke Sho’le

    Mafhoom :-
     Lekin Aye Mujrimo’n  ! Siyaah Karo,Gunah
Gaaro’n,Aakhir Gunah Gaar Hi Hona Magar Ho To
Wafadar? Gaddar To Nahi Hona? Ummed Rakho! Ke
Qiyamat Ke Din Mere Aaqa Muskura Kar Dekhenge
Aur Jab Unke Labo’n Pe Muskurahat Phail Jaaye Gi
To Angaare Bhi Phool Ban Jaayien Gey. Aur Ye

                    146

Muskurahat Huzoor Ki Wafadari Aur Mohabbat Se
Milti Hai.

         Tere Abru Ke Tasadduq Pyaare
       Band Kurre Hain Giraftaaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Abru = Bhavien
Tasadduq = Qurbaan
Kurre = Sakht
    Mafhoom  :- Aye Mere Pyaare Aaqa ﷺ ! Hum
Giraftaar E Bala Hain Aur Bandish Bhi Badi Mazbooti
Se Bandhi Huyi Hai Apne Abru Mubarak Ka Ishara
Farmaayien Ta Ke Ye Museebato’n Ke Laakho’n Ki
Saari Hathkadiyaa’n Aur Bediyaa’n Toot Jayengey
Aur Aap Ke Gunah Gaar Ghulam Har Qism Ke
Ghamo’n Se Azaad Hojayien Aur Nafs O Shaitaan Ke
Phailaaye Huye Jaalo’n Se Bach Kara Aap Ki Zulfo'n
Ki Chaao’n Me Aajaye Kyun Ke Duniya O Aakhirath
Ki Tamam Kamiyaabiyaaa’n To Aap Hi Ki Pairo’n Me
Hai.

       Jaan O Dil Tere Qadam Par Waare
      Kya Naseebay Hain Tere Yaaro’n Ke

                    147

Mushkil Alfaz :-
    Waare = Qurbaan Kare
     Naseebay = Bakht
     Yaaro’n = Sahaba E Kiram

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ ! Aap Ke Yaaro’n (Sahaba E
Kiram Bilkhusoos Khulafa E Rashideen) Ke Kya Ache
Naseeb The Ke Jo Aap Par Jaan O Dil Qurbaan Karte
Rahe.

      Sidq O ‘Adl O Karam O Himmat Mein
    Chaar Soo Shohre Hain Inn Chaaro’n Ke


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sidq = Sacchai
Adl = Insaaf
Karam = Sakhawat
Himmat = Bahaduri

    Mafhoom :-
     Sadaqat Siddiq E Akbar Ke,Adalat Farooq E
Azam Ke Sakhawat E Usmani Ke Aur Shuj’at Ali E
Murtaza Ke Danke Har Taraf Hai.

                    148

Behr E Tasleem E ‘Ali Maidaan Me
      Sar Jhuke Rehte Hain Talwaaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bahr E Tasleem = Salami Ke Liye

    Mafhoom  :-
   Wo Ali Sher E Khuda Jo Maidaan Me Utarte Hai
To Dushman Ki Talwarien Sarnagu Hokar Ali E
Murtaza Ko Salami Karte Hain .

       Kaise Aaqaaon Ka Banda Hoon Raza
          Bol Bale Meri Sarkaaro’n Ke

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aaqaao’n = Sardaaro’n
Banda = Naukar, Ghulam
Bol Bale = Shaan O Shaukat Buland Hona

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Ahmed Raza To Kitna Khushnaseeb Hai Ke
Allah Ta’ala Ne Humien Kaise Shaan O Shaukat
Waale  Aaqa  Ata  Farmaye.  Allah  At’ala  Unke
Martabo’n Me Mazed Bulandiyaan Ata Farmaye.

                    149

(17)
   Zameen O Zamaan

sections.title: Tumhare Liye

blocks.text:
Tumhare Liye Makeen O
           Makaan Tumhare Liye
   Chuneen O Chunaan Tumhare Liye Bane Do
            Jahaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zamaan = Zamane
Makeen = Makan O Jagah Me Rehna Waala
Chuneen O Chunaaan = Aisa Waisa Yaani Har Shay’i

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ  ! Ye Saari Zameen Aap Ki
Khaatir Aur Saara Zamana Aap Hi Ka Hai, Ye Makaan
(Aabaadiyaan) Aap Hi Ke Liye Hai Aur Un Me Rehne
Waali Makhlooq Bhi Aap Hi Ke Liye Hai, Ye Duniya
Ki Saari Rangeeniyaa’n Aap Ke Dam Qadam Se Hai
Balke Dono’n Jahaan Aap Hi Ke Liye Hai Kyun Ke
Aap Wajh E Takhleeq E Kainaat Hai.

 Dahan Me Zubaan Tumhare Liye Badan Me Hai
             Jaan Tumhare Liye
  Hum Aaye Yahaan Tumhare Liye Uthien Bhi
          Wahaan Tumhare Liye

                    150

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dahan = Munh
Badan = Jism
Yahaan = Is Duniya Me
Wahaan = Maidan E Mehshar Me
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ  ! Munh Me
Zubaan Bhi Aap Hi Ki Tareef Karne Ke Liye Hai Aur
Jism Me Jaan Bhi Aap Hi Ke Liye Hain. Hum Is
Duniya Me Aaye Bhi Aap Ki Itaat O Mohabbat Ke
Liye Aur Qabr Se Uthna Bhi Aap Hi Ke Liye Hain.


   Farishte Khidam Rasool O Hisham Tamaam E
        Umam Ghulaam E Karam
  Wujood O A’dam Hudoos O Qidam Jahaan Me
              ‘Iyaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khidam = Khadim Ki Jama Khidmatguzar
Hisham = Nokar
Umam = Ummat Ki Jama Kisi Bhi Nabi Ke Maanne
Waale
Wujood O ‘Adam = Hona na Hona
Hudoos O Qidam = Naya Purana
Iyaan = Zaahir

                    151

Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Pyare Nabi ﷺ Farishte
Aap Ki Khidmatgaar Hai Ambiya Aur Rasool Aap Ke
Khaiarkhwaa Hai Aur Tamaam Ummati Aap Ke
Karam Ki Bhikaari Aur Nokar Hai,Wujood Ho Ya
Adam ( Hona Yana Hona) Aalam E Hudoos O Ya
Qadeem (Zindagi Mout,Naya Purana, Raat Din) In Sab
Ka Jalwa Saamaniyaa’n Aap Hi Ki Tufail Hain.


    Kaleem O Najeeh,Maseeh O Safi Khaleel O
               Razi,Rasool O Nabi
    Ateeq O Wasi Ghani O Ali Sanaa Ki Zubaan
               Tumahre Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khaleel = Ibrahim Alaihissalam
Najeeh = Hazrtah E Nooh Alaihissalam
Kaleem = Moosa Alaihissalam
Maseeh = Isa Alaihissalam
Safi = Adam Alaihissalam
Razi = Ismaail Alaihissalam
Ateeq = Siddiq E Akbar
Wasi = Umar Farooq
Ghani = Usman E Ghani
Sana = Tareef

                    152

Mafhoom :-
    Moosa Kaleemullah Ho Ya Nooh  Najiullah
Ho,Ya Ibrahim Khaleel Ullah Ho Ya Adam Safiullah
Ho,Ya Ismaail Alaihissalam Ho Ya Koi Bhi Nabi Ho
Ya Phir Hazrath E Siddiq E Akbar Ho Ya Umar E
Farooq ,Ya Usman E Ghani Ho Ya Ali Shere Khuda
Ya Phir Koi Bhi Sahabi Ho Har Koi Aap Hi Ki Tareef
Me Rutbulissan Nazar Aa Raha Hai.

    Isaalat E Kul Imaamat E Kul Siyaadat E Kul
                 Imaarat E Kul
Hukoomat E Kul Wilaayat E Kul Khuda Ke Yahaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Isaalat = Buniyaad
Kul = Sab Ki
Imaamat = Imam Hona
Siyaadat = Sardaari
Imaarat = Hukoomat
Wilayat = Saltanat

    Mafhoom :-
    Aap Asal E Kul,Imam E Kul (Saari Kainaat Ke
Imam O Peshwa , Sayyid E Kul Hai Dono’n Jahaan Ki
                    153

Sardari,Hukoomat,Riyaasat O Wilayat Khuda Ne Aap
Ko Hi Ata Farmayi Hain.

   Tumhari Chamak Tumhari Dhamak Tumhari
            Jhalak Tumhari Mahak
  Zameen O Falak Simaak O Samak Mein Sikkah
            Nishaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Chamak = Roshni
Dhamak = Nooraniyat
Jhalak = Jalwa
Mehak = Khushboo
Falak = Aasman
Simaak = Sitaara
Samak = Machli
Sikkah = Tippah
Nishaan = Alaamat

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Noor Waale Aaqa ﷺ  Aap Ki
Nooraaniyat Jisse Dar O Deewar Jagmaga Uthe Aap
Ki Roshni Aisi Ke Suraj O Chaand Bhi Uska Muqabla
Na Kar Sake Aap Ki Ek Jhalak Jisko Dekhne Ki Taqat

                    154

Nahi Hai Aalam Ko , Aur Aap Ke Jism Munawwar Se
Phootne  Waali  Khushbu  Jannat  Ki  Khushboo
Hai.Zameen Ho Ya Aasmaan , Bulandi Ho Ya Pasti,
Jagah Ho Ya Basti,Har Taraf Aap Hi Ka Sikkah Chal
Raha Hai Aur Aap Hi Ki Azmath Ke Danke Baj Rahe
Hain.

Wo Kanz E Nihaan Ye Noor E Fashaan Wo Kun Se
            ‘Iyaan Ye Bazm E Fakaan
 Ye Har Tan O Jaan Ye Baagh E Jinaan Ye Saara
           Samaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kanz E Nihaan = Ghaibi Khazana
Fashaan = Zaahir, Noor Bikharne Waala
Kun = Hoja
Bazm = Mehfil
Fakaan = Makhlooq
Jinaan = Jannatien
Samaan = Manzar

    Mafhoom  :- Posheeda Khazanien Ya Zaahiri
Jalwa Samaaniyaa’n Ho,Aalam E Kun Fakaan (Aalam
Wajood Me Aane Waali Tamam Ashya) Ho Ya Kisi

                    155

Ke Jism Me Jaan, Jannat Ke Baaghaat Ho Ya Aalam E
Samaawat,Ye Sab Manzar Aap Hi Ke Liye.


  Zuhoor E Nihaan Qayaam E Jahaan Rukoo’ E
          Mihaan Sujood E Shahaan
  Niyaazien Yahaan Namazien Wahaan Ye Kis Ke
             Liye Haan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zuhoor O Nihaan  =  Posheeda Cheez Ka Zaahir
Hojana
Qayaam = Khade Hona
Mihaan = Sardaar
Sujood = Jama Sajda Ki
Shahaan = Baadshah
Niyaazien = Aajiziyaa’n

    Mafhoom :-
    Aalam E Zuhoor Me Aane  Waali Tamam
Ashiyaa , Jahaan Ka Qayim Hona Aur Qayim Rehna,
Saradaaro’n Ke Ruku’ Aur Badshaho’n Ke Sajde Jo
Unki Bargah Me Hote Hain Ya Murad Hai Aajizi O
Inkisaari Yahaan Ki  Aajiziyaa’n Ho Wahaan Ki
Namazien,Ye Sab Kuch Mere Aaqa ﷺ Ke Liye Hain.

                    156

Ye Shams O Qamar Ye Shaam O Sahar Ye Bargh O
            Shajar Ye Baagh O Samar
  Ye Taigh O Sipar Ye Taj O Kamar Ye Hukm E
           Rawaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Shams O Qamar = Suraj Aur Chaand
Shaam O Sehar = Din Aur Raat
Bargh O Shajar = Patte Aur Darakht
Samar = Phal
Taigh = Talwar
Sipar = Dhal
Kamar = Pusht
Rawaan = Jaari

    Mafhoom :-
    Haan  Haan  Suno    !  Ye  Chaand  Ka
Chamakna,Suraj Ka Dhamkna,Ye Raat Ki Siyaahi,Ye
Din  Ki  Roshni.Darakhto’n Ke  Patte Aur Khud
Darakht,Baaghat Aur Unke Phal,Ye Talwarien Aur
Dhaalien , Ye Takht O Taaj Pusht Aalam Par Khidmat
Ki Patti Ka Bandha Hona Algaraz Saare Jahaan Ka
Hukm Jaari Hona Ye Kis Ke Liye Hain? Haan Ya
Rasool Allah ﷺ Tumhare Hi Liye Hain.

                    157

Ye Faiz Diye Wo Jood Kiye Ke Naam Liye Zamana
                        Jiye
  Jahaan Ne Liye Tumhare Diye Ye Ikraamiyaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Faiz = Faida
Ikraamiyan = Ataayien

    Mafhoom :-
     Idhar Zameen Waalo’n Ko Apne Noor Ka Faiz
Ata Farma Rahe Hai Aur Udhar Meraj Ki Shab
Aasmaan Waalo’n Ke Saamne Apne Rehmat Ke
Khazane Luta Rahe Hain. Unka Naam Lekar Zamana
Jee Raha Hain.Ye Saari Ataaien Kis Ki Hai ? Aap Hi
Ke Hain.

  Sahaab E Karam Rawaana Kiye Ke Aab Ni’am
              Zamaana Piye
   Jo Rakhte The Hum Wo Chaak Siye Ye Sitr E
            Badaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sahaab = Baadal

                    158

Aab = Paani
Ni’am = Ne’matien
Chaak = Phatan
Satr = Parda
Badaan = Bure

    Mafhoom :- Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ne Apne Fazl O
Karam Ke Aise Baadal Rawaana Kiye Ke Aaj Tak Aur
Qiyamat Tak Huzoor ﷺ Ke Sadqe Allah Ta’ala Ki
Ne’maton Ke Paani Se Faizyaab Hota Rahega. Aap Ne
Hamare Zakhmi Dilo’n Pe Apni Mohabbat Ki Marham
Rakh Kar Hamari Chaak Si Diye Hai Aur Hum
Gunahgaar Ke Ai’bon Ko Apne Rehmat Ke Daaman
Se Dhaanp Diya ,Bhala Bataye Ye Shaan Kis Ki Hain?
Aap Hi Ke Liye Hain.

Sanaa Ka Nishaan Wo Noor Fashaan Ke Mehr Wa
         Shaan Ba Aanhamah Shaan
 Ba Saaya Kashaan Mawakib Shaan Yeh Naam O
            Nishaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sana = Tareef
Noor Fashaan = Noor Ki Baarish

                    159

Mehr Wa Shaan = Unki Mohabbat,Ya Maanind
Ba Aanhamah Shaan = Un Saari Shaano’n Ke Ba
Wajood
Ba Saaya Kashaan = Garmi O Dhoop Se Bachao Ke
Liye Saaya Karna
Mawakib Shaan = Unke Lashkar

    Mafhoom :-
     Ta’reef O Tauseef Ki Alamatien Ho Zamane Ko
Noor Ki Khairat Ya Chaand Aur Suraj Ho! Huzoor ﷺ
Ki Mohabbat O Hamdaardi Tamaam Shaano’n Ke
Saath Har Waqt Saya Afgan Hai. Saari Faujien  (
Insan,Jinn,Farishtey)Aap Ke Zair E Farmaan Hai Aur
Balke Jahaan Ki Ye Saari Naam O Namood Aap Hi Ke
Liye Hain.

  ‘Ataa E Arab Jala E Karab Fuyooz E ‘Ajab
               Baghair E Talab
  Ye Rehmat E Rab Hai Kis Ke Sabab Ba Rabb E
            Jahaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Arab = Sau Carod
Jala E Karab = Dukh Door Kare

                    160

Fuyooz = Faida
Ajab = Ajeeb
Baghair E Talab = Bin Maange
Ba Rabb E Jahaan = Jahaan Ke Parwardigar Ki Qasam

    Mafhoom :-
    Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Carodo’n Arbo’n Ataaien
Aur Nawazishien Logo’n Ke Aaj Bhi Dukh Dard Door
Kar Rahi Hai Aur Qiyamat Ko Bhi Yahi Haal Hoga.
Aur Phir Maze Ki Baat Ye Hai Ke Aap ﷺ Ke Ye Be
Misaal Aur  Hairan Kun  Faide  Baghair Maange
Humien Mil Rahi Hain.

 Zunoob Fanaa ‘Uyoob E Habaa Quloob E Safaa
              Khutoob E Rawaa
Ye Khoob E ‘Ataa Kuroob E Zudaa Paye Dil O Jaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zunoob = Gunah
Fanaa = Khatam
Uyoob = Burayi
Khutoob = Bada Ahem Kaam
Rawaa = Jaiz

                    161

Zudaa = Yaani Hajat Poori Hona
Paye = Waaste

    Mafhoom :-
    Mehboob E Khuda ﷺ Ki Taraf Se Milne Waali
Ataaien Par To Zara Ghaur Karo Gunah Jal Kar Rakh
Ho Rahe Hain Hamari Badiyaa’n Khaak Ban Kar
Hawaa Me Ud Rahe Hain Ahle Imaan Ke Dil Sheesha
Ki  Tarah  Saaf  Ho  Rahe  Hain  Bade  Bade
Masail,Museebatien Ke Pahad Jal Kar Bhasm Ho Rahe
Hai Ye Ataaien Jo Hamare Dard O Alam Ko Khata Ka
Rahe Hain Jin Se Hamare Dil O Jaan Ko Jaan Ke Laale
Pade Huwe The,Batate Kyun Nahi Ye Humien Kis Ki
Qadmo’n Ke Tufail Mili Hai? Aye Mere Aaqa Ye Sab
Kuch Aap Hi Ki Wajah Se Mili Hain’

 Nah Jinn O Bashar Ke Aathon Paher Malaik Dar
              Pe Bastah Kamar
  Nah Jubbah O Sar Ke Qalb O Jigar Hain Sajda
           Kunaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aath Paher = Har Waqt
Malaik = Farishtey

                    162

Dar = Darwaza Darwaza
 Basta Kamar = Kamar Bandhe Khidmat Ke Liye Har
Waqt Tayyar
Jubbah = Peshani
Sajda Kunaan = Sajda Karne Waala
    Mafhoom :- Aye Ghulaman E Mustafa ﷺ Zara
Apne Aaqa ﷺ Ke Roza E Pak Ki Dar E Pak Ki Shaan
To Dekho Na Sirf Jinn O Insaan Balke Har Waqt
Farishtey Aap Ke Dar E Aqdas Pe Khidmat Ke Liye
Haath Baandhe Khade Hain Aur Peshani O Sar Se
Nahi Balke Dil O Jaan Se Aap ﷺ Ke Liye Jhuk Rahe
Hain.

Nah Rooh E Ameen Nah ‘Arsh E Bari Nah Lawh E
          Mubeen Koi Bhi Kaheen
   Khabar Hi Nahi Jo Ramzien Khuleen Azal Ki
            Nihaan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Rooh E Ameen = Jibrael Alaihissalam
Arsh E Bari = Buland Takht
Lawh E Mubeen = Loh E Mehfooz
Ramzien = Posheeda Baatien
Nihaan = Chupi Huwi

                    163

Mafhoom :-
     Shab E Meraj Jo Raaz Ki Baatien Aye Mere
Aaqa Aap Ko Btayi Gayi Unki Jibraeel E Ameen Ko
Bhi Kya Khabar  , Arsh E Bari Ko Kya Pata,Loh E
Mehfooz Ko Kya Maloom ,Algaraz Khuda Jaane Ya
Uska Pyaara Mustafa Jaane Uske Ilawa Azal Ki
Posheeda Baatien Ka Khulna Kisi Ko Ma’loom Nahi
Aur Jis Par Bhi Ye Raaz Khule Aap Ke Kholne Se Hi
Khule.


Jinaan Me Chaman,Chaman Me Saman,Saman Me
          Phaban,Phaban Me Dulhan
 Sazaa E Mihan Pe Aise Minan Ye Amn O Amaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Jinaan = Jannatien
Chaman = Baagh
Saman = Phool
Phaban = Zebaaish
Sazaa E = Takleef
Mihan = Mehnat , Mashaqqat
Minan = Ehsaan
Amn O Amaan = Aaram O Sukoon

                    164

Mafhoom :- Jannato’n Ek Baagh,Baagho’n Me
Phool,Phoolo’n Me Jannat Ki Khushboo Aur Rang Ki
Sajawat Aur Unme Dulhan Jannat Ki Hooro’n Ka
Nazara Ye Sab Kuch Aap Ke Tufail Aap Ke Gunahgar
