Ummati Ke Liye Hogaya To Ye Apne Gunaho’n Ki
Wajah Se Azaab Ke Qaabil The Lekin Aap Ki Pakeeza
Shfa’at Unka Sahra Ban Ke Jannat Me Le Gayi Aur Ye
Saari Ne’matien Unke Liye Hogayi.

   Kamal E Mihaan Jalaal E Shihaan Jamaal E
          Hisaan Me Tum Ho ‘Iyaan
  Ke Saare Jahaan Ba Roz E Fakaan Zil E Aaina
             Saan Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kamal = Khoobi
Mihaan = Sardaar
Jalaal = Roab O Dab Daba
Shihaan = Baadshah
Jamal = Khubsoorti
Hisaan = Husn Waale
Iyaan = Zaahir
Ba Roz E Fakaan = Youm E Takhleeq
Zil = Saaya
Aaina Saan = Aisa Sheesha ,Maanind,Misaal
                    165

Mafhoom :-
    Bade Bade Sardaaro’n Ka Jaho Jalal Aur Fazl O
Kamaal,Bade Bade Baadshaho’n Ka Roab O Dabdaba
Aur Haseenan E Aalamka Husn O Jamal Aap Hi Ki
Zaat Se Zaahir Huwa Hai Kyun Ke Tamaam Jahaano’n
Ke Wajood Ka Saaya Aap Ki Zaat Ke Aaina Aks E
Jamal Se Hi Mila Hai . Aur Saare Jahaan Me Sirf Aap
Hi Ke Noor Ke Jalwa Aarayi Hai.

  Ye Toor Kuja Sipar To Kya Ke Arsh E Ulaa Bhi
                Door Raha
   Jihat Se Wara Wisaal Mila Ye Rifa’t E Shaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Toor = Pahad Ka Naam
Kuja = Kahan
Sipar = Dhaal Muraad Aasmaan
Arsh E Ulaa = Buland Arsh
Jihat = Simt,Taraf
Waraa = Upar
Wisaal = Mulaqat
Rif’ate Shaan = Azmath O Bulandi
    Mafhoom :- Kahan Musa Alaihissalam Ka Toor
Aur Kahaan Aasmaan, Yahaan To Arsh E Mualla Ki
                    166

Bhi Daal Na Gale,Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Na Daayan Na
Baayan La Makaan Wo Hai Jo In Shash  Jihato’n Se
Wara Hai Kyun Ke Khaliq E Noor Se Mulaqat Thi Jo
Jism O Jismaaniyat Se Pak Hai Lihaza Wahan Ka
Mahol Bhi Simt Se Pak Hai Ye Bulandi Aur Rif’at Ka
Maqam Bhi Sirf Aap Hi Ke Liye Hain.

   Khaleel O Naji, Maseeh O Safi, Sabhi Se Kahi
              Kaheen Bhi Bani
 Ye Be Khabari Ke Khalq Phiri Kahan Se Kahaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kahi = Bola,Poocha
Bani ? = Baat Bani?
Khalq = Makhlooq

    Mafhoom :-
    Maidan E  Mehshar Me  Har  Nabi  Se Ye
Makhlooq Ne Shafa’t Ki Talab Ki Lekin Kahin Bhi
Nahi Mili Phir Ye Saari Makhlooq Aap Hi Ki Taraf
Aap Hi Ke Liye Aap Ki Shafa’t Ki Bheek Maangne
Aayi Hai.


                    167

Bafowr E Sadaa Samaan Ye Bandha Ye Sidra Uttha
           Wo Arsh Jhuka
  Sufoof E Samaa Ne Sajda Kiya Huwi Jo Azaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bafowr = Achanak
Sadaa = Awaaz
Samaa = Manzar
Sufoof = Saf Ki Jama’ , Farishto’n Ki Qataarien
Samaa = Aasmaan

    Mafhoom :-
     Shab E Meraj Jab Upar Ki Duniya Me Mere
Aaqa ﷺ Ki Tashreef Aawari Huwi To Elaan Huwa
Sidratul Muntaha Apni Jagah Se Uthh Khada Huwa
Aur Arsh E Mualla Bhi Huzoor ﷺ Ke Isteqbal Ke
Liye Jhuk Gaya Aur Har Taraf Se Durood O Salaam
Ki Awaazien Aayi To Ajeeb Samaa Tha Ke Tamam
Farishtey Huzoor ﷺ Ki Amad Par Allah Ka Shukr
Ada Karne Ke Liye Sajde Me Gire Huwe The Aur
Awaazien   Ho   Rahi   Thi   Ashadu   Anna
Mohammadarasulallah ﷺ Ye Sab Kuch Huwa Aap
Hi Ke Liye.

                    168

Ye Marhmatien Ke Kacchi Matien Na Chore Latein
            Na Apni Gatien
Qusoor Karien Aur Unse Bharien Qusoor E Jinaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkl Alfaz :-
Marhamatien = Nawaazishien
Matien = Kamzor Aql Waale,Jinki Mat Maari Gayi
Hai
Lateen = Buri Aadat , Lat Pad Jaana Gunah Ki
Gatien = Haalat,Zillat Uthane Waali Haalat
Qusoor = Gunah
Qusoor = Mehal
Jinaan = Jannatien

    Mafhoom :- Ham Kam Aqal Hai Ki Apni Buri
Aadatien Nahi Chor Pa Rahe Hain Aur Gunah Par
Gunah Kiye Ja Rahe Hain,Iske Ba Wajood Bhi Aap Ki
Nawaazishat Hum Pe Qaaim O Daaim Hai,Na Sirf
Duniya Me Nahi Balke Aalam E Aakhirat Me Bhi
Jannat Ke Mohallat Inhi Gunahgaaro’n Ke Saath Bhar
Dengey.


                    169

Fanaa Badarat Baqaa Ba Barat Ze Har Do Jihat
                Bagird E Sarat
 Hay Markaziyat Tumhari Sifat Ke Dono Kamaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ba Darat = Aap Ke Darwaze Par
Baqaa = Zindagi
Be Barat = Aap Ke Daaman Me
Ze Har Do Jihat = Dono Taraf Se
Bagird E Sarat = Aap Ke Sar E Anwar Ke Ird Gird
Markaziyyat = Markaz Hona
Dono Kamaan = Duniya Aur Aakhirat

    Mafhoom :- Fana O Maut Ho Ya Barzakh O
Zindagi,Sab Aap Ke Dar E Aqdas Ke Laundiyaa’n Hai
Aur Do Kamaano’n Ki Tarah Aap Ke Sar E Anwar Ke
Ird Gird Dono Taraf Maujood Haazir Hain Magar
Markaziyyat Aap Hi Ke Zaat Ko Haasil Hai.


 Ishaare Se Chaand Cheer Diya Chupe Huwe Khur
              Ko Pher Liya
 Gaye Huwe Din Ko ‘Asr Kiya Ye Taab O Tawaan
               Tumhare Liye

                    170

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Cheerdiya = Do Tukde Kiya
Khur = Suraj
Taab O Tawaan = Quwwat O Taqat

    Mafhoom :-
    Aap Ka  Ishaara Ho To Chaand Do Tukde
Hojaaye Aur Aap Dua Farma Dein To Dooba Huwa
Suraj Unhi Qadmo’n Se Waapis Phire Aur Din Jo
Khatam Ho Chuka Tha Wo Asr Ke Waqt Par Aajaye
Ta Ke Hazrath E Ali Ki Namaz Ada Ho Qaza Nah O
Ye Taqat Aye Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ke Siwa Kahi Aur
Nazar Nahi Aati.

Sabaa Wo Chale Ke Bagh Phale Wo Phool Khile Ke
               Din Ho Bhale
  Liwaa Ke Tale Sanaa Me Khule Raza Ki Zubaan
               Tumhare Liye

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sabaa = Hawa
Phale = Phal Jaaye
Khule = Phool Ban Jaye
Liwaa = Liwa Ul Hamd

                    171

Tale = Niche
Sana = Tareef

    Mafhoom :-
     Aisi Baad E Saba Chale Ke Jo Baghaat Me Phal
Aur Phool Khila De Aur Na Sirf Phool Khile Hamare
Naseeb Bhi Khilein Aur Qiyamat Ke Din Liwa Ul
Hamd Haath Me Pakad Kar Jab Mehboob E Khuda
Nikle To Us Waqt Ahmed Raza Ko Zabaan Se Kuch
Kehne Ki Ijazat Hojaaye To Meri Baat Banjaaye To
Meri Zubaan Aye Mere Aaqa Wahan Bhi Aap Hi Ki
Tareef Me Khule.





                    172

(18)
 Lam Yaati Nazeeruka Fee Nazarin Mithle To Na
             Shud Paida Jaana
Jag Raaj Ko Taaj Tore Sarso Hai Tujhko Shahe Do

sections.title: Saraa Jaana

blocks.text:
Saraa Jaana

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Lam Yaati Nazeeruka Fee Nazarin = Aap Ka Misl
Kisi Ko Nazar Nahi Aaya
Mithle Tu Shud Paida Jaana = Aap Ki Tarah Koi
Paida Huwa Hi Nahi
Jag Raaj Ko Taaj Tore Sar So = Saare Jahano’n Ka
Taaj Aap Hi Ke Sar Par Sajaa Hai
    Mafhoom :- Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Jaisa To
Na Kabhi Dekha Gaya Hai Na Dekha Jayega Kyun Ke
Allah Ta’ala Ne Aap Jaisa Koi Paida Hi Nahi Farmaya.
Jahano’n Ki Baadhshahi Aap Hi Ko Sajti Hai Is Liye
Hum Ne Aap Ko Jahaano’n Ka Baadshah Maan Liya
Hai.

 Al Bahru A’laa Wal Mauju Taghaa Mann Bekas O
              Toofan Hosh Ruba
 Manjdhaar Me Hoon Bigdi Hai Hawa Mori Nayya
               Paar Laga Jaana

                    173

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Al Bahru A’laa Wal Mauju Taghaa  =  Samundar
Ooncha Gehra Hai Aur Maujien Tughyaani Par (Josh
Par)
Mann Bekas O Toofan Hosh Ruba = Main Majboor
Hoon Aur Toofan Hosh Uda Raha Hai
Manjhdaar Me Hoon Bigdi Hai Hawa  =  Main
Bhanwar Me Phans Gaya Aur Hawa Mukhalifat Ki
Simt Se Tez Chal Rahi Hai
Mori Nayya Paar Laga Jaana = Aaqa Meri Kashti
Kinaare Par Lagaa Dien

    Mafhoom :-
    Bad Amali O Bad  Aqeedgi Ka Samundar
Toofani Par Hai Aur Mai Akela Usme Ghera Huwa
Hoon ,Kashti Bhanwar Me Phansi Huwi Hai Khudara
Meri Madad Farma Kar Is Muqable Me Kamiyaab
Karwa Kar Meri Kasthi Kinaare Laga Dijiye.

 Ya Shamsu Nazarti Ilaa Lailee Chu Ba Taiba Rasi
                 ‘Arz E Ba Kuni
 Tori Jowt Ki Jhaljhal Jag Me Rachi Mori Shab Ne
           Na Din Hona Jaana

    Mushkil Alfaz :-

                    174

Ya Shamsu Nazarti Ilaa Lailee = Aye Suraj Tu Ne
Meri Raat Ko Dekha  , Masaib Ki Sakhti Ki Taraf
Ishara Hai
Chu Ba Taiba Rasi ‘Arz E Ba Kuni = Jab Tu Madine
Se Guzre To Meri Haalat Mere Mehboob Ke Saamne
Bayan Karna
Tori Jowt Ki Jhaljhal Jag Me Rachi = Aap Ke Noor
Se Tamam Jahaan Roshan Hai
Meri Shab Ne Na Din Honaa Jaana = Magar Meri
Raat Hai Ke Din Hone Ka Naam Nahi Leti

    Mafhoom :- Aye Dopahar Ke Suraj Tu Ne Mere
Mushkilat Ki Raat Ko Apni Aankh Se Dekha Hai Ke
Tere Hote Huwe Bhi Din Na Huwa Hai Lihaza Jab
Mere Mehboob Ki Nagri Se Guzre To Habeeb Ko Meri
Haalat E Zaar Arz Kardena Ke Aaqa Aap Ke Noor Ne
To Zamana Roshan Kardiya Mai Abhi Tak Hijr O
Firaq Ki Tareeki Me Dooba Huwa Hoon Aur Meri Aap
Se Doori Ki Raat Aap Ki Bargha Me Haazri Se Din
Nahi Huwi Hai.


 Laka Badrun Fil Wajhil Ajmal Khat Haala E Mah
                 Zulf Abr E Ajil
  Tore Chandan Chandar Paro Kundal Rahmat Ki
            Bharan Barsaa Jaana
                    175

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Laka Badrun Fil Wajhil Ajmal = Aap Ke Chehre E
Haseen Me Chaudvi Raat Ka Chaand Tulu’ Hota
Dikhaayi Deta Hai
Khat Haala E Mah Zulf Abr E Ajil = Daadhi Mubarak
Chaand Ki Gird Halqa Lagta Hai Aur Zulf Mubarak
Taqdeer Ka Zabardast Baadal Hai
Tore Chandan Chandar Paro Kundal = Sandal Jaise
Chehre Pe Ye Bata Raha Hai
Rahmat Ki Bharan Barsa Jaana = Ab Baarish Aayi Ke
Aayi

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Aap Ka Haseen O Jameel
Chehra To Chaudvi Ka Chaand Lagta Hai Aur Aap Ki
Daadhi Mubarak Chaand Ki Gird Haala Ka Manzar
Pesh Kar Rahi Hai Aur Suna Hai Ke Chaand Ke Gird
Haala Pad Jaaye To Baarish Zaroor Hoti Hai Lihaza
Mujh Ghareeb O Bekas Par Apni Rehmat Ki Baarish
Barsa Jaaye.

  Ana Fi Atashin Wa Sakha Ka Atam Aay Gesuye
            Pak Aye Abre Karam
  Barsan Hare Rimjhim Rimjhim Do Boond Idhar
               Bhi Gira Jaana
                    176

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ana Fi Atashin Wa Sakha Ka Atam = Main Pyasa
Hoon Aur Aap Ki Sakhawat Kaamil O Mukammal Hai
Aye Gesuye Pak Aye Abre Karam = Aye Pak Gesuo’n
Karam Ke Baadalo’n
Barsan Hare Rimjhim Rimjhim  =  Halki Baarish
Barsaane Waalo
Do Boond Idhar Bhi Gira Jaana = Idhar Mere Upar
Bhi Do Qatre Gira Do

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Mai To Aap
Ke Hijr O Firaq Me Pyaas Se Mar Raha Hoon Aur Aap
Ki Sakhawat Me Bhi Koi Shak Nahi Aap Apne Karam
Ki Hamesha Barasne Waali Baarish Se Mere Daaman
Me Bhi Do Qatre Gira Dien.

  Ya Qafilatee Zeede Ajalak Rahme Bar Hasrate
                 Tishna Labak
 Mora Jiyara Larje Darak Darak Taiba Se Abhi Na
               Sunaa Jaana


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ya Qafilatee Zeede Ajalak = Aye Qaafile Waalo’n
Apne Qiyam Ki Mudaat Zyada Karo

                    177

Rahme Bar Hasrate Tishna Labak = Hasrat Ke Maare
Pyaase Labo’n Par Reham Karo
Mora Jiyara Larje Darak Darak = Mera Dil Ghabra
Raha Hai ,Laraz Raha Hai
Taiba Se Abhi Na Sunaa Jaana = Madine Se Jaane Ki
Khabar Abhi Na Suna

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere  Qaafile  Waalo’n Mere  Saathiyo
Khuda Ke Liye Madine Ka Qiyaam Badha Do Kyun
Ke Tum Madine Se Jaan Eki Baat Karte Ho To Mera
Dil Ghabra Kar Dhadak Dhadak Karta Hai Aur Jaan
Nikal Nikal Jaati Hai.Isliye Abhi Jaane Ki Khabar Na
Sunana.

 Wa Aahan Lisooway’aatin Zahabat Aan Ahad E
            Huzoor Baar E Gahat
   Jab Yaad Awat Mohe Kar Na Parat Darda Wo
             Madina Ka Jaana

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Wa Aahan Lisooway’aatin Zahabat = Haaye Afsos
Chand Hi Ghadiyaanthi Guzar Gayi
Aan Ahad E Huzoor Baar E Gahat = Aap Ki Bargah
Ki Hazri Ki
                    178

Jab Yaad Awat Mohe Kar Na Parat = Jab Mujhe Aap
Ki Bargah Me Haazri Ka Manzar Yaad Aata Hai
Darda Wo Madina Ka Jaana = Ke Takleef Ke Parwa
Kiye Baghair Madine Me Jaa Raha Tha
    Mafhoom :- Haaye Afsos Ke Madina Shareef Mi
Qiyam Ke Liye Chand Ghadiyaan Mili Jo Guzar Bhi
Gayi.

  Al Qalbu Shajin Wal Hammu Shujoon Dil Zaar
         Chunaa Jaan Zer O Chunoo
 Pat Apni Bipat Mai Kaa Se Kahoo Mera Kaun Hai
                Tere Siwa Jaana

     Mushkil Alfaz :-
Al Qalbu Shajin Wal Hammu Shjoon = Dil Zakhmi
Hai Aur Pareshaaniyaa’n Beshumaar Hai
Dil Zaar Chunaa Jaan Zer O Chunoo = Dil Faryaad
Kunaa Hai Jaan Bohat Kamzor Hai
Pat Apni Bipat Mai Kaa Se Kahoo = Apna Dukhda
Kis Se Kahun
Mera Kon Hai Tere Siwa Jaana = Aap Ke Siwa Mera
Ha Ikon
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Mera Dil Aap
Ki Judaayi Me Betaab Hai Aur Us Par Mazeed Ye Hai

                    179

Tarah Tarah Ke Aalam O Masaaib Ne Ghera Huwa Hai
Huzoor Mera Aap Ke Siwa Kon Hai Jis Se Mai Apna
Dukh Bayan Karun.

 Arruhu Fidaaka Fazid Harqaa Yak Sho’la Digar
               Barzan ‘Ishqaa
Mora Tan Man Dhan Sab Phoon Diya Ye Jaan Bhi
              Pyaare Jalaa Jaana

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Arruhu Fidaaka Fazed Harqaa = Meri Jaan Aap Par
Qurbaan Zara Ishq Ki Aag Aur Badhaayiye
Yak Sho’la Digar Barzan Ishqaa = Apne Ishq Ki Ek
Aur Chingaari Mere Dil Par Rakhiye
Mora Tan Man Dhan Sab Phoonk Diya = Mera Saara
Jism To Jal Chuka Hai
Ye Jaan Bhi Pyaare Jala Jaana = Aaqa Ye Jaan Mai
Kya Karunga Is Ko Bhi Jalaa Dijiye

    Mafhoom :-
     Meri Rooh Aap ﷺ Ke Qurbaan Mere Aaqa Aap
Ki Mohabbat Ki Aag Ne To Mera Sab Kuch Jala Diya
Hai Ek Sho’la Aur Inayat Farmaye Taa Ke Jaa Bhi Aap
Ke Ishq Me Jala Doon.

                    180

Bas Khaamae Khaam E Nawaa E Raza Na Ye Tarz
            Meri Na Ye Rang Mera
  Irshaad E Ahibba Naatiq Tha Naachaar Is Raah
                 Parra Jaana

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bas Khaamae Khaam E Nawaa E Raza = Ahmed Raza
Ka Kamzor Qalamna Ye Tarz Meri Na Ye Rang Mera
= Mera Andaaz Ye Nahi Hai
Irshaad E Ahibba Naatiq Tha = Dosto’n Ke Israar Ne
Majboor Kiya
Naachaar Is Raah Parra Jaana  =  Majbooran Unki
Farmaish Poora Karna Pada

    Mafhoom :-
    Main Is Qaabil Kahaan Ke Chaar Zabano’n Me
Ashaar Likhoon Bas Dosto’n Nemohabbat Bhara
Israar Kiya To Apni Na Tajrube Kaari Ke Ba Wajood
Majbooran Chand Ashaar Kah Diya Ya Ahbaab E
Naatiq Se Muraad Do Sho’raa Me Ek Naatiq Naami
Shayar Huwa Guzra Aur Doosre Aap Ke Khalifa
Hazrath Muhiba Bhikri ,Jinho Ne Chaar Zabaano’n Me
Kalam Lihne Ki Farmaish Ki Thi.



                    181

(19)
 Utha Do Parda Dikha Do Chehra Ke Noor E Baari
                Hijaab

sections.title: Me Hai

blocks.text:
Me Hai
  Zamana Tareek Ho Raha Hai Ke Mehr Kab Se
               Niqaab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Baari = Paida Karne Waala
Mehr = Suraj
Niqab,Hijaab = Parda
    Mafhoom  :- Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ  Aap Ka
Chehra Mubarak Agar Parde Me Hoto Goya Noor E
Khuda Parde Me Hojata Hai Isliye Ke Aap Hi To Noor
E Khuda Hai Aur Aap Ka Rukh E Pur Anwar Parde
Me Rehne Se Ek Baar Phir Zamane Pe Zulm,Jihalat,Be
Deeni Ke Siyaah Baadal Chaa Gaye Hain Aur Bas Ab
Yahi  Intezaar Hai Ke Aasmaan E Nabuwaat Ka
Aaftaab Apna Chehra E Anwar Parde Se Nikale Aur
Har Taraf Noor Hi Noor Phail Jaaye.

   Jali Jali Bu Se Uski Paida Hai Sozish E Ishq E
             Chashme Waala
Kabaab E Aahu Me Bhi Na Paaya Mazah Jo Dil Ke
              Kabaab Me Hai
                    182

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Jali Jali Bu =  Kisi Shay’i Ke Aag Par Jalne Se Jo
Paida Ho
Sozish = Jalan
Chashme Waala = Azmath Waali Aankh
Aahu = Haran

    Mafhoom :- Ishq E Rasool Aur Furqat E Rasool
ﷺ Ki Aag Me Dil Ke Jalne Ki Jo Halki Halki Bu
Aarahi Hai Ye Mere Aaqa Ke Mubarak Aankho’n Ki
Ishq Ki Sozish Se Paida Huwi Hai Aur Is Dil Ke Ishq
E Rasool Me Kabaab Hone Me Jo Lazzat Hai Bhala
Wo Hiran Ke Kabaabo’n Me Kahaan Ho Sakti Hai.

  Unheen Ki Bu Maaya E Saman Hai Unheen Ka
          Jalwa Chaman Chaman Hai
 Unheen Se Gulshan Mehak Rahe Hai Unheen Ki
            Rangat Gulaab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bu = Khushboo
Maaya E Saman = Chumbuli Ka Sarmaya
Chaman Chaman = Baagh
Rangat = Rang

                    183

Mafhoom :-
    Mere Aaqa ﷺ  Ki Khushboo Chumbuli Ke
Phool Ka Sarmaya Hai Aur Baaghaat Huzoor ﷺ Hi
Ke Jalwe Se Baagh Baagh Hai Gulshan Unhi Ke
Khsuhboo Se Mehak Rahe Hain Aur Gulab Ke Phool
Ka Husn Bhi Marhoon Mannat Hai.


  Teri Julu Hai Maah E Taiba Hilaal Har Marg O
                  Zindagi Hai
Hayaat Jaan Ka Rikaab Me Hai Mamaate Aa’da Ka
               Daab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Julu = Ikhtiyaar Me
Maah E Taiba = Aye Madine Ke Chaand
Hilaal = Pehli Raat Ka Chand
Marg = Mout
Hayaat Jaan = Jaan Ki Zindagi
Rikaab = Lo Ka Halqa Jispe Paun Rakh Kar Suwaar
Suwaari Huwe Hain
Mamaate Aa’da = Dushmano’n Ki Mout
Daab = Qabze Me
    Mafhoom :- Aye Madine Ke Chaand Aaqa ﷺ
Zindagi Aur Mout Ka Kamzor Saa Chaand Aap Hi Ke

                    184

Zere Saaya Tulu Ho Raha Hai Aap Hi Ki Nigah E
Rehmat Se Patthar Dil Ko Bhi Zindagi Naseeb Ho
Rahi Hai Aur Darakht Bhi Rawaa Dawaa Hai ,Ahle
Emaan Ki Rooh O Jaan Bhi Aap Ki Qadmo’n Ke
Neeche Hai Aur Dushman Ki Maut Bhi Aap Ke Qabze
O Ikhtiyaar Me Hai

Siyaah Libaasaan E Daar Duniya Wa Sabz Poshaan
           E Arsh E Aa’laa
 Har Ik Hai Unke Karam Ka Pyaasa Ye Faiz Unke
               Janaab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Libaasa,Poshaan = Libaas Pehanne Waale
Karam = Bakhshish
    Mafhoom :- Is Duniya Ke Siyaah Libaas Waale
Insaan Ho Ya Aalam E Baala Ke Sabz Rang Ka Libaas
Pahenne Waale Farishte Ho, Sab Ke Sab Huzoor E
Anwar O Akram ﷺ Ki Rehmat Ke Pyaase Hai Aur
Sab Ko Faiz Aap Hi Ki Bargah Se Milta Hai.

 Wo Gul Hai Labhaaye Naazuk Unke Hazaaro’n
            Jhadte Hain Phool Jinse
   Gulaab Gulshan Me Dekhe Bulbul Ye Dekh
           Gulshan Gulaab Me Hai
                    185

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Gul = Phool
Labhaaye = Honto’n
Gulshan = Baagh

    Mafhoom  :- Aaqa E Do  Jahaan ﷺ  Ke
Labhaaye Mubarak Bhi Kaise Ajeeb Shaan Rakhte
Hain , Gulaab Se Bhi Zyada Narm O Naazuk Aur Jab
Aap Un Labo’n Ko Harkat Dete Hain To Quran O
Hadees Ke Hazaaro’n Phool Unse Bar Aamad Hote
Hain ,Baagh Me Phool To Aye Bulbul Tune Bohat
Dekhe Hai Lekin Zara Idhar Bhi Dekh Saara Gulshan
Hamare Phool Aaqa ﷺ Me Samaya Huwa Hai.

   Jail Hai Soz E Jigar Se Jaan Tak Hai Taalib E
              Jalwa E Mubaarak
Dikha Do Wo Lab Ke Aab E Haiwaan Ke Lutf Jinke
                Khitaab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aab E Haiwaan = Zindagi Dene Waala Paani
Khitaab = Bayan O Kalam
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Meri Jaan Jo
Aap Ke Noorani Jalwe Ki Tamanna Me Jal Chuki Hain

                    186

Usko Ek Baar Aap Ke Labhaaye Mubarak Ka Deedar
Ata Ho. Jin Honto’n Se Jab Aap Kalam Farmate Hain
To Aab E Hayaat Ki Lazzat Naseeb Hoti Hai.

Khade Hain Munkar Nakeer Sar Par Na Koi Haami
             Na Koi Yaawar
 Bata Do Aakar Mere Payambar Ke Sakht Mushkil
              Jawaab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Haami = Himayat,Tarafdaari Karne Waala
Yaawar = Madadgaar

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Aaqa Qabr Ki Andheri
Kotdi Me Qabr Ke Farishte Mere Sar Par Khade Huwe
Hain,Aap Ke Siwa Koi Haami Aur Madadgaar Nazar
Nahi Aata, Mushkil Me Hoon Tashreef Laa Kar Qabr
Ko Munawwar Farmaye Aur Apne Gunahgar Ko
Bataye Ke Un ﷺ Sawaalo’n Ka Jawab Kya Dena Hai.

   Khuda E Qahhar Hai Ghazab Par Khule Hai
            Badkaariyo’n Ke Daftar
Bacha Lo Aakar Shafi’ E Meshar Tumhaara Banda
                ‘Azaab Me Hai

                    187

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Qahhar = Qahr O Ghazab Karne Waala
Daftar = Register,Naama E Aamal

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ  Allah Ta’ala Aaj Poori
Shaan E Qaharriyat O Jabariyyat Ka Izhar Farma Raha
Hai Aur Uske Saamne Mere Gunaho’n Ka Register
Khule Huwe Hain,Kisi Ko Bhi Majaal Nahi Ke Kuch
Arz Kare, Bas Meri Nigah Aap Hi Ko Dhoond Rahi
Hai.Tashreef Laaye Aur Jahannum Se Ghulam Ko
Bachaaye.

 Kareem Aisa Mila Ke Jiske Khule Hain Haath Aur
              Bhare Khazaane
  Batao Aye Mufliso Ke Phir Kyun Tumhara Dil
                  Izteraab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Mufliso = Mohtajo’n
Izteraab = Pareshani

    Mafhoom  :- Humien Allah Kareem Ne Aisa
Kareem Nabi Ata Farmaya Hai Ke Jiske Haath Dene

                    188

Ke Liye Har Waqt Khule Hain Aur Uske Khazane
Bhare Huwe Hain ,Phir Zara Batao To Aye Munkiro’n
Tumhara Dil Kyun Dhadak Raha Hai Ke Kaise Guzara
Hoga.

  Gunah Ki Taareekiyaam Ye Chaayi Umand Ke
              Kaali Ghataayien Aain
 Khuda Ke Khursheed Mehr Farma Ke Zarra Bas
                  Izteraab Me Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Umand = Josh
Khursheed = Suraj
Mehr = Mehrbani
Zarra = Haqeer Aur Mamoli Shayi
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Rehmat Waale Aaqa ﷺ
Gunaho’n Ki Siyaahi Hume Gher Rakha Hai ,Aye
Allah  Ta’ala Ke Nabiyo’n Ke Sardaar Aaftab E
Nabuwaat Madni Aaqa ﷺ  Meherbaani Farmaye Is
Naa Chiz Zarre Par.

 Kareem Apne Karam Ka Sadqa La Eeme Be Qadr
             Ko Na Sharma
 Tu Aur Raza Se Hisaab Lena Raza Bhi Koi Hisaab
              Me Hai
                    189

Mushkil Alfaz :-
La Eeme = Kameena , Ghatiya
Be Qadr = Be Haisiyyat

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Aaqa Aap Ko Apne Hi Karam Ka
Sadqa Is Kameene Aur Be Qadre Insaan Ka Hisaab
Lekar Ise Sharmsaaz Na Kijiye. Ye Ahmed Raza
Bechara Is Qaabil Hi Nahi Ke Isse Hissab Liya Jaaye.





                    190

(20)
 Wah Kya Jood O Karam Hai Shahe Bat’ha Tera

sections.title: Nahi Sunta Hi Nahi Maangne Waala Tera

blocks.text:
Nahi Sunta Hi Nahi Maangne Waala Tera


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Wah = Tajjub,Kya Baat Hai
Jood O Karam = Sakhawat O Meherbani
Shah = Baadshah
Bat’ha = Makka E Mukarrama

    Mafhoom :- Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ke Jood
O Sakhawat , Karam O Bakhshish Ke Kya Kehne Ke
Jo Bhi Maange Jo Jo Bhi Aap Ke Dar Pe Maangne
Waale Ne Suwal Kiya To Aap Ne Nahin Hai Kabhi
Nahi Kaha Balke Talab Se Zyada Hi Ata Karte Gaye.

Dhaare Chalte Hain Ataa Ke Wo Hain Qatraa Tera
  Taare Khilte Hain Sakha Ke Wo Hai Zarra Tera


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dhaare = Darya,Bulandi Se Girne Waala Paani
Zarra = Ma’mooli Si Shay’i
Sakha = Sakhawat

                    191

Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah Aap Ki Ata Ki Shaan Ye Hain
Ke Aap Qatra Dete Hain To Wo Darya Ban Jaata Hai
Aur Aap Zarra Dete Hain To Wo Sakhwat Ke Tare Ban
Jaate Hain.

      Faiz Hai Shah E Tasneem Nirala Tera
  Aap Pyaaso’n Ke Tajassus Me Hai Darya Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Tasneem = Jannat Ki Nehar
Nirala = Anokha
Tajassus = Talash

    Mafhoom :- Aye Jannat Ke Nehr Ke Malik! Aap
Ki Ata Bhi Badi Nirali Hai Ke Jiska Samandar Be
Paida Kinara Khud Pyaaso’n Ko Talash Karta Hain Ke
Unko Sairaab Kiya Jaaye.

  Aghniya Palte Hain Dar Se Wo Hai Baada Tera
  Asfiya Chalte Hain Sar Se Wo Hai Raasta Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
     Aghniya = Jama’ Maaldaar

                    192

Baada = Khairat
     Asfiya = Saaf Dil Waale

    Mafhoom  :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ  Aap Ke Dar Se  Sirf
Faqeero’n Ko Hi Nahi Balke Maaldaaro’n Ko Bhi
Nawaza Jaata Hai Aur Aap Ki Guzar Gaah Aisa Raasta
Hai Jahan Allah Ke Maqbool Bande Sar Ke Bal Chalna
Apne Liye Sa’adat Samjhte Hain.

  Farsh Waale Teri Shaukat Ka U’loo Kya Jaane
    Khusrawa Arsh Pe Udta Hai Pharera Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Farsh Waale = Zameen Waale
Shaukat = Ro’ab Dabdaba
U’loo = Bulandi
Khusrawa = Aye Khuda Ke Khudaayi Ke Baadshah
Pharera = Jhanda

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ki Azmath Ke Jhande
To Arsh Pe Leh Ra Rahe Hain, In Zameen Waalo’n Ko
Kya Pata Aap Ki Azmath O Shaan Kya Hai.

                    193

Aasmaan Khwaan Zameen Khwaan Zamana
               Mehmaan
    Sahib E Khana Laqab Kiska Hai Tera Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khwaan = Dastarkhwaan
Zamana = Waqt,Kul Kainaaat
Laqab = Wasfi Naam
Sahib E Khana = Ghar Waala,Mezbaan

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Ye Zameen Ye Aasman
Aap Ke Dastarkhwaan Hai Jin Par Saare Jahaano’n Ko
Ba Izzat Rozi Mil Rhi Hai Aur Mezbaan Aap Ki Zaat
E Ba Barkat Hai.


   Main To Malik Hi Kahunga Ke Ho Malik Ke
                  Habeeb
  Yaani Mehboob Ho Muhibb Me Nahi Mera Tera

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Main To Aap Ko Malik Hi
Kahunga Kyun Ba Zahir Ye Baat Tayi’ Hai Ke
Mehboob Aur Muhibb Ke Darmiyaan Ye Mera Hai Ye
                    194

Tera Hai Nahi Hota Jo Mehboob Ka Hota Hai Wo
Muhibb Ka Hota  Jo Muhibb Ka Hota Hai Wo
Mehboob Ka Hota Hai Goya Allah Ta’ala Sab Ka
Malik Hai Aur Aap Uski Ata Se Allah Ke Ilawa Har
Cheez Ke Malik Hai.


  Tere Qadmo’n Me Jo Hai Ghair Ka Munh Kya
                  Dekhe
   Kon Nazro’n Pe Chade Dekh Ke Talwa Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Qadmo’n Me Hona = Sohbat O Khidmat Me Hona
Ghair Ka Munh Dekhna = Doosro’n Ki Taraf Dekhna
Nazro’n Pe Chadna = Pasand Aa Jaana
Chade = Jache
    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ  Jo Aap Ke Qadmo’n Me
Aap Ke Ghulam Hai Wo Kaise Dunyavi Baadsho’n Ki
Taraf Dekhta Hai Kyun Ke Jis Ne Aap Ke Qadam
Mubarak Dekh Liya Wo Phir Kaise Kisi Haseen Se
Haseen Chehre Ko Dekhna Qubool Karega ?

 Behr E Saail Ka Hoon Saail Na Kunwe Ka Pyaasa
  Khud Bujha Jaaye Kaleja Mera Cheenta Tera
                    195

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Behr = Darya ,Samundar
Saail 1 = Pehanne Waala,Murad Zaat E Mustafa ﷺ
Saail 2 = Mangta
Kaleja = Dil O Jigar

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Mai Apni Pyaas Bujhane
Kisi Darya Ya Samundar Ke Paas Kyun Jaun Kya Aap
Ki Rehmat Ke Darya Ka Ek Cheenta Pyaas Bujhaane
Ke Liye Kaafi Nahi.

  Chor Haakim Se Chupa Karte Hain Yaan Uske
                      Khilaf
    Tere Daaman Me Chupe Chor Anokha Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Yaan = Yahan
Anokha = Nirala

    Mafhoom :-
     Saari  Duniya Me  Yahi  Dastoor  Hai  Ke
Chor,Mujrim Afsar Aur Police Waalo’n Se Chupne Ki
Koshish Me Hote Hain Magar Bargah E Risalat Ka

                    196

Muamla Uske Khilaaf Hai Allah Ta'ala Mujrimo’n Ko
Khud Apne Habeeb Ki Bargah Tak Bhej Raha Hain.

   Aankhien Thandi Ho Jigar Taaza Ho Jaanien
                    Sairaab
    Sacche Suraj Wo Dil Aara Hai Ujala Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aankhien Thandi Hona = Pareshaani Door Hona
Jigar Taaza Hona = Dil Bagh Bagh Hona
Jaanien Sairaab = Ruhani Sukoon Milna
Sacche Suraj = Haqeeqi Aftaab
Dil Aara = Dil Ko Roshsn Karne Waala
    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Wo Haqeeqi Aftab E
Nabuwwat O  Risalat Hai Ke Aap Ke Noor Se
Aankho’n Ko Noor Aur Dil Ko Suroor Naseeb Hota
Hai,Jigar Thanda Aur Rooh Ko Sukoon Milta Hai.

    Dil A’bas Khauf Se Patta Sa Udaa Jaata Hai
   Palla Halka Hi Sahi Bhari Hai Bharosa Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
A’bas = Befaida
                    197

Khauf = Aane Waali Halat Ki Pareshaani
Patta = Darakht Ka Patta
Palla = Tarazu Ka Ek Palda

    Mafhoom :-
Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Agarche Mera Dil Qiyamat Ke
Din Aamal Tole Jaane Ki Wajah Se Khauf Se Patte Ki
Tarah Uda Ja Raha Hai,Pareshaan Ho Raha Hai,Magar
Is Ka Is Qadar Darna Be Fazool Hai Kyun Ke Agarche
Mere Aamaal Ka Palla Halka Hi Sahi Magar Aap Ki
Shafa'at Ka Aasra To Halka Nahi Hai.

  Ek Main Kya Meri I’siyaan Ki Haqeeqat Kitni
  Mujh Se Sau Laakh Ko Kaafi Hai Ishaara Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
I’siyaan = Gunah
Kitni = Kis Qadar
Sau Laakh = Ek Carod
    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ  Mere Gunah Jitney Bhi
Sahi Aap Ke Shafa’at Ke Saamne Unki Haisiyyat Kitni
Aur Na  Sirf  Mai  Balke Mujh  Jaise  Carodo’n
Gunahgaro’n Ke Liye Aap Ka Ek Ishaara Kaafi Hai.

                    198

Muft Paala Tha Kabhi Kaam Ki Aadat Na Padi
  Ab Amal Poochte Hain Haaye Nikamma Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Muft = Baghair Qeemat
Nikamma = Bekaar

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ne Baghair Amal Ke
Allah Ki Ne’matien Ata Farmayi Jis Se Muft Khaane
Ki Aadat Pad Gayi Hai Aur Ab Marne Ke Baad
Farishte Mujh Nakaare Se Aamal Ka Taqaza Kar Rahe
Hai . Haaye Mai Kya Karun?

Tere Tukdo’n Pe Pale Ghair Ki Thokar Pe Na Daal
 Jhidkiyaa’n Khaaye Kahaan Chor Ke Sadqa Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ghair = Begana
Thokar = Paun Se Maarna , Murad Zillat O Ruswaayi

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Hum To Aap Ke Tukdo’n
Pe Palne Waale Hai,Humien Apne Qadmo’n Se Hata
                    199

Kar Doosro’n Ke Darwazo Par Thokarien Khaaane Se
Bachalien.Apne Darbaar Se Hatakar Ghairo’n Ke
Daant Dapat Ke Hawale Na Kijiye

 Khwaar O Beemar Khatawaar Gunahgaar Hoon
                  Mai
    Raafe’ Naafe’ O Shaafe’ Laqab Aaqa Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khwaar = Zaleel O Ruswa
Khatawaar = Mujrim
Raafe’ = Buland Karne Waala
Naafe’ = Nafa Pahunchane Waala
Shaafe’ = Shafa’at Karne Waala

    Mafhoom :- Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Agarche Mai
Zaleel O Khwaar  , Gunahgar Sahi Magar Aap To
Girto’n Ko Uthaane Waale Hain, Beemaro’n Ko Apni
Nigahe  Karam  Se  Accha  Karne  Waale,Aur
Gunahgaaro’n Ki Shafa’at Farmane Waale Jaise Ba
Barkat Naami Rakhte Hain.

   Meri Taqdeer Buri Ho To Bhali Karde Ke Hai
    Mehv O Isbat Ke Daftar Pe Katoda Tera

                    200

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Taqdeer = Qismat, Naseeb
Bhali = Behtar
Isbaat = Saabit Karna
Daftar = Register
Katoda = Qabza

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Meri Qismat Agar Kharaab
Hai To Aap Bigdi Banana Waale Hain Aur Qaza Aur
Qadr Par Aap Ka Qabza Hai Meri Buri Qismat Ko
Accha Kardena Aap K Liye Baaye Haath Ka Kaam
Hai.

  Tu Jo Chahe To Abhi Mail Mere Dil Ki Dhule
   Ke Khuda Dil Nahi Karta Kabhi Maila Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Mail = Matti Jo Badan Par Lagjaati Hai
Dhulien = Dhuljaaye

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ  Aap Ki Meherbaani Se
Mera Dil Gunaho’n Ki Mail Se Saaf Ho Sakta Hai,

                    201

Kyun Ke Aap Ke To Gunah Qareeb Bhi Nahi Aa Sakte
Kyun Ke Aap Sayyid Ul Ma’soomeen Hai.

 Kis Ka Munh Takiye Kahan Jaayiye Kis Se Kahiye
   Tere Hi Qadmo’n Pe Mit Jaaye Ye Paala Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Takna = Dekhna
Paala = Parvarish Kiya Huwa

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Jaise Banda Parwar Ko
Chor Kar Kisi Ki Taraf Lalchaayi Huwi Nigaaho’n Se
Dekhun Aur Apne Dukhde Sunane Ke Liye Kis Ke
Dar Par Jaaun Kyun Ke Siwaaye Mayoosi Ke Kisi Aur
Ke Paas Se Aur Kya Mil Sakta Hai.Lihaza Ye Maangta
Aap Ka Paala Huwa Aap Hi Ki Dar Par Mitjaaaye
Qubool Farma Lijiye.

      Tu Ne Islam Tu Ne Jama’at Me Liya
    Tu Kareem Ab Koi Phirta Hai Attiya Tera

    Mushkl Alfaz :-
Jama’at = Murad Ahle Sunnat Wa Jama’at
                    202

Phirta Hai = Wapis Hota Hai
Attiya = Ina’am

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Ye Aap Ka Kitna Bada
Ehsaan Hai Ke Aap Ne Mujhe Jannati Jama’at Me
Qubool Farmaliya Hai Jo Aap Ka Bohat Bada Ina’am
Hai Aur Kareem O Sakhi Diya Huwa Ina’am Waapis
Nahi Lete.

  Maut Sunta Hoon Talkh Hai Zehraab E Naab
 Kaun Laa De Mujhe Talwo’n Ka Ghasaala Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Talkh = Kadvi
Zehraab = Zehar Waala Paani
Naab = Khaalis
Ghasaala = Wo Paani Jis Se Aap ﷺ Ne Qadma
Mubarak Ko Dhoya

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Main Ne Suna Hai Ke Maut
Bohat Badi Aafat Aur Khaalis Zehar Hi Ki Tarah Hai
Lekin Kadvahat Ko Agar Koi Shay’i Mithaas Me

                    203

Badal Sakti Hai To Wo Aap ﷺ  Ke Qadmo’n Se
Utarne Waala Paani Hai,Kaash Mujhe Koi Laakar
Deta.

    Door Kya Jaaniye Badkaar Pe Kaise Guzre
    Tere Hi Dar Pe Mare Bekas O Tanha Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Dar = Darwaza
Bekas O Tanha = Be Yaar O Madadgaar

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Kya Maloom Aap Ke Dar
E Aqdas Se Dor Hojaun To Kis Museebat Se Guzrun
Lihaza Mujhe Aap Hi Ke Dar Par Marjaane Dijiye.


  Tere Sadqe Me Mujhe Ik Boond Bohat Hai Teri
   Jis Din Accho’n Ko Mile Jaam Chalakta Tera

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Jaam = Pyala
Chalakta = Bhara Huwa

                    204

Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ke Tufail Jis Din Aap
Ke Acche Ghulamo’n Ko Bhara Huwa Chalakta
Kausar Ka Jaam Milega To Mujh Gunahgaar Ko Bhi
Apne Jaam Ka Ek Boond Ata Kare Mere Liye Wahi
Kaafi Hai,

  Haram O Taiba O Baghdad Jidhar Kijiye Nigah
   Jaut Padhti Hai Tere Noor Hai Cheenta Tera


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Haram = Makka
Taiba = Madina
Jaut = Noor , Ujala
Cheenta = Zaahir Hona
    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Makka Ho Ya Madina Ho
Ya Baghdad Ho Ya Koi Bhi Muqaddas Maqam Jidhar
Bhi Nigah Utha Kar Dekha Jaaye Aap Hi Ke Noor Ke
Jalwe Nazar Aa Rahe Hai.

    Teri Sarkar Me Laata Hai Raza Usko Shafi’
    Jo Mera Ghaus Hai Aur Laadla Beta Tera

                    205

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Shafi’ = Sifaarish Karne Waala

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ki Bargah Me Sifarish
Ke Liye Main Mere Murshid Ghaus E Azam Ko Laata
Hoon Jo Mere Ghaus Hai Aur Laadla Beta Hai Tera.


                        (21)
   Wahi Rab Hai Jisne Tujhko Hamatan Karam
                  Banaya
     Humien Bheek Maangne Ko Tera Aastaan
                    Bataya

sections.title: Tujhe Hamd Hai Khudaya

blocks.text:
Tujhe Hamd Hai Khudaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Hamatan = Mukammal Taur Par
Aastaan = Choukat
Hamd = Tareef

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Hamara Parwardigar Bas
Wahi Akela Rab Hai Jis Ne Aap Ko Sarapa Karam Aur
                    206

Bakhish O Ata Banaya Hai Aur Us Ne Humien Us
Karam,Bakhsish Ki Bheek Maangne Ke Liye Aap Ki
Baargah Ka Raasta Dikhaya Hai. Aye Allah Hamd Ke
Laayiq To Sirf Teri Hi Zaat Hai.

  Tumhin Haakim E Baraayaa Tumhin Qaasim E
                    ‘Ataaya
   Tumhin Daaf’ E Balaaya Tumhin Shaaf’ E
                  Khataaya
            Koi Tum Sa Kaun Aaya

    Muhskil Alfaz :-
Baraaya = Makhlooq, Jahaan
Qaasim = Taqseem Karne Waala
‘Ataaya = Ata Karne Waala
Daaf’e = Door Karne Waala
Balaaya = Balaiyyat,Museebatien
Shaaf’e = Shifa’at Karne Waala
Khataaya = Gunah
Tum Sa = Tumhare Jaisa

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Allah Ta’ala Ne Aap
Hi Ko Tamaam Jahaano’n Ka Haakim Banaya Hai .

                    207

Aap ﷺ  Hi Allah Pak Ki Tamam Ne’mato’n Ko
Taqseem Farmate Hain.Allah Ta’ala Ke Hukm Se Aap
Hi Mushkilo’n Ko Taalne Waale Hai. Aap Khatao’n
Ko Darguzar Karne Waale Aur Ummat Ke Gunaho’n
Ko Apni Shafa’at Ke Noor Se Mitaane Waale Hain.
Aye Mere Aaqa ﷺ Aap To Be Misl O Be Misaal
,Lajwab Hai Aap Jaisa Koi Aaya Hain Na Aayega.

Woh Kunwaari Pak Maryam Woh Nafakhtofeeh Ka
               Dam
Hai Ajab Nishaan E Azam Magar Aamina Ka Jaaya
           Wohi Sab Se Afzal Aaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kunwaari = Ghair Shaadi Shuda
Maryam = Isa Aliahissalam Ki Maa
Nafakhtofeeh = Main Ne Us Me Phoonka
Dam = Phoonk
Ajab = Hairan Kun
Azam = Sab Se Bada
Jaaya = Jana Huwa, Beta

    Mafhoom :- Beshak Hazrat E Isa Alaihissalam
Ka Hazrath E Mariyam Sallamulla Alaiah Ke Pet Me

                    208

Baghair Baap Ke Sirf Phoonk Ke Zariya Paida Ho
Jaana Badi Kamal O Hairan Kun Hai Aur Ye Allah
Ta’ala Ki Badi Nishaani Tehri Magar Sayyada Amina
Ka Laal Sayyidul Ambiya Ki Paidaish Bhi Koi Kam
Nahi, Ke Bade Bade Hairat Angez Waqiyaat Kasrat Ke
Saath Zikr Kiye Gaye Hain.Is Se Pata Chalta Hai Ke
Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Sab Se Badi Allah Ki Nishaani Hai.

   Yahi Bole Sidra Waale Chaman E Jahaan Ke
                    Thaale
  Sabhi Maine Chaan Dhaale Tere Paaye Ka Na
                   Paaya
           Tujhe Yak Ne Yak Banaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sidra Waale = Jibrael Alaihissalam
Thaale = Daaire
Chaan Dhaale = Dekh Liya
Paaya = Rutba
Yak = Ek , Be Misaal

    Mafhoom :-
     Farishto’n Ke Sardaar Bhi Pukar Utthe Ke Hum
Ne Poore Jahaan Chaan Dhaale Lekin Huzoor ﷺ

                    209

Jaisa Martaba O Maqam Kisi Ka Nahi Hai Wajah Yahi
Hai Ke Us Wahdahu La Shareek Ne Apne Mehboob
Ko Yakta O Be Misl O Lajwab Banaya Hai.

  Fa Izaa Farghta Fansab Ye Mila Hai Tum Ko
                 Mansab
 Jo Gadaa Bana Chuke Ab Uttho Waqt E Bakhsish
                   Aaya
            Karo Qismat E ‘Ataaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Fa Iza Faraghta Fan Sab = Jab Tu Farigh Ho To Khade
Ho Ja Allah Ki Bargah Me.
Mansab = Maqam O Martaba
Gada = Bhikaari
Qismat E ‘Ataaya = Ne’mato’n Ki Taqseem

    Mafhoom :-
     Quran E Majeed Me Allah Ta’ala Ne Apne
Mehboob Ko “ Pas Aap Jab Farigh Hojaye To Apne
Rab Ki Bargah Me Khade Hojaye” Ka Azeem Mansab
Ata Farmaya Hai. Aye Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Jinko Aapne
Apna Gada Bana Liya Hai Khudara Uthien Aur
Gadao’n Ko Allah Ki Ne’matien Taqseem Farmaye.

                    210

Wa Ilalilaahi Farghab Karo Arz Sab Ke Matlab
 Ke Tumhin Ko Takte Hai Sab Karo Un Par Apna
                   Saaya
          Bano Shaaf’ E Khataaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Wa Ilalilaahi Farghab =  Allah Ki Taraf Raaghib O
Mutawajje Ho
Arz Karna = Pesh Karna
Matlab = Maqasid O Hajat

    Mafhoom :- Jab Allah Ne Aap Ko Hukm Diya
Hain Ke Uski Bargah Me Mutawajjeh Ho To Phir Aye
Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ  Apne Rab Ki Taraf Ruju’
Farmaye Aur Hum Sab Ki Haajaat Allah Ki Bargah
Me Pesh Farmaye, Aap Ke Tamam Gada To Sirf Aap
Hi Ka Munh Tak Rahe Hain,Ke Abhi Hamare Aaqa
ﷺ Rehmat Ka Saaya Farmayengey, Shafa’at Ke Lab
Hilaayengey Aur Hum Sab Ki Bakhshish Hojayegi.

   Are Aye Khuda Ke Bando’n Koi Mere Dil Ko
                Dhundoo
Mere Paas Tha Abhi To Abhi Kya Huwa Khudaaya
           Naa Koi Gaya Na Aaya
                    211

Mushkil :-
Khudaaya = Ya Allah

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Khuda Ke Bando’n Zara Mere Dil Ki
Khabar Lo Ke Kahaan Chala Gaya Hai Abhi To Yahi
Tha Aur Koi Gaya Aaya Bhi Nahi.

  Kabhi Khandah Zer Lab Hai Kabhi Girya Saari
                 Shab Hai
 Kabhi Gham Kabhi Tarab Hai Na Sabab Samajh
              Me Aaya
          Na Usi Ne Kuch Bataya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khanda Zer E Lab = Nazar Chura Kar Lab Muskurana
Girya = Rona
Tarab = Khushi
Sabab = Wajah

    Mafhoom :-
     Ajeeb  Deewana  Dil  Hai  Kabhi  Zere  Lab
Muskurata Hai Aur Kabhi Deedar Ki Hasrat Me Raat
Raat Bhar Rota Hai , Kabhi Gham Se Nidhaal Hai To

                    212

Kabhi Khushi Se Phoola Nahi Samata. In Kaifiyaat Ki
Wajah Na Mujhe Khud Samjh Me Aayi Aur Na Hi
Usne Mujhe Kuch Bataya.

  Kabhi Khaak Par Pada Hay Sar E Charkh Zer E
                 Paa Hai
   Kabhi Pesh E Dar Khada Hai Sar E Bandagi
                 Jhukaaya
          To Qadam E Arsh Paaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sar E Charkh = Aasmaan Ke Upar
Zer E Paa = Paun Ke Neeche
Pesh E Dar = Darwaze Ke Saamne

    Mafhoom :-
     Kabhi Mera Dil Deewana Khaak Pe Lot Pot Hota
Hai,Kabhi Aasmaan Ke Upar Parwaaz Karna Shuru
Kardeta Hai Aur Aasmaan Uske Zare Pa Hojata Hai.
Kabhi Roza E Pak Ke Saamne Adab Se Ghulami Ka
Haq Ada Karne Ke Liya Khada Hojata Hai, Phir Ek
Lamhe Me Arsh Se Upar Pahunch Jaata Hai Aur Meraj
Un Nabi Ke Tasawwuraat Me Gum Ho Jaata Hai.


                    213

Kabhi Wo Tapak Ke Aatish Kabhi Wo Tapak Ke
                    Baarish
   Kabhi Wo Hujoom E Naalish Koi Jaane Abr
                  Chaaya
             Bari Joshishon Se Aaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Tapak 1 = Dard Ki Garmi
Aatish = Aag
Tapak 2 = Tapakna Se
Naaish = Rona, Duhaayi Dena
Abr = Baadal
Joshishon = Zor O Shor
    Mafhoom :- Kabhi Dard Ki Wajah Se Is Tarah
Tadapta Hai Ke Aag Hojaata Hai Aur Kabhi Us Aag
Ko Apni Aansuon Ki Baarish Se Bujata Hai . Kabhi Us
Par Ghamo’n Ka Is Qadar Hujoom Hojata Hai Ke
Goya Kale Baadal Chaa Gaye Hain Ye Haalat Is Par
Bade Zor Shor Ke Saath Hoti Hai.

 Kabhi Wo Chehek Ke Bulbul Kabhi Wo Mehak Ke
                Khud Gul
   Kabhi Wo Lehak Ke Bilkul Chaman E Jinaan
                   Khilaaya

                    214

Gul E Quds Lehlaaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Chehak = Bulbul Ki Awaaz
Mehak = Khushboo
Gul = Phool
Lehak = Sabza
Jinaan = Jannatien
Gul E Quds = Mubarak Phool
Lehlaaya = Joban Par Aa Kar Lehraya

    Mafhoom :- Kabhi Yaad E Mehboob Aati Hai
To Mera Dil Bulbul Ki Tarah Hojata Hai Aur Kabhi Is
Me Mohabbat E Rasool Ki Aisi Khushboo Paida Hoti
Hai Ke Saara Phool Nazar Aane Lagta Hai Aur Phir
Usko Deedar E Mehboob Ki Lazzat Mil Jaati Hai To
Khilke Jannat Ka Baagh Ban Jaata Hai Aur Ye Ba
Barkat Baagh Phir Lehlehaane Lagta Hai.

 Kabhi Zindagi Ke Armaan Kabhi Margh E Nau Ka
               Khwaahaan
 Wo Haya Ke Marg Qurbaan Wo Mawaa Ke Zeest
                   Laaya
          Kahe Rooh Haan Jilaaya

                    215

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Armaan = Aarzo
Marg E Nau = Nayi Maut
Khwaahaan = Talib, Mutalashi,Talash Karne Waala
Haya = Sharm
Mawaa = Murda
Zeest = Zindagi
    Mafhoom  :-
     Kabhi Zindaa Rehne Ki Khwaish Karta Hai To
Kabhi Har Waqt Maut Ka Talabgaar Hota Hai Magar
Us Ki Zindagi Aisi Hai Ke Maut Us Par Qurbaan
Hojaati Hai Aur Uski Maut Bhi Aisi Hai Ke Hazaaro’n
Zindagiyaa’n Us Pe Nisaar Ho Jaati Hai Aur Markar
Bhi Zinda Hi Rehta Hai Kyun Ke Mohabbat E Rasool
Me Shaheed Huwa Hai Aur Shaheed Zinda Hote Hain.

  Kabhi Gham Kabhi ‘Iyaan Hai Kabhi Sard Gah
                Tapaan Hai
Kabhi Zer E Lab Faghaan Hai Kabhi Chup Ke Dam
              Na Thaaya
        Rukh Ke Kaam Jaan Dikhaya

    Muhskil Alfaz :-
Iyaan = Zaahir

                    216

Sard = Thanda
Gah = Kabhi
Tapaan = Garam
Faghaan = Rona,Pukarna
Dam = Saans
Na Thaaya = Na Tha Yahan

    Mafhoom :- Kabhi Mera Dil Deeewana Ghaib
Hojata Hai Kabhi Zaahir Hojata Hai,Kabhi Bilkul
Thanda Baraf Ho Jaata Hai Aur Kabhi Aisa Garam
Hojata Hai Ke Badan Me Aag Lega Deta Hai,Kabhi
Zer E Lab Rona Shuru Kardeta Hai Aur Kabhi Aisa
Chup Hojata Hai Ke Us Me Dam Kham Hi Nahi,Rooh
Ne Apne Kaam Ka Chehra Dikhaya.

  Ye Tasawwuraat E Baatil Tere Aage Kya Hain
                   Mushkil
   Teri Qudratien Hai Kaamil Unhien Raast Kar
                 Khudaya
         Main Unhien Shafee’ Laaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Tasawwuraat E Baatil = Ghalat Khayalat
Raast = Saccha

                    217

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Allah Teri Qudrat E Kaamila Ke Aage
Kya Baee'd Aur Mushkil Hai Ke Tu Mere In Khayalat
E  Baatila  Jo Abhi Tak Poore Nahi Hosake Ko
Haqeeqat Me Tabdeel Farma De Aur Mere Dil Ko
Yahi Kaifiyaat Aur Bulandiyaan Ata Farma. Main Teri
Bargah Me Tere Mehboob ﷺ Ko Sifarish Ke Liye
Aaya Hoon.

   Humien Aye Raza Tere Dil Ka Pata Chala Ba
                   Mushkil
Dar E Roza Ke Muqabil Wo Hamien Nazar To Aaya
          Ye Na Pooch Kaisa Paaya

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Muqabil = Saamne

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Raza Tere Dil Ka Humne Badi Koshish Ki
Use Dhoondne Ki To Hamien Wo Tasﷺ  Urati
Duniya Me Pyare Mehboob ﷺ Ke Roza E Pak Ke
Saamne Nazar Aaya Magar Ye Na Pooch Kis Haalat
Me Paaya Kyun Ke Kabhi Kuch Kabhi Kuch Kaifiyat
Me Wo Humien Nazar Aaya Hai.

                    218

(22)
  Hai Kalaam E Ilahi Me Shams O Dhuhaa Tere
         Chehra E Noor Fiza Ki Qasam
Qasam E Shab E Taar Me Raaz Ye Tha Ke Habeeb
         Ke

sections.title: Zulf E Do Taa Ki Qasam

blocks.text:
Zulf E Do Taa Ki Qasam

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kalam E Ilahi = Allah Ta’ala Ka Kalam , Quran
Shams = Surah Shams
Dhuha = Surah Dhuha
Noor Fiza = Noor Badhane Waala
Shab E Taar = Andheri Raat Murad Wallaili Iza Saja
Do Taa = Kham Daar
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Noor Waale Aaqa ﷺ
Quran E Majeed Me Wasshams Waddhuha Farma Kar
Allah Ne Aap Ke Chehra E Anwar Ki Qasam Yaad
Farmayi Aur Wallaili Iza Saja Farma Kara Ap Ke
Kham Zulfien Ki Qasam Yaad Farmayi. Goya Din
Agar Munawwar O Roshan Hai To Rukh E Mustafa Se
Aur Raat Andheri Hai To Zulf E Do Taa Se.


Tere Khulq Ko Haq Ne Azeem Kaha Tere Khalq Ko
           Haq Ne Jameel Kiya

                    219

Koi Tujh Sa Huwa Hai Na Hoga Shaha Tere Khaliq
         E Husn O Ada Ki Qasam

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khulq = Akhlaq
Azeem = Bada
Khalq = Paidaish
Jameel = Khubsoorat
Tujh Sa = Aap Jaisa
Khaliq = Paida Karne Waala
Husn O Ada = Husn O Jamal Aur Ada

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Rehmat Waale Aaqa ﷺ  Allah Ne
Aap Ke Khulq Ko Bada Qaraar Diya Hai Aur Aap Ki
Wiladat E Ba Sa’adat Hazaaro’n Barkatien Le Kar
Aayi Hai Aisi Nirali Wa Haseen Paidaish Na Kisi Ki
Huyi Hain Na Hogi Mujhe Usi Husn O Ada Ke Khaliq
Ki Qasam Hai.

 Wo Khuda Ne Hai Martaba Tujh Ko Diya Na Kisi
          Ko Mile Na Kisi Ko Mila
Ke Kalam E Majeed Ne Khaayi Shaha Teri Shehr O
          Kalaam O Baqaa Ki Qasam

                    220

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Baqaa = Zindagi
Kalaam = Baat, Guftugu

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ  Jo Aap Ke Rab Ne
Aap Ko Martaba Diya

sections.title: Hai

blocks.text:
Hain Ke Rab Ka Kalaam Me
Aap Ke Shehar , Aap Ki Munh Mubarak Se Nikalne
Waale Alfaz Aur Aap Ki Zindagi Ki Qasam Yaad
Farmayi Hai Aisa Maqam O Martaba Na Kisi Ko Mila
Hain Na Na Milega.

   Tera Masnad E Naaz Hai Arsh E Baree Tera
     Mahram E Naaz Hai Rooh E Ameen
 Tu Hi Sarwar E Har Do Jahaan Hai Shaha Tera
         Misl Nahi Hai Khuda Ki Qasam

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Arsh E Baree = Khuda Ka Takht
Rooh E Ameen = Jibrail Alihissalam

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Azmat Wale Nabi ﷺ  Aap Ke
Azmato’n Ka Kon Andaza Laga Sakta Hai Ke Khuda

                    221

Ka Arsh To Aap Ke Baithne Ki Jaga Hai,Aur Sayyidul
Malaika Aap Ka Hamraaz Zer Hai,Aur Aap Dono
Jahaano’n Ke Baadshsah Huwe Khuda Ki Qasam Aap
Jaisa Koi Hai Hi Nahi.


 Yahi Arz Hai Khaliq E Ardh O Samaa Wo Rasool
          Hai Tere Main Banda Tera
  Mujhe Unke Jawaar Me De Wo Jagah Ke Hai
        Khuld Ko Jis Ki Safaa Ki Qasasm

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Ardh O Sama = Zameen O Aasmaan
Jawaar = Pados
Khuld = Jannat
Safaa = Pakeezgi

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Zameen O Aasmaan Ko Paida Karne Waale
Main Tera Banda Hoon Aur Wo Tere Habeeb Hai
Mujhe Apne Mehboob ﷺ Ke Sadqe Unhi Ke Pados
Me Duniya Aur Aakhirath Me Thodi Jaga Inayat
Karde Ki Ye Aisi Jaga Hai Jiski Pakeezgi Par Jannat
Bhi Qasam Uthaa Thi Hai.


                    222

Tu Hi Bando Pe Karta Hai Lutf O Karam Hai Tujhi
           Pe Bharosa Tujhi Se Dua
Mujhe Jalwa E Pak Rasool Dikha Tujh Apne Hi Izz
          O Ulaa Ki Qasam

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Lutf O Ata = Mehrbaani
Izz O Ulaa = Izzat O Bulandi

    Mafhoom :- Aye Allah Is Me Koi Shak Nahi Ke
Apne Bando’n Pe Tu Hi Meherbani Fermata Hai Aur
Unke Bigde Kaam Tu Hi Sanwaarta Hai Yahi Aqeeda
O Imaan Bharosa Bhi Hai Aur Saath Ye Aajizaana Dua
Bhi Hai Ke Mera Bigda Kaam Sirf Tere Nabi Ke
Deedar Se Sanwar Sakta Hai Aye Allah Tujhe Qasam
Hai Apne Izzat O Bulandi Ki Mujhe Apne Habeeb Ka
Deedar Ata Farma.

 Mere Gharche Gunah Hai Had Se Siwa Magar Un
          Se Ummed Hai Tujh Se Raja
Tu Rahim Hai Unka Karam Hai Gawaa Wo Kareem
           Hain Teri Ata Ki Qasam

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Had Se Siwa = Behad O Behisaab

                    223

Raja = Ummed

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Allah Main Tasleem Karta Hoon Ke Mere
Gnah Behisaab Hai .Magar Na Mai Teri Rehmat Se Na
Ummed Hoon Aur  Huzoor Ke Karam  Se  Bhi
Mukammal Ummed Rakhta Hoon.

 Yahi Kehti Hai Bulbule Baaghe Jinaa Ke Raza Ki
            Tarah Koi Sehr Bayaan
   Nahi Hind Me Wasif E Shah E Huda Mujhe
         Shokhiye Tab’ E Raza Ki Qasam

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Jinaa = Jannat
Sehr Bayaan = Jaadu Bayan, Faseeh O Baleegh
Hind = Pak O Hind
Wasif = Tareef Karne Waala
Shah E Huda = Hidayat Ka Baadshah Yaani Huzoor
ﷺ
Shokhi = Be Baki
Tab’e = Tabiyat
    Mafhoom :- Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Aap Ke Dar
Ka Gada Ahmed Raza Apni Shokhi Tabiyat Ke Taqaze

                    224

Se Arz Kar Raha Hai Ke Jannat Ki Bulbulien Kehti
Hongi Ke Hindhustan Me Ahmed Raza Jaisa Allah Ke
Mehboob Ki Tareef Karne Waala Koi Bhi Nahi Aur
Ye Baaat Wo Raza Ki Shokhi Tab’e Ki Qasam Utha
Kar Keh Rahi Hogi. Ye Sher Aala Hazrath Ka Tehdees
E Nemat Ke Taur Par Hai.


                        (23)
 Mujda Baad Aay Aa’siyon Shaafi’ Shah E Abraar
                    Hai
 Tehniyat Aye Mujrimo Zaat E Khuda Ghaffar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Mujda Baad = Mubarak Baad
Aas’iyon = Gunahgaaro
Shaafi’ = Shifa’at Karne Waala
Shah E Abraar = Neko’n Ka Baadshah
Tehniyat = Khushkhabri

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye  Gunahgaaro’n  Mubarak Ho  Baroz E
Qiyamat Apne Hi Aaqa O Maula ﷺ Jo Neko’n Ke
Sardar Hai Hamari Shaf’at Farmayengey ,Haan Haan

                    225

Ek Aur Khushkhabri Ye Hai Ke Jis Khuda Ki Bargah
Me Huzoor ﷺ Shaf’at Karengey Wo Zaat Bhi Badi
Bakhshne Waali Hai.


 Arsh Sa Farsh E Zameen Hai, Farsh Paa Arsh E
                    Baree
  Kya Niraali Tarz Ki Naam E Khuda Raftaar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Arsh Sa = Arsh Ki Tarah
Farsh = Zameen
Bareen = Buland O Baala
Nirali Tarz = Anokha Tariqa
Raftaar = Chaal

    Mafhoom  :- Jis Sar Zameen Par Huzoor ﷺ
Qadam Mubarak Rakhte Hain Wo Farsh Ho Kar Bhi
Arsh Jaisa Hai Ke Allah Ta’ala Uski Qasam Yaad
Fermata Hai  . Mere Huzoor ﷺ Ka Chalna  , Allah
Allah Kya Anokhi Chaal Hai.

 Chaand Shaq Ho Ped Bolein Jaanwar Sajda Kare
  Baarak Allah Marja E Aa’lam Yahi Sarkaar Hai

                    226

Mushkil Alfazl :-
Shaq Ho = Phat Jaaye
Ped = Darakht
Baarak Allah = Allah Aap Ko Barkat De
Marja E Aa’lam = Saare Jahaan Ki Panah Gah

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Logo’n Dekho Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Par Allah
Ta’ala Ka Kitna Karam Hai Aap Ke Ungli Ke Ishaare
Se Chaand Ke Tukde Ho Rahe Hai, Aap Ke Hukm Se
Darakhto’n Ko Bolne Ki Taqat Mil Rahi Hai Janwar
Aap Ko Sajda Kar Rahe Hain. Subhan Allah ! Hamare
Aaqa Sirf Insaaano’n Ke Hi Marja’ Nahi Balke Saare
Aalam Ki Panah Ga Hain.

 Jin Ko Soo E Aasmaan Phaila Kar Jhalthal Bhar
                     Diye
   Sadqa Un Haatho’n Ka Pyaare Hum Ko Bhi
                Darkaar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Soo E = Taraf
Jhal Thal = Khushk Tari Me Paani Hi Paani
Darkaar = Zaroorat

                    227

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Pyare Pyare Aaqa ﷺ   Jin Gore Gore
Haantho’n Ko Baarish Ke Liye Dua Ke Liye Uthaaye
The Phir Barsaat Cham Cham Barasne Lagi Unhi
Mubarak Haatho’n Ka Sadqa Humien Bhi Zaroorat
Hai Humien Bhi Ata Karde. Hamare Liye Bhi Apne
Rab Ki Bargah Me Haath Utha Kar Bakshish Ki Dua
Kardijiye.

Lab Zulaal E Chashma E Kun Me Gundhey Waqt E
                 Khameer
   Murde Zinda Karna Aye Jaan Tum Ko Kya
               Dushwaar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zulaal = Saaf Suthra
Kun = Hoja
Gundhey = Gundhane Se Jaise Aata Goondhna
Khameer = Gundhi Huwi Mitthi Yaa Aata

    Mafhoom :-
    Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Ki Bashariyat Ko Banana Ke
Liye Jab Allah Ta’ala Ne  Aapka Khameer Paida
Farmaya To Chashm E Kun Ke Saaf, Suthre Paani Se

                    228

Aap ﷺ Ke Labhaaye Mubarak Ko Banaye Gaye,Phir
Murde Zinda Karna Aap Ke Liye Konsa Mushkil
Kaam Hai.

  Gore Gore Paun Chamka Do Khuda Ke Waaste
 Noor Ka Tadka Ho Pyaare Gor Ki Shab Taar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Tadka = Ujala , Sawera
Gor = Qabr
Shab Taar = Andheri Raat
    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Pyare Rasool ﷺ Khuda
Ke Liye Aap Ke Gore Gore Qadam Mubarak Meri
Qabr Me Rakh Kar Meri Qabr Ki Siyah Raat Ko Subh
E Noor Bana Dijiye .

 Tere Hi Daaman Pe Har Aa’si Ki Padti Hai Nazar
 Ek Jaan E Be Khata Par Do Jahaan Ka Baar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Be Khata = Masoom

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Lajpal Aaqa ﷺ  Har
Gunahgar Ki Nigah Aap Hi Ke Daaman E Rehmat Pe
Lagi Huyi Hai Agarche Ummat Beshumar Hai Aur
                    229

Aap Ek Hi Masoom Jaan Hai Lekin Allah Ne Aap Ko
Aisi Pakeeza Jaan Ata Farmayi Ke Saare Ummat Ka
Bojh Uthaane Ke Liye Aap Akele Hi Kaafi Hai.


 Josh E Tufaan Behr E Be Paayaan Hawaa Naaa
                   Saazgaar
Nooh Ke Maula Karam Kar Dete To Beda Paar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Josh E Toofan = Sakhti Aandhi,Toofan
Behr Be Paayaan = Samundar Jis Ka Kinara Na Ho
Naa Saazgaar = Mukhalif

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ Toofan
Zor Par Hai Gunaho’n Ka Samundar Aisa Hai Uska
Kinara Nazar Nahi Aa Raha Hai, Jab Ke Hawa Bhi
Mukhalif  Taraf  Hi  Chal  Rahi  Hai Aye Nooh
Alaishissalam Ke Bhi Aaqa Aap Hi Karam Farma De
To Hamara Beda Paar Hai. Rahmatul Lil ‘Aalameen
Teri Duhaayi Dab Gaya, Ab To Moula Be Tarah Sar
Par Gunah Ka Baar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Duhaayi = Faryad

                    230

Dab Gaya = Bojh Tale Aagaya
Be Tarah = Qaabil O Bardasht

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Rehmat Waale Aaqa ﷺ Gunaho’n
Ke Bojh Tale Mai Dab Gaya Hoon,Aur Bohat Buri
Tarha Gunah Ki Chaal Me Phans Gaya Hoon,Pas Aap
Hi Ki Duhaayi Hai Aap Ek Ishaare Se Mere Gunaho’n
Ka Bojh Utaar Dijiye.

 Hairatien Hai Aaina Daar E Wafur E Wasf E Gul
 Un Ke Bulbul Ki Khamoshi Bhi Lab E Izhaar Hai

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Hairatien = Hairaaniyan
Aaina Daar = Sheesha Dikhane Waala
Wafur = Bohat Zyada
Wasf E Gul = Phool Ki Khoobi
Lab E Izhaar = Zaahir Karne Wale Hont

    Mafhoom :-
    Mere Aaqa ﷺ Me Is Qadar La Tadaad Kamalat
O Khoobiyan Hai Ke Zabaan Se Bol Kar To Un
Khoobiyo’n Ko Bayan Karna Mumkin Me Se Hai

                    231

Hairaaniyo’n Ne Saamne Rakh Kar Ghaur Karna
Shuru Kiya To Khamoshi Ki Zabaan Me Hi Un
Kamalat Ko Bayan Karne Hi Me Aasani Samjhi .

  Goonj Goonj Hai Naghmat E Raza Se Boostan
Kyun Na Ho Kis Phool Ki Midhat Me Waa Minqaar
                    Hai

    Muhskil Alfaz :-
Boostan = Baagh
Waa = Khula Huwa
Minqaar = Parinde Ki Choch

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Raza Tu Ne Aisa Mehboob Chuna Ke Jiske
Ishq Me Tu Naghme Alaap Raha Hai Us Baagh Ke
Baagh Bhi Goonj Uthe Hain.





                    232

(24)
         Dil Ko Unse Khuda Juda Na Kare

sections.title: Bekasi Loot Le Khuda Na Kare

blocks.text:
Bekasi Loot Le Khuda Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bekasi = Mohtaji
Loot = Tabah Kare

    Mafhoom :- Aye Allah Duniya Choote To Sau
Baar Choote,Magar Mere Dil Ko Apne Mehboob Se
Juda Na Karna Ke Us Me Mehboob ﷺ Ki Mohabbat
Na Raahi Aur Dard E Ishq E Mustafa ﷺ Ki Bekasi
Mujh Se Chin Jaaye.

        Is Me Rouze Ka Sajdah Ho Ke Tawaf
      Hosh Me Jo Na Ho Wo Kya Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
    Tawaf = Chakkar

    Mafhoom :-
      Is Bekasi Me Agar Koi Apne Hosh O Hawas Hi
Kho Baithe Aur Roza E Aqdas Ka Tawaf Ya Sajda
Kare Jo Hosh O Hawas Ke Saath Na Jaiz Hai Karle To
                    233

Us Par Kya Muakhaza Ho Sakta Hai Kyun Ke Wo
Hosh Me Hi Nahi Hai.

      Ye Wohi Hain Ke Bakhsh Dete Hain
      Kaun In Jurmo’n Pe Sazaa Na Kare

    Mafhoom :- Ye Hamare Aaqa ﷺ Hi Hai Ke Jo
Bade Bade Paapiyo’n Ko Muaf Farma Dete Hain
Warna Kon Hai Aisa Jo In Jurmo’n Pe Saza Na Kare.

      Sab Tabeebo’n Ne De Diya Hai Jawab
       Aah ‘Eesa Agar Dawaa Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Tabeeb = Ilaaj Karne Waale
Jawab = Ilaaj Se Mazoori Zaahir Karna

    Mafhoom  :- Duniya K Tamam Hakeemo’n Ne
To Mujhe La Ilaaj Kar Ke Chorr Diya Hain Ab Mere
Eesa Yaani Aaqa ﷺ Bhi Agar Dawa Na Kare To Phir
Zindagi Ki Ummed Kahaan.

      Dil Kahaan Le Chala Haram Se Mujhe
         Are Tera Bura Khuda Na Kare

                    234

Mushkil Alfaz :-
Haram = Makka O Madina

    Maf

sections.title: Ho

blocks.text:
hoom :-
     Are Mere Dil Khuda Tujhe Hidayat De Tu Bhi
Kaisa Ahmaq Hai Ke Mujh Se Madina Churra Raha
Hai,Kya Madine Se Behtar Koi Jaga Hai Jo Tu Mujhe
Le Jaana Chahta Hai.

       Uzr E Ummed E Afw Agar Na Sune
      Ru Siyaah Aur Kya Bahana Kare


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Uzr = Bahana
Afw = Muafi
Ru Siyah = Gunahgar

    Mafhoom :-
      Jin Ke Karam Kareemana Se Mujhe Muafi Aur
Darguzar Ki Ummed Hai Agar Wo Kareem Hi Mera
Bahana Aur  Mazirath Qubool Nahi Karega Aur
Gunahgar Ke Liye To Aur Koi Jaaye Panah Bhi Nahi
Hai.


                    235

Dil Me Roshan Hai Sham’e Ishq E Huzoor
      Kaash Josh E Hawas Hawaa Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Kaash = Haaye Afsos
Josh E Hawas = Lalach O Hirs Ki Ziyadati

    Mafhoom :- Alhamdulillah Abhi Tak To Dil Me
Sham’e Ishq E Mustafa Roshan Hai ,Kahin Josh E
Hawas Kaam Kharab Na Karde.

      Hashr Me Hum Bhi Sair Dekhengey
        Munkir Aaj Unse Ilteja Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sair Dekhengey = Tamasha Dekhengey
Munkir = Inkaar Karne Waala
Ilteja = Darkhwast

    Mafhoom :-
    Maidan E  Mehshar Me Hum  Bhi Khoob
Tamasha Dekhengey Ke Aaj Jo Unse Madad Maangne
Ko Na Jaiz Kehte Hain Wo Bhi Kaise Unki Madad Ke
Bhikari Bante Hain.

                    236

Zof Maana Magar Ye Zaalim Dil
      Unke Raaste Me To Thaka Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zof = Kamzori

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye  Dil Maana Ki Tu Kamzor Hai Lekin
Mehboob Ke Dar Par Jaane Ke Liye To Na Thaka Kar
Aur Nekiyaan Karke Rehmat E Mustafa Haasil Karne
Ki Koshish Me To Na Thaka Kar.

      Jab Teri Khu Hai Sabka Jee Rakhna
       Wahi Accha Jo Dil Buraa Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khu = Aadat
Jee Rakhna = Khush Karna

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Kareem Aaqa ﷺ Jab Aap Ki Aadat
E Kareema Hai Ke Aap Sab Ka Dil Rakhte Hain Chahe
Jinn O Ins O Farishtey Har Shayi Ho To Mai Bhi Apne
Dil Ko Samjha Ta Hoon Ke Aye Dil Tu Bhi Andar Se

                    237

Mail Kuchail Nikal Aur Aaqa ﷺ Ki Mohabbat Me
Zindagi Guzar Yehi Accha Hai.

       Dil Se Ek Zauq E Mai Ka Talab Hoon
        Kaun Kehta Hai Itteqa Na Kare

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Zauq E Mai = Lazzat E Sharab . Ishq
Itteqa = Parehzgaari

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Pyare Aaqa ﷺ ! Mujhe
Aap Apni Mohabbat Ka Jam Pilaadijiye Aur Haan
Agar Koi Is Se Bachta Aur Taqwa Parehzgaari Karta
Hai To Mujhe Koi Parwa Nahi Ke Taqwa Unko
Mubarak Jo Baghair Ishq Ke Ho Aur Mujhe Aap Apna
Jaam E Ulfat Pilaayiye.

         Le Raza Sab Chale Madine Ko
      Main Na Jaun Are Khuda Na Kare

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Allah Main Ye Na Sun Uke Sab Madine
Chalegaye Aur Aye Raza Tu Reh Gaya Balke Mujhe
Bhi Madine Ki Khush Khabri Ata Karde.
                    238

(25)
    Ya Ilahi Har Jagah Teri Ata Ka Saath Ho
 Jab Pade Mushkil Shahe Mushkil Kusha Ka Saath
                Ho

    Mafhoom :- Aye Allah Hum Teri Bargah Me
Dua Goh Hai Ke Har Waqt Har Jagah Teri Ataaien Aur
Teri Mehrbaaniyan Hamare Saath Ho,Aur Hamien
Apni Har Mushkil Me Tere Mehboob ﷺ  Mushkil
Kusha Ka Saath Ata Karde.

    Ya Ilahi Bhool Jaaun Naza’ Ki Takleef Ko
 Shaadiy E Deedar E Husn E Mustafa Ka Saath Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Naza’ Ki = Maut Ki
Shaadiy = Khushi
    Mafhoom :- Ya Allah Hum Siyaah Kaar Maut
Ki Takleef Bardasth Nahi Kar Sakte Lihaza Maut Ke
Waqt Apne Mehboob ﷺ Ka Deedar Ata Farma Taa
Ke Hamari Deed Hoti Rahe Hum Jalwa E Mustafa ﷺ
Me Gum Hojaye Aur Rooh Nikal Jaaye Pata Bhi Na
Chale.

                    239

Ya Ilahi Gor E Teera Ki Jab Aaye Sakht Raat
Unke Pyaare Moonh Ki Subh E Jaan Fiza Ka Saath
                Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Gor E Teera = Andheri Raat
Jaan Fiza = Jaan Ko Badhane Waali

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Allah Qabr Ki Us Sakht Tareeki Raat Me
Apne Mehboob ﷺ Ka Qabr Me Deedar Ata Farma
Taa Ke Meri Jaan Me Jaan Aaye Aur Rooh Unki
Ziyarath Karke Chain O Sukoon Paaye.


Ya Ilahi Jab Pade Mehshar Me Shor E Daar O Geer
  Amn Dene Waale Pyaare Peshwa Ka Saath Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Daar O Geer = Qaid O Band
Peshwa = Muqtada
    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Mere Allah Jab Mujrimo’n Ki Qiyamat Me
Pakad Dhakad Hogi, Qaid O Band Hojayengey To

                    240

Mujhe Kon Bacahyega To Allah Un Haalat Me Amn
Dene Waale Mere Peshwa Ka Saath Ata Farma De.

  Ya Ilahi Jab Zubaanien Baahar Aaye Pyaas Se
 Sahib E Kausar Shah E Jood O Ata Ka Saath Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sahib E Kausar = Hauz E Kausar Ke Malik
Shah E Jood O Ata = Jood O Sakhawat Ke Baadshah

    Mafhoom :-
    Aye Allah Jab Maidane Mehshar Ki Garmi Se
Sabki Zubaanien Baahar Aajyengei To Mere Liye
Houz E Kausar Ke Malik Ke Haatho Jaam E Kausar
Peena Naseeb Farma.

  Ya Ilahi Sard Muhri Par Ho Jab Khursheed E
                  Hashr
   Sayyid E Be Saaya Ke Zil E Liwa Ka Saath Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Sarde Muhri = Bewafaai
Khursheed = Suraj
Zil E Liwa = Liwa Ul Hamd Jhanda Ka Saya

                    241

Mafhoom :-
    Aye Allah Jab Suraj Poori Tarah Apne Gussa Ka
Izhaar Karega To Mujhe Tere Be Saaya Nabi Ke
Jhanda Ka Saaya Ata Farma.


 Ya Ilahi Garmi E Mehshar Se Jab Bhadke Badan
Daaman E Mehboob Ki Thandi Hawa Ka Saath Ho

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Allah Jab Maidan E Mehshar Ki Garmi Se
Saara Jism Bhadak Uthega Aur Log Paseene Me
Doobe Huwe Hongey To Mujhe Apne Mehboob Ke
Daaman Ki Thandi Hawa Ata Farma.

   Ya Ilahi Naama E Aamal Jab Khulne Lage
  A’ib Posh E Khalq Sattar E Khata Ka Saath Ho

    Muhskil Alfaz :-
A’ib Posh = Chupane Waala
Khalq = Makhlooq
Sattar E Khata = Ghalti Chupaane Waale

    Mafhoom :- Aye Mere Allah Jab Mehshar Me
Mere Naam E Amaal Khulengey To Wo Jinko Tune
                    242

makhlooq Ke A’ibo Ko Chupane Waala Banaya Hai
Unka Saath Ata Farma De.

  Ya Ilahi Jab Bahe Aankhien Hisaab E Jurm Me
 Un Tabassum Rez Honton Ki Dua’a Ka Saath Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Bahe = Jaari Ho
Tabassum Rez = Mukurahat Waale Hont
    Mafhoom  :- Ya  Ilahi Jab Hamri Aankhien
Hisaab E Gunah Me Bahe To Tere Pyare Mehboob Ke
Un Muskurate Honton Ki Dua Ka Saath Ho Jo Wo
Ummat Ke Liye Karengey.

  Ya Ilahi Jab Hisaab E Khanda E Bejaa Rulaaye
  Chashm E Girya Shafi E Murtaza Ka Saath Ho

    Muhskil Alfaz :-
Khanda E Beja = Mazaq
Girya = Rone Waali
Murtaza = Jisse Ummed Wabasta Kiya Jaaye
    Mafhoom :- Aye Allah Jo Duniya Me Hum Ne
Hansi Mazaq Me Jo Apna Waqt Guazrdiya Aur Ab

                    243

Mehshar Me Wo Hume Rulaaye To Tere Pyare
Mehboob ﷺ Ki Muqaddas Aankh Se Is Ummat Ke
Liye Niaklne Waae Aansuon Ka Sadqa Ata Karde


   Ya Ilahi Rang Laaye Jab Meri Be Baakiyaan
Unki Neechi Neechi Nazro’n Ki Hayaa Ka Saath Ho

    Muhskil Alfaz :-
Be Bakiyaan = Gunah

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Allah Jab Maidan E Mehshar Me Hamari Be
Baakiyaan Agar Khule To Itna Karam Karde Ke Tere
Mehboob Ke Saamne Na Khol Ki Ham Sharminda
Hojayengi Aur Tere Mehboob Ki Neechi Nazro Ka
Sadqa Maula Hamare Jurm Ko Khulne Hi Na Dein.

  Ya Ilahi Jab Chaloon Tareek Raah E Pul Sirat
   Aftaab E Hsashmi Noor Ul Huda Ka Saath Ho


    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Aaftab = Suraj
Noor Ul Huda = Hidayat O Rehnumayi Ki Roshni

                    244

Mafhoom :-
    Ya Rab Jab Hum Us Pul Se Guzrengey Jo Baal
Se Zyada Bareek Aur Talwar Se Zyada Tez Hai To
Humien Us Waqt Pyare Mehboob Ke Noor Ki Roshni
Ata Farma Jo Ke Noor E Rushd O Hidaaya Ke Suraj
Hai.

  Ya Ilahi Jab Sar E Shamsheer Par Chalna Pade
 Rabbi Sallim Kehne Waale Gham Zada Ka Saath
                Ho

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Allah Jab Us Pul Se Guzarne Ka Waqt Aajaye
To Tere Mehboob Ko Wo Sajda Jo Ummat Ke Liye
Pul Se Guazarne Me Aasani Ke Liye Hoga Wo Mujhe
Bhi Ata Farma De.

   Ya Ilahi Jo Duaaien Nek Hum Tujh Se Kare
Qudsiyo'n Ke Lab Se Ameen Rabbana Ka Saath Ho

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Allah Jo Bhi Nek O Jaiz Duaaien Hum Tujh
Se Kare Us Par Farishto’n Ke Lab Se Bhi Ameen Ka
Sada Ho.

                    245

Ya Ilahi Jab Raza Khwaab E Giraan Se Sar
                   Uthaaye
  Daulat E Bedar E Ishq E Mustafa Ka Saath Ho

    Mushkil Alfaz :-
Khwaab E Gira = Gehri Neend , Maut
Daulat = Naseeb
Bedar = Jeeta Jaagta

    Mafhoom :-
    Ya Allah Jab Maut Ki Gehri Neend Se Bedar
Hokar Apne Qabr Se Maidan E Mehsha Me Uthhu To
Tere Pyare Mehboob ﷺ Ki Ishq O Mohbbat E Bedaar
Se Mera Daaman Bhara Huwa Ho Aur Unke Hi Yaad
Se Mamoor Ho.





                    246
